jobs.title: Senior Water Resources Engineer - Aviation
jobs.description: **Company Overview** EG Solutions, Inc. (EGS) is a consulting firm specializing in water management for Florida airports as one of our four focus areas. Airport water management includes surface water quality and quantity and groundwater interactions in an operating environment that requires innovative and non\-standard approaches to avoid hazards to aircraft operations. With more than 100 years of combined experience among senior leadership, the EGS team provides those innovative solutions to airport clients throughout Florida. EGS is headquartered in the Sarasota area of Southwest Florida. **Position Summary** The Senior Water Resources Engineer provides analysis, design, permitting, and project management support for a variety of airport water management projects. This position performs technical work that includes hydrologic and hydraulic analyses, water quality evaluations, drainage design, floodplain studies, erosion and sediment control, water quantity and quality monitoring system design and data evaluation, groundwater hydrology, permitting, and construction support. The Senior Water Resources Engineer works collaboratively with internal staff, clients, contractors, consultants, and regulatory agencies to support successful project delivery. This position requires strong technical and organizational skills, independent thinking, and the ability to effectively manage changing project priorities. Occasional fieldwork and travel are required. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: * Perform stormwater system analysis and design for airport projects, including conveyance, storage, and stormwater quality best management practices. * Perform analysis and calculations to establish water quality treatment efficiencies for non\-standard, airport operation compatible design. * Perform surface water/groundwater interaction analyses to evaluate groundwater mounds, dewatering system design, potable groundwater supply from wells and similar. * Prepare or direct technical staff preparing technical reports, construction plans and details, construction technical specifications, presentation graphics, and other technical project deliverables. * Analyze flood\-prone areas to identify problems, evaluate alternative solutions, and develop recommended design alternatives. * Design soil erosion and sediment control practices. * Prepare grading designs and conceptual site layouts for consistency with stormwater management systems. * Coordinate with engineering and technical disciplines on multidisciplinary projects. * Assist with regulatory agency coordination, communication, and permitting activities for assigned projects. * Provide technical support during bidding and construction, as required. * Manage assigned projects and ensure deliverables are completed accurately and in accordance with established schedules and deadlines. * Communicate project progress and coordinate effectively with clients, regulators, subconsultants, and other project stakeholders. * Attend and participate in project meetings. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, or a related field from an accredited four\-year college or university. * Professional Engineer (PE) licensure. * 5\+ years experience * Fundamental understanding of water resources concepts, including stormwater management, water quality and chemistry, hydraulics, fluid mechanics, hydrology, geohydrology, and permitting. * Proficiency with at least one of the following modeling programs: EPA SWMM, Storm Wise/ICPR, or HEC\-RAS. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. * Valid driver’s license. * Ability to successfully complete required background check to pass airport security badge screening. * Ability to meet company drug\-free workplace requirements. **Preferred Qualifications** * Previous experience working on airport projects. * Field experience with water quality and quantity monitoring, including system design. * Experience applying for Environmental Resource Permits and Consumptive Use Permits with one or more Florida Water Management Districts. * Experience providing construction phase services, including shop drawing reviews, construction evaluation, permit closeouts, and similar. * Proficiency with Geographic Information Systems (GIS). * Proficiency with AutoCAD Civil 3D. * Experience with field and laboratory testing for geohydrologic data and parameters. * Experience with Computational Fluid Dynamics. * Experience with artificial intelligence and/or machine learning applications relevant to engineering or project delivery. * Pilot experience or aviation\-related knowledge. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong technical and analytical skills. * Ability to define the problem requiring solution. * Ability to analyze technical problems and develop practical design alternatives. * Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to interact professionally with clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory personnel, and internal team members. * Ability to coordinate effectively with regulatory agencies and other project stakeholders. * Ability to manage multiple projects, tasks, and changing priorities. * Ability to respond quickly and accurately under pressure. * Ability to meet established project schedules and deadlines. * Effective written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to prepare clear and accurate technical documentation, calculations, reports, and project deliverables. * Ability to evaluate alternative approaches to project design and delivery. **Physical Requirements and Working Conditions** This position operates in a combination of office, remote, hybrid, and field environments depending on project and business needs. Occasional fieldwork at airports, construction sites, and other project locations is required. The employee must be able to: * Remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working at a computer. * Frequently use a computer, keyboard, telephone, and other standard office equipment. * Communicate effectively with employees, clients, contractors, consultants, regulatory personnel, and other project stakeholders. * Work outdoors and in active project or construction environments as required. * Occasionally move materials or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds over short distances. * Travel to airports, project sites, meetings, training, or other business\-related activities as required. * Adapt to changing priorities and business needs in a fast\-paced professional environment. **Travel Requirements** * Occasional local and regional travel is required. * Travel to airports, construction sites, client meetings, regulatory meetings, and other project locations may be required. * Additional travel requirements may vary based on project assignments and client needs. * A valid driver’s license is required. **Compensation and Benefits** Compensation: Highly competitive salary based on experience Benefits may include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * Paid time off and company holidays. * Retirement savings plan with company contribution or match, where applicable. * Professional development and certification support. * Mileage reimbursement and travel\-related expenses in accordance with company policy. * Opportunities for advancement within a growing consulting firm. **Equal Employment Opportunity** *EG Solutions, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer and maintains a drug\-free workplace. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable federal, state, or local law.* Pay: $114,000\.00 \- $156,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Director of business systems & AI
jobs.description: Director of Business Systems \& AI Eclipse Lighting \& ElectricalLocation: Southern CaliforniaJob Type: Full\-TimeCompensation: $150,000–$190,000 per year \+ performance bonus About Eclipse Lighting \& Electrical Eclipse Lighting \& Electrical is an established commercial lighting and electrical contractor with approximately 100 employees. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a highly capable Director of Business Systems \& AI to lead a company\-wide transformation of our processes, technology, automation, data, and use of artificial intelligence. This is not a traditional IT support position, and we are not looking for someone simply to introduce employees to AI tools. We are looking for someone who can learn how our business operates from the ground up, identify inefficient or outdated processes, and then design and implement better systems. The Opportunity Our company has grown significantly over the years, and some of our processes and systems have not evolved as quickly as the business. Many workflows currently involve combinations of paper, manual approvals, multiple software systems, databases, spreadsheets, and repeated data entry. We believe there is a significant opportunity to use modern software, automation, integrations, data analytics, and AI to fundamentally improve how the company operates. You will be responsible for leading that transformation. You will work directly with company ownership and department leaders across: * Operations * Dispatch * Field Operations * Estimating * Engineering * Sales * Accounting * Accounts Receivable * Accounts Payable * Payroll * Purchasing * Billing * Human Resources * IT Your job will be to understand how work actually moves through Eclipse and determine how we can do it better. What You’ll Do Understand and Redesign Our Processes Spend time inside each department observing how employees actually work. Map workflows from initial customer request through estimating, scheduling, field execution, documentation, billing, collection, and financial reporting. Identify: * Duplicate data entry * Unnecessary approvals * Paper\-based processes * Manual reporting * Bottlenecks * Disconnected systems * Repetitive administrative work * Opportunities for automation * Opportunities for AI * Processes that should be redesigned before they are automated We don’t want to automate bad processes. We want to fix them first. Own Our Business Systems Strategy Evaluate our existing technology stack and determine what should be kept, improved, integrated, replaced, or eliminated. Current systems include QuickBooks Enterprise, Microsoft Access\-based operational systems, custom\-developed applications, and various department\-specific tools and processes. You will help determine the appropriate long\-term technology architecture for the company. Implement Automation and AI Identify practical applications of AI and automation that produce measurable business results. Potential applications include: * Automated document processing * Work\-order processing * Dispatch and scheduling assistance * Estimating and takeoff automation * Field documentation * Purchasing and material workflows * Invoice preparation and validation * Accounts receivable workflows * Job\-cost analysis * Financial reporting * Management dashboards * Customer communication * Internal knowledge systems * Contract and document review * Exception detection * Operational analytics AI should solve business problems—not be implemented simply because it is new technology. Connect Our Systems Reduce information silos and unnecessary manual entry. Develop or oversee integrations between accounting, operations, estimating, field systems, reporting tools, and other company platforms. Experience with APIs, databases, workflow automation, and systems integration is highly valuable. Build Management Visibility Create systems and dashboards that allow leadership to quickly understand: * Job profitability * Labor performance * Billing status * Accounts receivable * Operational bottlenecks * Estimating performance * Field productivity * Purchasing/material issues * Financial performance * Exceptions requiring management attention Our goal is to move from searching for information to having important information automatically surfaced to management. Lead Implementation You will not necessarily be expected to personally write every piece of software. You will be expected to understand technology well enough to determine what should be built, purchased, or integrated and to manage internal resources, developers, consultants, vendors, and AI platforms required to accomplish it. Most importantly, you will be accountable for getting projects implemented—not simply making recommendations. What We’re Looking For The ideal candidate has experience in some combination of: * Construction technology * Electrical, mechanical, plumbing, or specialty contracting * Business systems * ERP implementation * Digital transformation * Operations/process improvement * Systems integration * Workflow automation * AI implementation * Data analytics Experience inside a commercial contractor or construction company is strongly preferred. You should understand—or be capable of quickly understanding—business processes involving: * Estimating * Project/service operations * Dispatch * Purchasing * Field labor * Payroll * Job costing * Billing * Accounts receivable * Accounting Technical Experience Experience with some combination of the following is preferred: * Construction ERP systems * QuickBooks Enterprise or similar accounting/ERP platforms * Microsoft SQL Server / SQL * Microsoft Access * Power BI * Microsoft Power Platform * APIs and system integrations * Workflow automation platforms * Cloud applications * AI/LLM platforms * AI agents and workflow automation * Data architecture and reporting * Construction management software You do not need experience with every technology listed above. We care more about your ability to understand business problems, design solutions, and successfully implement them. Who Will Succeed in This Position You may be a strong fit if you are the type of person who walks into a department, watches a process involving 15 steps and immediately starts asking: Why are we doing it this way? You enjoy understanding how businesses actually operate. You are comfortable talking with everyone from electricians and dispatchers to accountants, engineers, managers, software developers, and company ownership. You can translate operational problems into technology solutions. You aren’t afraid to challenge existing processes. And you finish what you start. What This Position Is NOT This is not primarily: * Help desk/desktop support * Network administration * Cybersecurity * Software development * An AI research position * A consulting position that produces reports without implementation This is a hands\-on leadership position responsible for making Eclipse a more efficient, scalable, data\-driven company. How Success Will Be Measured Success will be measured by tangible improvements such as: * Reduction in manual administrative work * Faster work\-order\-to\-invoice cycle * Reduced duplicate data entry * Improved billing accuracy * Better job\-cost visibility * Improved estimating throughput * Faster management reporting * Improved accounts receivable processes * Reduced dependence on paper * Successful adoption of new systems across the organization Why Join Eclipse? This is a rare opportunity to have significant influence over the future of an established company. You will not be joining a massive corporate IT department where you own one small piece of a system. You will have direct access to company ownership and the ability to rethink how an entire organization operates. For the right person, this is an opportunity to build the technology and operational infrastructure that will support Eclipse’s next stage of growth. Compensation: $150,000–$190,000 annually, depending on experience, plus performance\-based bonus. Job Type: Full\-time Work Location: Southern California / On\-site Because understanding our field and office operations is critical to this position, this is primarily an on\-site role. Pay: $150,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Energy Project Coordinator
jobs.description: Do you have an eye for detail? Do you pride yourself on your ability to prioritize and coordinate several moving pieces? Do you thrive in a dynamic, collaborative environment? You're in the right place! We are hiring an **Energy Project Coordinator** to join our team serving Energy Trust of Oregon's Industry \& Ag customers. **Key Details:** * **Location:** Onboarding is 100% onsite in Portland; flexibility for a hybrid work arrangement may be available once fully onboarded. Relocation assistance is provided. * **Pay:** Full base pay range is $75,000 \- $88,000 commensurate with skills and experience. Our target hiring range is at or below mid\-point to allow for growth and internal equity. All positions are eligible for an annual bonus and profit share on top of base pay. * **Benefits:** Health, dental, vision, disability, FSA or HSA option, 401K with 4% match and profit sharing, annual cash performance bonus, paid vacation, paid sick time, paid floating holidays, parental leave, wellness reimbursement, home office stipend, and first\-time homebuyers assistance. * **Schedule:** Full time; 40 hours per week; Monday\-Friday **About Energy 350:** The future is bright at Energy 350! We are an energy efficiency consulting firm located in Portland, OR. Energy 350 is a leader in energy efficiency programs, policy, research, evaluation, and engineering. At Energy 350, we care about our employees and prioritize a balanced work lifestyle. We look for fast learners who are highly motivated and mission driven to join us in our casual yet hard working environment where we value people for who they are and for their differences. **Position Overview:** As an Energy Project Coordinator, you will serve as the quality control point between industrial customers, vendors, engineers, account managers, and our client. The Energy Project Coordinator reviews energy efficiency project applications and project deliverables to ensure forms and Excel\-based tools are filled out completely and correctly, reports are grammatically sound, error\-free, and formatting meets client's expectations. The Energy Project Coordinator is responsible for troubleshooting any missing or inaccurate data on project forms and materials; this requires proactive phone and email communications with industrial customers, vendors, account managers, and engineers. The Energy Project Coordinator submits all project deliverables to our client through various channels and software programs, and inputs project data into project tracking and CRM systems at various project milestones. Additionally, the Energy Project Coordinator is responsible for monitoring phone lines, message lines, and email accounts and distributing customer inquiries in a timely matter. The Energy Project Coordinator position requires someone who is detail\-oriented, organized, and skilled at prioritizing varied tasks. **A typical day may include:** * Communicating with our client, customers, vendors, account managers, and engineers via phone, email, Microsoft Teams, and in\-person. * Communicating with customers and vendors regarding project specifications or missing information. * Inputting data into our internal project tracking system as well as our client's project tracking and customer relationship management (CRM) systems at each project stage, including: adding new project information, linking sites/accounts/contacts, creating and updating forecasts, generating project tracking codes, uploading documents, and queuing payments. * Regularly navigating Excel\-based tools to track project and application details. * Reviewing project documents and deliverables to ensure they are complete, accurate, grammatically sound, and correctly formatted, and communicating needed clarifications to move the project forward. * Managing project dates and reaching out to customers, contractors, and account managers to communicate approaching deadlines and project statuses. * QCing data to ensure project information is accurate and up\-to\-date. * Other duties as assigned. **Qualifications:** We are looking for a detail\-oriented and organized candidate with a wide range of skills including excellent communication, emotional intelligence, excellent computer skills, and an interest in the energy efficiency industry. Ideal candidates will have the following skills and experience: * Previous experience, proficiency, and interest in data entry and data processing across multiple software platforms. * Experience copy\-editing technical reports; excellent grammar and written communication skills. * Excellent customer service skills \- ability to actively listen, communicate clearly and concisely, and maintain respect and courtesy. * Proficient in MS Excel; ability to QC basic functions in spreadsheets. * Proficient in MS Word; ability to QC basic formatting in documents. * Proficiency in CRM databases such as Salesforce. * Basic understanding of energy efficient equipment upgrades and understanding of common equipment specifications, or the interest and ability to learn industrial equipment. * Proficiency in mathematics \- ability to interpret percentages, fractions, decimals, and units of measurement. * Basic understanding of engineering units of measure, including: tons, kW, kWh, therms, btu, square feet, cubic feet, gpm, bhp, and hp. * Adept at performing detail\-oriented tasks, demonstrating accuracy and thoroughness. * High school degree required; Additional degree is preferred. *Energy 350 is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.*

jobs.title: Junior Data Scientist
jobs.description: Company Overview: At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry\-leading solutions and services. jobs.title: Senior Detection & Response Engineer
jobs.description: You're the detection engineer people turn to when they ask "what does Microsoft actually see here?" Not the marketing\-slide answer, the real map. Which product emits which telemetry, any anticipated ingestion lags, what table or API it lands in, which license tier gates it, how long it survives before it ages out, and where the documentation quietly disagrees with reality. When a new technique drops, your first instinct is to ask which Microsoft signal would catch it, and whether customers have it switched on. You also know Microsoft never sits still. Hunting tables appear, columns get renamed, Graph versions retire, capability shuffles between SKUs, previews go GA, features quietly vanish, and native alert logic shifts underneath you. You've got a repeatable way of staying ahead of that churn instead of finding out when a detection stops firing. You're comfortable behind a command line and in front of a customer, including scenarios where the conversation isn't pleasant. If that's you, we'd love to talk! We have an amazing team and believe you'll love getting to know us. At Expel, we help businesses bridge the cybersecurity talent gap by providing transparent Managed Detection and Response. To do this we build technology to make sure our security analysts are solving important problems, and automation is helping them make better decisions at every step. We delight in using technology to make security accessible for our customers. **What Expel can do for you** ----------------------------- * Make you one of our recognized authorities on Microsoft detection and response — for our SOC, our engineers, our go\-to\-market teams, and our customers * Give you real ownership of Expel's detection coverage across the whole Microsoft security estate * Put Microsoft telemetry from across our customer base in front of you — a breadth of real\-world environments no single enterprise gets to see * Let you write and tune detections in our own rule engine and watch them run against live signal * Treat AI tooling (Claude Code and friends) as a first\-class part of how you work, not a side experiment * Enable you to learn from analysts, data scientists, engineers, and responders responsible for various components of Expel's product and services * Provide access to popular EDR, network, SIEM, identity, and cloud technologies well beyond the Microsoft stack * Challenge you to push the boundaries of our security vision **What you can do for Expel** ----------------------------- * Own our detection coverage across Defender XDR, Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, Azure, and Microsoft 365 — from raw signal through to shipped, tuned detections * Build and maintain a living map of Microsoft security signal: what exists, known ingestion lag, where it lands, what gates it, how long it's kept, and how far you can trust it * Track how that signal changes and turn every material change into a concrete action — catching drift before it costs us efficacy * Tell us where Microsoft's native detections are strong enough to lean on, where they're noisy or shallow, and where Expel needs its own layer * Make SOC analysts faster by automating Microsoft\-specific investigative workflows against the Graph, Defender, Sentinel, and Entra APIs * Partner with Engineering on our Microsoft integrations — ingestion, API limits and throttling, and schema mapping * Answer the hard questions from the SOC, CS, and Sales — and mentor the people asking them * Help customers understand what they're actually covered for, what they're missing, and what turning it on would buy them **What you should bring with you** ---------------------------------- * Deep, current, hands\-on knowledge of the Microsoft security stack — Defender XDR (Endpoint, Identity, Office 365, Cloud Apps), Entra ID, Sentinel, Microsoft Graph, and the Azure and Microsoft 365 control and data planes * Fluency in KQL: you can write, read, optimize, and debug non\-trivial hunting queries across both Defender Advanced Hunting and Sentinel, and you know how and why the two schemas differ * Working knowledge of the Graph and Graph Security APIs, the Defender and Sentinel APIs, and their authentication, permission, versioning, and throttling models * A strong grasp of the Entra ID (and legacy Active Directory) identity attack surface — authentication flows, conditional access, OAuth application consent, token theft and replay, hybrid identity and sync, privileged role abuse — and the telemetry each produces * Solid understanding of Windows internals and command line tooling, with enough macOS and Linux to keep up with Defender's cross\-platform coverage * Experience writing, deploying, and tuning custom detections against Microsoft data sets, plus enough non\-Microsoft exposure (AWS, GCP, other EDR and SIEM) to keep perspective * Proficiency with Python and Sigma, and real fluency using Anthropic tools such as Claude Code to work across systems and data (locally, via MCP, and so on) * 5\+ years in information technology or security operations, with substantial time spent defending or operating Microsoft environments * Excellent tact and diplomacy skills — you can explain Microsoft's limits to an audience that doesn't want to hear about them * SC\-200, AZ\-500, or SC\-300 are a plus; demonstrated depth matters considerably more **Work Location** ----------------- Our headquarters is in Herndon, Virginia. However, we realize that while there is a benefit to in\-person interaction, good people don't all live in Northern Virginia. Remote work is an option for this role. **Additional Notes** -------------------- The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD \+ bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long\-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $160,000 and $192,000 based on experience, skills, and market data. We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You'll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits. We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas. We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You'll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability. We'll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind. \#LI\-Remote

Work Environment: At Exponent, we have found that in\-person interactions deepen employee engagement and are crucial for development, for realizing the full potential of our talented and diverse teams, and for building a more inclusive workplace where all have a sense of belonging. In our offices, you can expect a supportive culture and a collaborative, dynamic, multi\-disciplinary work environment. Our consultants engage in\-person in the office unless they are traveling for client work or other business activities. We value the rich lives our colleagues enjoy outside of work and understand that work/life balance is critical to our employees and their well\-being. Consultants have the autonomy to balance their work and personal schedules so you can meet with clients, visit inspection sites, attend conferences, and make time for priorities outside of work, too. It is this flexible, agile work style and working hours that allow our teams to drive innovation and results in their own ways, while meeting the needs of clients. \#LI\-Onsite Compensation: Our consultants are rewarded for their technical and business contributions and have an opportunity to plan for future success and career growth. Exponent's total compensation plan is consistent with its expectations of the quality and quantity of work performed and with the professional standards set by Exponent. At the Associate and Senior Associate level, total compensation includes base salary, bi\-weekly bonuses for high\-intensity efforts, annual bonus and 401(k) employer contribution of 7% of base salary. The base salary range for this position is dependent on experience and capabilities which will be assessed during the interview process. Benefits you will enjoy: Access benefits information on our Life@Exponent page: https://www.exponent.com/careers/life\-exponent Exponent is a proud equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status. jobs.title: Sr. AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Fieldpiece** is a privately held, global leader in professional HVACR tools and test instruments. We're known for developing innovative products that technicians rely on every day \- and for investing in our people, our technology, and our future. Named***one of the Best Places to Work in Southern California for four consecutive years***, we're looking for talented people who want to make an impact while growing their careers. We're looking for a **Senior AI Engineer** to help us turn the potential of AI into practical solutions that help teams to increase their efficiency, speed, and accuracy in their everyday jobs. This is a unique opportunity to become our first dedicated AI engineering hire and help shape how AI and automation are used across the organization. You'll partner with teams throughout the business—from Sales, Marketing, Finance, and HR to Product Development, Supply Chain, Operations, Customer Experience, and IT—to understand how they work, identify opportunities for improvement, and build solutions that deliver measurable value. This position is in our Orange, CA office with an exciting move to Tustin, CA in 2028\. This role follows a hybrid work schedule, with employees typically working onsite three days per week. Additional in\-office days may be required from time to time for onboarding, training, team meetings, project collaboration, or other business needs.**Why This Role?*** This isn't a role where you'll spend your time simply evaluating AI tools or developing proofs of concept that never make it into production. You'll sit down with business teams, understand what they're trying to accomplish and where their processes are slowing them down, translate those needs into technical requirements, determine the right solution, and then build, deploy, and improve it. * The projects will vary widely. One may involve automating a manual workflow; another could involve creating an AI agent, improving access to company knowledge, connecting AI to an enterprise system, or building a decision\-support application. The common thread is using technology to solve meaningful business problems. * We're technology agnostic and want someone who can choose the right solution for the problem rather than force every problem into the same technology stack. That said, experience within the Microsoft ecosystem—particularly Dynamics 365 Business Central, Azure, Copilot, Power Platform, Fabric, Dataverse, and Microsoft 365—is highly valuable in our environment. **What You'll Do*** Partner with teams across Fieldpiece to understand their workflows, pain points, and business needs and identify opportunities where AI, automation, or better technology can make a meaningful difference. * Take business requirements from concept to solution—designing, developing, implementing, and supporting production\-ready applications and automations. * Build AI agents, copilots, workflow automations, decision\-support tools, and other practical AI\-enabled solutions. * Develop applications using large language models, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise knowledge systems, APIs, and agentic workflows. * Connect AI solutions with ERP, CRM, PLM, customer support, analytics, knowledge management, productivity, and other enterprise platforms. * Reengineer processes to improve speed, accuracy, quality, service, cost, revenue enablement, and employee productivity. * Establish testing and evaluation approaches to ensure solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, scalable, and effective. * Work closely with Information Systems, business leaders, data owners, and security stakeholders to implement appropriate governance and controls. * Help users successfully adopt new AI tools and continuously improve solutions based on feedback and results. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and make practical recommendations based on business value, implementation requirements, cost, risk, and scalability. * Bachelor’s degree in CS, AI, or related fields. * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including ownership of production applications. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building solutions using modern AI technologies, including large language models. * Experience taking ambiguous business jobs.title: IS Onsite Engineer

With pump installations in 145 countries, Peerless is globally recognized for engineering tough, reliable, and versatile pump solutions with extensive flow and pressure capabilities. From our production facilities in Indianapolis and Houston to our service centers in Lubbock and Fresno, Peerless pumps are designed to protect people and property from fire and to bring water where it’s needed most. Our product quality is second to none, but it’s our people who’ve made us Peerless for over 100years. Our legacy of innovation is fueled by attracting, training, and retaining employees from diverse backgrounds. With competitive benefits and a strong emphasis on development, growth, and innovation, Peerless employees come seeking a job but stay to build a career. Are you passionate about ensuring product quality through precision measurement and hands\-on problem solving? Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people. ***Are you passionate about being the go\-to IT expert who keeps a local team connected, productive, and secure?*** Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people. As our new **IS Onsite Engineer**, you will be delivering hands\-on IT support and hardware lifecycle management for a local Grundfos office \[Peerless Pump], ensuring employees have the tools and services they need to succeed. CompTIA A\+, MCDST, MD\-102, CNCI, AZ\-104 ***It is a plus if you also:*** * Experience with IT asset lifecycle management and procurement processes * Familiarity with IT security best practices and end\-user training delivery * Experience working in a global IT organization with remote reporting structures * Veterans with related technical MOS experience are strongly encouraged to apply. \*much preferred **Why you will love working here** We care! Apply today!*** To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or visit ***grundfos.com*** ***Relocation for this position cannot be supported and qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Sponsorship is not available for applicants for US Work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H\-1B, L\-1, TN, O\-1, E\-3, H\-1B1, F\-1, J\-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment\-based visa.*** The salary range for this position is $59,800\-$79,365 (exempt). Individual pay will be determined based on market location and the candidate’s profile. The range listed is just one component of Peerless Grundfos’s total compensation and benefits package for employees. Total compensation includes paid time off, paid holidays, merit increases, bonuses, and employee stock purchase programs, etc. Peerless Grundfos salary rates are benchmarked and reflect the target for new hire salaries for the position in Indianapolis, Indiana. ***Peerless Grundfos participates in E\-verify and is an Affirmative Action, Equal Opportunity Employer. All positions subject to post offer drug screening and background checks.*** Peerless needs and welcomes professional people from all corners and backgrounds by providing equal employment opportunities for all applicants and employees and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. Employment decisions at Peerless and Grundfos are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. jobs.title: Data Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **About Hazel** --------------- Hazel is the AI coworker for consumer brands. We connect to a brand's live data — Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon, Meta, and dozens of others — and turn it into a teammate operators talk to every day. Ask "why did repeat purchase rate drop last week?" and 10 seconds later you get an answer, cited from live data. Hazel also takes action herself, proactively flagging issues and making changes directly in Shopify and the other systems she connects to, on the way to running full playbooks autonomously. We’ve raised more than $2M, are rapidly scaling and serving some of the biggest consumer brands including Bogg Bag, Ultra, and OneSkin. **Why this role exists** ------------------------ Hazel’s intelligence is built on top of a data warehouse meticulously tailored for consumer brands. We’re moving a massive amount of data and the owner of this layer plays a direct part in how users interact with Hazel Our data layer is tens of terabytes of data and thousands of data tables, and customers expect perfect sync reliability, new integrations to be built in days, and for every question Hazel asks to be correctly grounded in data. **The stack** ------------- Experience with our stack is a bonus, but similar experience working on problems at our scale is required: * dbt * Temporal * dltHub * Duckdb / Motherduck * Dagster **What you'll do** ------------------ You own the data platform end to end — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and the reliability of all three. As importantly, you’ll need to further develop our existing AI agents that write, build, and test new integrations end\-to\-end. Automating your job is the only way you will scale it. **Beyond that you’ll:** * Own data platform reliability as we scale * Optimize ingestion pipelines for low\-latency data availability, ensuring consistent performance during peak seasonal surges. * Build our data transformation layer so Hazel has clean, predictable data to work with. * Automate your own job, especially the data integrations and transformations * Ship new source integrations end to end **Who we're looking for** ------------------------- * 4\+ years building production data infrastructure, with real ownership of a warehouse someone else depended on. * Deep understanding of dbt and SQL. You have opinions about grain, incrementality, and data modeling. * Strong Python. Our ingestion layer is code you'll be writing, not a UI you'll be clicking. * You've owned an orchestrator in production — Dagster, Airflow, Temporal, Prefect, whatever es. * AI\-native in practice. You use coding agents to do the work of a much larger team, and you can tell us where they helped and where they made things worse. * You write documentation well, because here it's a feature. * Comfortable being the only person who does this job, and equally comfortable making sure that stops being true. Nice to have: Experience with open table formats, e\-commerce/DTC data (Shopify, Klaviyo, Amazon SP\-API, ad platforms), and designing multi\-tenant warehouses. **Comp \& benefits** -------------------- * $155–200K base * 0\.15–0\.25% equity * Top\-tier health, dental, vision * 401(k) * Unlimited PTO * Hybrid in NYC **How we hire** --------------- * 15\-min intro * Founder call * Systems design and case study * Onsite Compensation Range: $155K \- $200K

jobs.description: Overview: **Grow with us!** HCI Systems, Inc. is seeking a results\-driven, enthusiastic sales professional to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will sell enterprise\-level integrated fire life safety/low voltage solutions with a focus on new construction and build strong relationships with end\-users, electrical contractors and general contractors. You will have the opportunity to prospect and cultivate new relationships, gain an understanding of our clients' needs, and secure sales opportunities. **About Us:** HCI Systems, Inc. is a renowned leader in the fire life safety and low voltage industry, providing our clients with an end\-to\-end service offering that allows them to bundle all their needs under one provider. Responsibilities: * Drive business growth by prospecting and cultivating new relationships and identifying and educating prospective customers about HCI's products and services. * Be responsible for identifying customer needs and developing strategies to meet company sales objectives. * Lead the sales process from proposal development to closing, including crafting comprehensive scopes of work, managing project scope communication, and handling change order costs. * Serve as the primary contact for clients, ensuring strong partnerships are established and maintained before, during, and after the sales process. Oversee all aspects of customer accounts, including managing active accounts and fostering sales growth. * Collaborate with premier partners in vertical markets, such as transportation, global/enterprise accounts, utilities, financial/banking, healthcare, datacenters, federal, state, and local governments, and K\-12 \& higher education. * Develop business opportunities by conducting needs assessments and constructing winning proposals for system installation and service opportunities. * Develop financial justifications, perform takeoffs, prepare estimates and proposals, make presentations, and perform the necessary follow\-up for a successful closing of the sale. * Build market awareness through networking, presentations, event attendance, and participation in industry associations. * Partner with operations personnel to execute growth, development, sales, and marketing strategies. * Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within schedule. Qualifications: * Associate degree or equivalent experience required; bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or engineering preferred. * Minimum 3\-5 years of demonstrated successful consultative sales experience within the fire life safety, electronics, general construction, or electrical construction industry. * Comprehensive industry knowledge in Fire Alarm, Nurse Call or Special Hazards Suppression Systems, Security or other related low voltage systems. * Ability to quickly identify and qualify opportunities, as well as handle complex, large\-scale accounts and high\-value contracts. * Experience working with electrical contractors, general contractors, consultants, engineers or end users, with the ability to read construction blueprints and wiring diagrams. * High degree of self\-discipline and ability to prioritize and meet deadlines in a fast\-paced corporate environment. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, using tact and diplomacy when dealing with customers. * Must be reliable, self\-motivated, success\-driven, with excellent organizational, negotiating and follow\-up skills. * Proficiency in industry\-related equipment including Windows, MS Office, and customer relationship management (CRM) software. * Applicants must meet requirements in relation to background, have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record. * Regular, reliable, predictable attendance. ***\*\*compensation range includes potential commissions earned on sales\*\**** HCI Systems Inc. is a licensed C\-7, C\-10 and C\-16 low voltage systems integration contractor offering a full spectrum of services including sales, engineering, installation, service, and maintenance with over 600 employees in our seven branches. We offer fire life safety, fire suppression, fire sprinkler, access control, video management, intrusion detection, structured cable, nurse call and other related electronic detection solutions to our customers. **Why Join Us?*** **Unlimited Growth** – Our expanding product lines and markets drive consistent double\-digit growth, creating ongoing opportunities for advancement. * **Comprehensive Benefits** – Enjoy 401(k) with matching, reduced\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible spending accounts. Additional voluntary benefits include life insurance, disability, and accident coverage. * **Paid Time Off** – Recharge with paid holidays and our PTO plan * **Weekly Pay** – Get paid every Friday. * **Employee Perks** – From appreciation events and department outings to wellness programs and pet insurance, we invest in our team’s well\-being. **E*****qual Employment Opportunity****HCI is an equal opportunity employer. We will not unlawfully discriminate against qualified applicants or employees with respect to any terms and conditions of employment and give equal opportunity considerations to applicants and employees regardless of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, related medical conditions and lactation), gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, disability, protected medical condition as defined by applicable state or local law, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances (“Protected Classifications”). HCI will reasonably accommodate employees and applicants with disabilities as required by law, if the person is otherwise qualified to perform all the essential functions of the position safely and competently.* Pay Range: USD $60,000\.00 \- USD $300,000\.00 /Yr.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Coding
jobs.description: **About Handshake** =================== Handshake was founded on a simple belief that everyone deserves a path to a great career, regardless of where they went to school or who they know. Today, we power 25 million job seekers, 1 million\+ employers, and 1,600 educational institutions. In 2025, we started Handshake AI and built the fastest\-growing AI data business in history. We work directly with frontier AI lab researchers to create evaluations, publish benchmarks, and push the boundary of data. We’ve grown from $0 to \~$1B run rate and pay \~$60M to over 30K individuals every month. **Why join Handshake now:** * Shape how every career evolves in the AI economy, at global scale, with impact your friends, family and peers can see and feel * Partner hand\-in\-hand with world\-class AI labs, Fortune 500 partners and the world’s top educational institutions * Work together with engineers, scientists, operators, and more from Palantir, Meta, Scale AI, and former YC founders * Build a massive, fast\-growing business with billions in revenue **About Handshake AI** Human data is the core infrastructure to AI advancement. Frontier AI labs currently improve model capabilities with various data\-intensive post\-training techniques. We believe that data spend for AI training will increase by 3\-5x in the next few years and continue for much longer as models take on new domains. Handshake AI supports all of the frontier AI labs, working on their most complex data at the largest scale. **About the Role** ================== We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to help build the systems that power high\-quality coding data and evaluations for next\-generation AI models. You’ll work on technically complex projects involving software engineering benchmarks, code review evaluation, agentic coding workflows, and developer\-facing tools. You’ll combine strong engineering judgment with hands\-on execution, designing reliable systems that enable teams to create, validate, and improve sophisticated coding datasets. This is an opportunity to shape foundational infrastructure at the intersection of software development and AI. You’ll operate with significant ownership, collaborate closely with engineers and technical program leaders, and help establish the standards and tools that support our fastest\-growing AI initiatives. **What You'll Do** ================== * Design, build, and operate scalable software systems for coding evaluation, data generation, and agentic development workflows. * Develop tools and services that analyze, validate, and improve AI\-generated code. * Build reliable pipelines for code execution, testing, benchmarking, and quality measurement. * Partner with engineering, research, operations, and customer\-facing teams to translate complex requirements into practical systems. * Drive technical decisions across architecture, APIs, data models, observability, and operational excellence. * Improve engineering velocity through reusable frameworks, automation, and developer tooling. * Lead projects from ambiguous problem definition through design, implementation, launch, and iteration. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and day\-to\-day collaboration. * Establish high standards for maintainability, correctness, security, and reliability. **Desired Capabilities** ======================== * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience. * Strong proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, or another modern programming language. * Experience designing and operating production systems with meaningful scale, reliability, and performance requirements. * Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals, including testing, APIs, data structures, distributed systems, and observability. * Experience building developer tools, infrastructure, data pipelines, evaluation systems, or other technically complex products. * Ability to work effectively in ambiguous environments and break large problems into clear, executable plans. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical partners. * A track record of taking ownership and delivering high\-quality results in collaboration with **Bonus Points** ================ * Experience with AI/ML evaluation, coding agents, LLM applications, or developer productivity tools. * Familiarity with code execution sandboxes, GitHub workflows, CI/CD systems, or benchmark infrastructure. * Experience working with containerization, cloud platforms, databases, and distributed job orchestration. * Contributions to open\-source software or a demonstrated passion for improving developer tools. * Experience partnering with research teams or customers to deliver technically rigorous solutions. **Perks** ========= Handshake delivers benefits that help you feel supported—and thrive at work and in life. The below benefits are for full\-time US employees. **Ownership:** Equity in a fast\-growing company **Financial Wellness:** 401(k) match, competitive compensation, financial coaching **Family Support:** Paid parental leave, fertility benefits, parental coaching **Wellbeing:** Medical, dental, and vision, mental health support, wellness stipend **Growth:** Learning stipend, ongoing development **Remote \& Office:** Internet, commuting, and free lunch/gym in our SF office **Time Off:** Flexible PTO, 15 holidays \+ 2 flex days **Connection:** Team outings \& referral bonuses Explore our mission, values, and comprehensive US benefits at **joinhandshake.com/careers**. Compensation Range: $208K \- $260K

jobs.title: Advanced Software Engineer
jobs.description: As an **Advanced Software Engineer** here at Honeywell Aerospace, you will be responsible for a variety of professional\-level engineering responsibilities and requires the application of advanced knowledge of software engineering disciplines, processes, and tools to execute project subtasks and ensure compliance with technical, quality, and customer requirements. You will contribute to the design, development, integration, verification, and release of software features for Avionics Displays systems, algorithms, and software frameworks. This position plays an important role in delivering products that meet customer specifications, certification requirements, and organizational quality standards. The role also involves regular interaction with internal stakeholders and external customers to support project execution and product compliance. This Advanced Software Engineer is recognized as an emerging authority within Integrated Flight Deck Systems COE and is expected to help define and improve engineering processes, recommend enhancements to technical methods, and mentor early\-career engineers. The ideal candidate demonstrates strong technical depth, independent problem\-solving ability, and the capability to lead feature decomposition, coordinate development activities, and support programs execution. You will directly impact product delivery by executing engineering subtasks, identifying technical improvements, driving feature implementation, and supporting the successful completion of customer\-driven software solutions. You will report directly to our Sr Software Engineering Manager and you’ll work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on a hybrid work schedule. Note: For the first 90 days, New Hires must be prepared to work 100% onsite M\-F. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Plan and execute software engineering activities to meet technical, quality, schedule, certification, and customer requirements. * Analyze, develop, and manage software and system requirements, feature implementation, and technical coordination across development activities. * Design, develop, integrate, maintain, test, debug, and verify avionics display software, algorithms, and application/framework\-level functionality. * Support software build, integration, release, and delivery activities while ensuring compliance with product, project, and certification requirements. * Collaborate with cross\-functional engineering, quality, certification, program management, and customer teams to support product development and customer acceptance. * Communicate technical progress, project status, risks, compliance findings, and corrective actions to stakeholders, leadership, and customers. * Drive continuous improvement of engineering processes, methods, and product quality, while providing technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to engineers.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical/Robotics Engineering Consultant
jobs.description: **Principal Mechanical \& Robotics Engineering Consultant** **About Infratek** Infratek is a technology company developing advanced systems for inspecting and maintaining critical infrastructure, including bridges, roadways, and other structures as well as assistive robotics systems for on\-demand and accessible mobility. We design, integrate, and manufacture autonomous robotic platforms, non\-destructive evaluation technologies, and supporting software systems. **The Opportunity** Infratek is seeking a highly experienced Mechanical and Robotics Engineering Consultant to serve as a senior technical advisor to our engineering team. This is not an entry\-level or early\-career position. We are looking for a seasoned engineering professional with extensive, hands\-on industry experience developing complex robotic, electromechanical, or automated machinery. The ideal consultant has taken multiple systems from concept through detailed design, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, deployment, and field support. You will help our team solve difficult engineering problems, conduct rigorous design reviews, identify technical risks, troubleshoot failures, and make sound engineering decisions. You should be equally comfortable reviewing calculations and drawings, working directly with hardware, and mentoring engineers. **Responsibilities** * Serve as a senior technical authority for robotic mechanical systems and subsystems. * Lead and participate in mechanical design reviews, architecture reviews, failure investigations, and technical risk assessments. * Help the engineering team solve complex problems involving mechanisms, structures, actuators, motors, sensors, pneumatics, hydraulics, and other electromechanical components. * Review designs, calculations, simulations, engineering drawings, specifications, bills of materials, test plans, and manufacturing documentation. * Evaluate system architecture and component selections for performance, reliability, safety, manufacturability, maintainability, and cost. * Guide the transition of research prototypes into robust, repeatable, field\-ready commercial products. * Support mechanism design, structural analysis, dynamics, vibration analysis, tolerance analysis, thermal considerations, materials selection, and failure analysis. * Conduct root\-cause investigations and recommend practical corrective actions. * Provide guidance on design for manufacturing and assembly, supplier capabilities, fabrication processes, and production readiness. * Work closely with mechanical, electrical, controls, and software engineers to ensure effective system integration. * Participate in hands\-on assembly, testing, troubleshooting, and evaluation when required. * Mentor team members and help establish disciplined engineering practices, design\-review processes, and documentation standards. * Maintain high standards of engineering judgment, professional ethics, safety, and attention to detail. **Required Experience and Qualifications** * At least 15 years of relevant professional engineering experience, including substantial experience with robotics, automation, industrial machinery, or complex electromechanical systems. (10 years may be acceptable in case of noteworthy achievements) * A demonstrated record of successfully delivering multiple physical products or robotic systems from concept through deployment. * Deep practical expertise in mechanical engineering fundamentals, including machine design, mechanisms, materials, structural analysis, dynamics, vibration, fatigue, tolerancing, and failure analysis. * Extensive experience integrating actuators, motors, transmissions, bearings, sensors, pneumatics, hydraulics, and fabricated or machined components. * Strong command of GD\&T, tolerance analysis, design for manufacturing and assembly, engineering drawings, and configuration control. * Experience performing or critically reviewing FEA and other quantitative engineering analyses. * Strong proficiency with SolidWorks or a comparable professional 3D CAD platform. * Experience diagnosing difficult field, prototype, or production failures using structured root\-cause methods. * Sound engineering judgment and the ability to identify risks that may not be apparent through analysis alone. * Ability to communicate complex technical matters clearly and provide direct, constructive feedback. * Experience mentoring engineers and working effectively with multidisciplinary teams. * Willingness to engage directly with hardware and testing—not solely provide high\-level advice. A bachelor’s degree in mechanical or robotics engineering or a closely related field is preferred. Equivalent experience may also be considered. Advanced academic credentials are welcome, but they are not a substitute for extensive hands\-on industry experience and a demonstrated record of delivering real\-world systems. **Preferred Experience** * Experience designing mobile robots, autonomous systems, industrial automation, or other complex electromechanical systems. * Experience developing safety\-critical machinery that operates near people, vehicles, equipment, or public infrastructure. * Strong understanding of robotic mechanical architecture, including drivetrains, steering, suspension, braking, stability, actuation, and precision positioning. * Experience designing rugged equipment for outdoor, industrial, or otherwise demanding operating environments. * Experience integrating mechanical systems with motors, actuators, sensors, batteries, controls, communications, and autonomous\-navigation hardware. * Experience conducting hazard analyses, design risk assessments, FMEA, fault\-tree analysis, and formal engineering design reviews. * Experience designing load\-bearing, lifting, positioning, or material\-handling mechanisms with appropriate safety factors and fail\-safe features. * Experience developing verification and validation programs, including structural, proof\-load, fatigue, vibration, stability, environmental, reliability, misuse, and fault\-condition testing. * Experience transitioning research prototypes or first\-generation designs into reliable, maintainable, and manufacturable commercial products. * Familiarity with low\-volume manufacturing, supplier qualification, fabrication methods, assembly processes, quality control, and production readiness. * Experience troubleshooting difficult prototype, field, or production failures and leading structured root\-cause investigations. * Working knowledge of electrical systems, controls, embedded systems, or robotics software sufficient to support multidisciplinary system integration. * Experience mentoring engineering teams and serving as a technical reviewer or design authority. * Experience working with customers, manufacturers, regulatory organizations, testing laboratories, or other external technical stakeholders. **Engagement** * Consulting or contract engagement, with the scope and schedule determined by project needs. * Fully remote (continental US) with on\-site participation required for selected design reviews, hardware evaluations, and testing activities. * Longer\-term or expanded engagement may be considered based on mutual fit and company needs. **What Success Looks Like** The successful consultant will quickly earn the confidence of the engineering team, improve the quality of critical technical decisions, identify problems before they reach the field, and help transform promising prototypes into safe, reliable, and manufacturable commercial products. Job Type: Contract Application Question(s): * Describe two or three robotic systems that you personally helped bring into production. What was your exact technical contribution, and describe a difficult failure that you diagnosed? Experience: * Mechanical or Robotics Engineering: 10 years (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in New Hope, PA 18938

jobs.title: Senior Staff Product Manager, Small Business Health
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ **Join our mission** Intuit is a global technology platform company that helps our customers and communities overcome their most important financial challenges. We help give over 50 million consumers, small business, and self\-employed customers around the world the opportunity to prosper. **The Mission** Small businesses fuel the global economy. In the US alone, they employ 60% of the workforce and create 80% of new jobs. Yet, the odds are stacked against them: one in two fails within five years. At Quickbooks, we are just building software; we are increasing the survival rate for the entrepreneurs who are the backbone of our economy. **The Opportunity** Many small businesses start from an entrepreneur’s passion for their craft \- usually a product or service \- and a desire to share their craft with the world. Almost by definition these new entrepreneurs are not experts on starting or scaling a business, and Quickbooks has helped many millions of businesses every year launch, scale, and thrive. Easy access to capital, and strategically applying funds to accelerate growth or bridge rocky cashflows, has an outsized impact on a business’s prospect. Yet access to capital is still a highly opaque, anxious process for most customers and overwhelmingly they avoid exploring financing options due to fears of rejection, qualifying less money than they actually need, or taking far more time than they believe is worth spending to access funds. Quickbooks has a unique opportunity \- as a financial management platform and as a lender \- to help customers understand the business metrics that have an outsized impact on survivability and growth and the actions that they can take to meaningfully improve them. In the short term, this product will be focused on demystifying access to credit and providing customers with a path to improving their borrowing power and approval odds. In the longer term, we have the opportunity to provide an experience like Credit Karma, but for small businesses: genuinely useful, deeply personalized, and compelling enough that people come back on their own. We’re looking for a product leader with a track record of conceptualizing and scaling high\-engagement customer experiences that meaningfully affect customer outcomes. **Responsibilities** * Deeply understand our customers \- learn into the most compelling customer segments to serve through direct engagement with business owners of all stripes. Leverage research, quantitative, and qualitative data to build the foundation for this new product. * Own the strategy and execution for our Borrowing Power and Small Business Health roadmap – including designing, launching, and scaling experiences that delight and drive results for multiple customers segments * Define and drive the key metrics, including engagement, product attach rate, and improvements in customer health, that we use to evaluate the success of our products * Set the tempo for speed and experimentation \- leveraging AI to accelerate analyses, rapid prototyping and experimentation, and cross\-functional operations. **Qualifications** * Experience: 6\+ years in Product Management, building delightful, high\-engagement consumer\-facing products * Execution: You have a track record of high velocity and high quality, thoughtfully shipping incremental products en route to a generally available product that inflects the shape of the businesses. This role will entail vision, strategy, design, and more, but the foundation is a senior product leader who gets in the weeds and ships great work. * Strategy: Clear articulation of the customer segments and product solutions you will bring to market, in what order, and why. Ability to distill production metrics, market research, and customer insights into trusted takeaways that inform downstream decisions. * Sharp with data: You know what to measure, where the drop\-off is, and what to do about it. You use AI tools to move faster, not to replace your own judgment. * Executive communication: You can explain a complex strategy to a leadership audience in five minutes and dive into the nitty gritty with engineers, designers, analysts, and more. You are comfortable at multiple altitudes. **Why Join Us?** ---------------- * Impact at Scale: This product could become the financial compass for millions of small businesses – most of whom have never had anything like it. That’s not a small thing. * Build Something New: Greenfield product category, inside a platform with tens of millions of customers already on it. The infrastructure is there. The category isn’t built yet. * Culture: The bar is high, the customer impact is real, and the opportunity to innovate is at massive scale. And we have a good time while doing it. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position will be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: SF Bay Area \- $205,000 \- $278,000 The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $205,500 \- $278,000 San Francisco Howard Street, CA $205,500\- $278,000

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Email Editing, Fullstack
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Email Editing team owns the creative heart of Mailchimp: the editors millions of customers use to design, personalize, and publish email campaigns that reach hundreds of millions of inboxes. Our work spans the full stack, and then some: * A **modern, interactive email editor** — a rich React \+ TypeScript editing experience where customers visually compose, style, and preview their campaigns. * **Backend services** that validate content, apply brand styling, generate previews, and render customer designs into HTML that displays correctly across notoriously inconsistent email clients. * A **large\-scale web application** serving millions of users, where we modernize long\-lived product surfaces while keeping them reliable for the customers who depend on them every day. * **AI\-powered editing** — services that let customers edit their emails in natural language: "make the header blue and add a Summer Sale banner." "Fullstack" is not a buzzword here. In a given quarter you might evolve how email content is structured and stored, optimize the rendering pipeline, ship a new editing interaction in the visual canvas, and improve how our AI features manipulate customer designs — all in service of one editing experience. **Responsibilities** * Design, build, and operate features **end\-to\-end across the stack**: a rich frontend editing experience, backend content and rendering services, and AI\-powered capabilities. * Help set technical direction for how **customer email content is structured, validated, and versioned** — and evolve those formats without breaking millions of customers' saved campaigns and templates. * Own **rendering correctness**: turn customer designs into email HTML that renders reliably across Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail, and the long tail of email clients, while meeting performance and accessibility standards. * Shape our **AI editing capabilities**: design the interfaces between AI\-driven edits and customer content, and hold AI\-produced changes to the same quality bar as human\-authored ones. * Lead workstreams that **modernize legacy technology** — migrating customers and their saved content safely to newer experiences, shipped incrementally with controlled rollouts. * **Operate what you ship**: instrument services with logging, metrics, and tracing; participate in on\-call; and use observability data to keep quality high in production. * Build for **scale, accessibility, and compliance**: millions of users, WCAG accessibility standards, and awareness of email regulations such as GDPR and CAN\-SPAM. * **Multiply the team**: mentor engineers, write clear design documents, raise the bar in code review, and collaborate closely with design, product management, and partner teams across Mailchimp and Intuit. * Champion **responsible AI\-assisted development** — use modern AI tooling to move faster while establishing the practices that keep generated code reviewable and trustworthy. **Qualifications** ### **Required** * 8\+ years of professional software development experience (or equivalent demonstrated ability), including several years building and shipping production web applications at scale. * Hands\-on experience building **LLM\-powered product features**: working with agent frameworks, designing tools for AI systems, prompt design, or evaluation pipelines. * Deep expertise in **TypeScript/JavaScript and React**, including experience building complex, state\-heavy user interfaces (editors, canvases, design tools, or comparably interactive products). * Strong server\-side engineering experience in **at least one of Node.js, PHP, or Python** — and genuine willingness to work across more than one, since our stack spans several. * Experience **designing, operating, and debugging production APIs and services**, including instrumentation, monitoring, and incident response. * A track record of **staff\-level technical leadership**: driving initiatives that span multiple engineers or teams, decomposing large or ambiguous problems, and mentoring others. * Strong **testing discipline** across unit, integration, and end\-to\-end levels, and habits that keep large, long\-lived codebases healthy. * Excellent **written and verbal communication**, suited to a distributed team where design docs and async collaboration carry real weight. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, **or equivalent practical experience** — we care about what you can do, not the path you took to learn it. ### **Nice to have — none of these are required** * Experience with **HTML email rendering** and its constraints (email client quirks, templating frameworks, deliverability considerations). * Experience building **editors or document tooling**: rich\-text or visual editors, schema\-driven UIs, undo/redo systems, or collaborative editing. * Experience leading **legacy modernization** — incrementally replacing older frameworks or architectures in a system that must stay reliable throughout. * Familiarity with **high\-scale data and infrastructure**: large relational databases, caching, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipelines. * Depth in **web accessibility** (WCAG) beyond the basics. * Familiarity with **email and privacy regulations** (GDPR, CAN\-SPAM).
