jobs.title: Flight Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Flight Software Engineer** ### **About Intuitive Machines:** ### **Intuitive Machines is an innovative and cutting\-edge space company making cislunar space accessible to both public and private customers. Our mission is to further science and exploration, communications, and economic progress from the Earth to the Moon and beyond. With multiple NASA lunar missions in development and additional private missions on our manifest, we pride ourselves in supporting NASA, our customers, and the nation in paving the way to return humans to the surface of the Moon. Our world\-class team includes experts in all aspects of spacecraft subsystems design, development, and test, on\-orbit operations, and safety.** **About the Position:** Intuitive Machines is seeking a Flight Software Engineer to support the Landsat 10 mission under the OMES III contract at NASA Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, MD. This position requires hybrid on\-site support and the ability to obtain and maintain a NASA badge. The selected candidate will join a multidisciplinary flight software team responsible for the development, integration, test, verification, and sustainment of mission\-critical spacecraft flight software supporting one of NASA's flagship Earth observation missions. The successful candidate will participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements development through flight software delivery, integration, system testing, launch support, and on\-orbit operations. This position offers the opportunity to work alongside NASA civil servants, flight software developers, systems engineers, software assurance organizations, and spacecraft hardware teams in the development of highly reliable spaceflight systems. **Responsibilities:** * Design, develop, integrate, and test embedded flight software for spacecraft avionics systems. * Support all phases of the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture design, implementation, unit testing, integration, verification, validation, and maintenance. * Develop software for real\-time spacecraft applications operating on embedded processors and flight\-qualified operating systems. * Participate in software peer reviews, design reviews, and formal NASA lifecycle reviews. * Collaborate with hardware engineers, systems engineers, mission operations personnel, and software assurance teams. * Support software integration activities with spacecraft avionics and communications hardware. * Develop and maintain software documentation, test procedures, verification reports, and technical memoranda. * Investigate software anomalies and support troubleshooting efforts during integration and test activities. * Support Independent Verification \& Validation (IV\&V), Software Quality Assurance (SQA), and mission assurance activities. * Assist with flight software readiness assessments and mission operations support as required. **Required Qualifications \& Experience :** **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in computer engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline. **Experience** * 15\+ years of experience developing software for embedded or real\-time systems. * Familiarity with NPR 7150\.2 * Experience supporting the complete software development lifecycle from requirements through acceptance testing. * Experience developing software within structured engineering processes utilizing industry\-recognized standards. **Desired Qualifications** * Experience supporting NASA, DoD, NOAA, or commercial spaceflight programs. * Flight software development experience for spacecraft, instruments, or ground\-support systems. * Familiarity with software acquisition and government flight projects. * Experience using: * IBM DOORS or equivalent requirements management tools * TDMS or equivalent configuration/data management systems * Git, SVN, or other software configuration management tools * Experience leading small software development teams or technical task groups. * Knowledge of spacecraft command and data handling systems. * Experience supporting environmental testing, integration and test campaigns, or launch preparation activities. **Preferred Competencies** * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to work effectively in a collaborative NASA and contractor environment. * Self\-motivated with strong attention to detail and quality. * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced mission environment. ### **US EEO Statement:** ### **Intuitive Machines is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.**

jobs.title: On-Call - Senior Pipe Stress Engineer
jobs.description: OVERVIEW: Merrick is seeking an On\-Call **Senior Pipe Stress Engineer I** to join our Energy, Manufacturing \& Bioprocessing Business Unit. **This position will is located in our Greenwood Village, CO office. A hybrid work schedule may be supported, and fully remote candidates will be considered.** WHAT YOU'LL DO: * As an On\-Call Senior Pipe Stress Engineer with our Energy, Manufacturing \& Bioprocessing team, you will work in a dynamic multi\-discipline environment with other engineering and technical personnel to ensure overall project goals are met. * Performs and documents engineering calculations related to mechanical engineering for the purpose of selecting code compliant systems and equipment. * Ensures mechanical activities follow QA procedures. * Performs pipe stress analysis utilizing software such as CAESAR II, NozzlePro, etc. * Works with the project team to design a cohesive, technically acceptable, and optimized piping system. * Performs detailed reviews of piping isometrics, piping plans, pipe specifications, P\&IDs, pipe stress analysis completed by others and other design documents. * Mentor other mechanical engineers and designers. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related engineering field from ABET accredited program required. * **12\+ years industry experience.** * Experience with Design/Build and EPC projects. * Significant pipe stress analysis experience utilizing software such as CAESAR II. * Must have a valid driver's license, a good driving record, and be insurable under Merrick’s insurance carrier. * **Must be eligible to work in the United States without sponsorship.** DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS: * Significant experience with oil and gas, petrochemical, bioprocessing or power facility design. * Extensive design experience in piping engineering, pipe supports, equipment layouts and detailed piping design. * Knowledge of ASME B31\.3 and B31\.1, ASME Boiler \& Pressure Vessel codes, PIP and API codes. * Registered Professional Engineer ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: * Apply online only. jobs.title: Optical Process & Manufacturing Engineer - Lens Technical Lead
jobs.description: As an Optical \& Manufacturing Engineer at Reality Labs, you will own the development and productization of precision optical components, including ophthalmic\-grade optics, that are core to next\-generation AI and AR glasses. You will serve as the single point of accountability for optical components, from concept through prototype and validation to high\-volume production ramp, working alongside a team tackling radically new concepts driven by the constraints of advanced AI and AR glasses. You will establish new process and tooling capabilities with supply\-chain partners and release product sub\-systems that are fully hardened for high\-volume manufacturing. We are looking for engineers who work well across disciplines, who move fluidly between big\-picture ideas and the critical details that make a technology succeed, and who bring a data\-driven track record of taking products from concept to mass production. ### **Optical Process \& Manufacturing Engineer \- Lens Technical Lead Responsibilities:** * Own precision optical components from concept through prototype, validation, and high\-volume production ramp, as the single point of accountability for the outcome * Lead external vendor and supply\-chain collaborations spanning material selection, tooling, process optimization, metrology, and quality control * Develop and qualify ophthalmic manufacturing processes and the metrology used to verify optical components, including optical power, surface form, wavefront, and cosmetics * Define and qualify manufacturing processes and tooling, including precision molds, fixtures, and optical surface generation, to establish new process capability with partners * Drive mold design and mold flow analysis to optimize tool geometry, gating, and process windows for optical\-grade parts * Develop and qualify high\-precision lens cutting processes, including CNC machining, edging, and laser systems at scale * Troubleshoot optical and mechanical defects and run design of experiments (DOE) for root cause analysis and process improvement * Develop and integrate novel materials and fabrication processes such as lamination, optical surface generation, coating, casting, and injection molding to enable next\-generation optics and displays * Partner with cross\-functional teams to set program priorities and deliver product sub\-systems hardened for high\-volume manufacturing ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in Materials Science, Polymer Science, Optical Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 6\+ years of experience in manufacturing and process development of precision optical components for ophthalmic or consumer electronics * Experience with metrology of optical components, including optical power, surface form, wavefront, and cosmetic inspection, and with material and mechanical characterization * Experience with mold design and mold flow analysis * Experience with mold flow and fluid dynamics simulation software (e.g., Autodesk Moldflow, Moldex3D, or equivalent CFD tools) * Experience with precision tooling and manufacturing methods such as optical\-grade injection molding, casting in high\-volume manufacturing ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Ph.D. In Materials Science, Polymer Science, Optical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience in the optical plastics lens industry * 8\+ years of experience with optical materials and process engineering lens manufacturing * Experience with sequential ray tracing, optical simulation, and tolerancing using Zemax or Code V * Experience with DOE design and data analysis for problem solving and root cause analysis * Experience with emerging or non\-traditional manufacturing techniques, processes, and materials such as lamination, optical surface generation, or advanced casting methods * Experience in owning tooling development and qualification for molds and fixtures, from design through production * Experience with ophthalmic coating design, process development, and manufacturing * Experience with high\-precision machining and edging tools for lens cutting and engraving * Experience with optical compliance and product regulations such as FDA, ANSI, or ISO ### **About Meta:** jobs.title: Software Engineer, Systems ML - Compilers
jobs.description: Reality Labs (RL) focuses on delivering Meta's vision through Virtual Reality (VR), Augmented Reality (AR) and Wearable AI Devices. The compute performance and power efficiency requirements of our AI devices require custom silicon. Reality Labs Silicon team is driving the state of the art forward with breakthrough work in computer vision, machine learning, mixed reality, graphics, displays, sensors, and new ways to map the human body. Our chips will unlock personalized on\-device AI capabilities and blend virtual, physical worlds on wearable devices. We believe the only way to achieve our goals is to look at the entire stack, from transistors, through architecture, firmware, and algorithms.We are seeking a software engineer to support the development of the compiler tool\-chain for state\-of\-the\-art deep learning hardware components optimized for AR/VR systems. You will be part of our efforts to architect, design and implement a clean slate compiler for this activity and will be part of a team that includes compiler, machine learning algorithms and software, firmware and ASIC experts. You will contribute to a full stack development effort compiling PyTorch models down to binaries for custom hardware accelerator blocks. ### **Software Engineer, Systems ML \- Compilers accelerators * Design and implement compiler transformations informed by hardware architecture constraints for GPU, TPU, and edge AI accelerators * Drive the development of LLVM/MLIR\-based toolchains for compiling PyTorch models to optimized binaries for custom silicon * Work with hardware architects to co\-design compiler features that maximize performance, power efficiency, and programmability toolchains, or code optimization software * Experience with LLVM, MLIR, or similar compiler infrastructure frameworks * Experience in designing intermediate representations and implementing compiler optimization passes * Experience with hardware architectures such as GPUs, TPUs, or custom AI accelerators * Experience in software development using C\+\+ for compiler and systems\-level programming jobs.description: **Why Thunderbird?** Thunderbird is one of the world’s most trusted open\-source email applications, empowering more than 20 million people globally. At Thunderbird, we build privacy\-respecting communication and productivity tools that help people manage their digital lives while staying in control of their data. We are open source by design. Our products are developed transparently and in collaboration with a global community of contributors, and that same spirit shapes how we work: collaboratively, inclusively, and with a shared commitment to putting users first. Our small but growing distributed team includes more than 65 people across seven countries. As Thunderbird evolves beyond a single desktop application, we are expanding across desktop, mobile, paid services, AI offerings, and enterprise\-facing work to build independent, privacy\-respecting alternatives to big tech ecosystems. Our revenue model combines user donations, which help keep Thunderbird’s applications freely available, with paid services that cover the costs of hosted offerings while supporting long\-term sustainability and continued innovation. **A note about Thunderbird and Mozilla:** Thunderbird Technologies Corporation is the nonprofit\-owned company behind Thunderbird email and a growing portfolio of products. While part of the Mozilla family, Thunderbird is a separate entity from Mozilla Corporation and Mozilla Foundation with its own compensation programs, benefits, and employment policies. **The opportunity** As a Staff Software Engineer, Services, you’ll help shape the architecture and technical direction of web\-based products that extend Thunderbird beyond email. The Services team is currently focused on building offerings such as an appointment calendar and secure file storage and transfer solutions, creating valuable experiences for our users while supporting additional revenue streams for Thunderbird. This is a Staff\-level individual contributor role with significant technical ownership and influence. You’ll work with designers, engineers, and community members to write code, build prototypes, solve complex problems, and make technical decisions that shape our products. You’ll take a holistic view of our code and systems, helping establish the architecture and software patterns that allow our Services products to evolve and scale. You’ll also take on broad, ambiguous problems that have a direct impact on our goals, from improving our technical architecture to helping grow Services users and subscribers. Along the way, you’ll provide technical and product direction across teams, mentor other engineers, and identify ways to make our systems and processes more sustainable, scalable, and easier to work with. **What you’ll do** * Lead the technical architecture of new Services products, taking ownership of complex projects and identifying improvements that strengthen our systems as they evolve. * Write code, build prototypes and experiments, and contribute throughout the development lifecycle, from planning and testing through implementation, monitoring, and maintenance. * Help establish software patterns and make technical decisions across our Services products, including investigating and proposing technology choices. * Build and evolve analytics and infrastructure that help the team use user\-generated data to inform decisions. * Take on ambiguous, high\-level problems with broad scope and direct impact on Services goals, including growing users and subscribers. * Provide technical and product direction across Thunderbird and lead technical collaboration with other parts of Mozilla and community contributors when needed. * Work closely with the team and community to surface issues, refine ideas, and develop practical solutions. * Identify and plan improvements that make our systems and processes more accessible, self\-serviceable, lower friction, sustainable, scalable, and easier to delegate. * Mentor other engineers through code review, documentation, technical discussions, process improvements, and ongoing guidance. * Stay current with evolving technologies, coding standards, libraries, and frameworks and apply that knowledge to your work. **What you bring** * 10\+ years of web software development experience, including experience designing scalable and efficient systems and launching complex web projects at scale. * Expert\-level JavaScript skills and knowledge of at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Rust, Go, or C\+\+. * An understanding of the business landscape, including challenges and opportunities, and experience collaborating with teams to expand Thunderbird’s user and donor base. * Experience with front\-end frameworks, full\-stack development, and/or API development. * Strong knowledge of software development practices, including testing, code review, and documentation, and the ability to help others develop these skills. * Experience acting as a technical lead, solving complex technica hunderbird expands its offerings beyond email. **Work environment** This is a full\-time, fully remote position. You’ll join a distributed team of Thunderbird staff, open\-source community members, and contributors from around the world. We rely on clear communication, thoughtful documentation, and collaborative decision\-making to work effectively across time zones and disciplines. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with designers, engineers, cross\-functional teams across Thunderbird, other parts of Mozilla, and community contributors. **Compensation \& benefits** We benchmark our base salaries to local markets and target the 60th percentile of the peer market. jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Integrity
jobs.description: WORK OPTION: The NBA currently provides eligible employees the option of working remotely one day per week. \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ **Position Summary** The NBA’s Basketball Strategy \& Growth department is seeking a highly skilled full stack software engineer to support, manage, and improve the AI\-driven software the Integrity Team uses to identify conduct that may violate the league’s gaming policy. The software ingests data from a wide range of sources — betting markets, basketball data, open\-source intelligence (OSINT), and internal league systems — and surfaces anomalies for review by the Integrity Team. The engineer will own the platform end to end: building and maintaining backend jobs and services that power application functionality and designing the frontend interfaces the team uses to triage, investigate, and document the content the system surfaces. This role joins a team of data scientists, engineers, and basketball experts and collaborates closely with the Legal department on any investigation relating to a potential violation of the gaming policy. The work is highly confidential and often time\-sensitive, and the engineer will be expected to translate the needs of data scientists, investigators and attorneys into reliable, auditable software. **Major Responsibilities** * Own the backend architecture that powers the Integrity platform – build, schedule, monitor, and maintain the services and automated jobs that support application functionality, model execution, and investigative workflows * Design and build the front\-end UI the Integrity Team uses to review flagged activity, including alert queues, case views, market and player drill\-downs, and supporting visualizations. * Partner with data scientists to integrate anomaly detection and machine learning models and outputs into production applications, including deployment, inference, versioning, and monitoring. * Integrate third\-party and internal data services into the platform, defining service interfaces and application\-level schemas and building resilience for late, missing, or malformed data. * Build application logic and services on top of curated warehouse datasets, partnering with the Analytics Engineer when new transformations or data models are required. * Improve reliability and observability across the stack — alerting, logging, error handling, performance monitoring, and service health — so that system failures are detected and resolved quickly. * Build audit\-ready capabilities in partnership with the Legal department, including role\-based access controls, evidence exports, and durable records of what the system surfaced and when. * Instrument feedback loops so that investigator dispositions and case outcomes improve system precision over time. * Support active investigations by rapidly developing application features, internal tools, or views needed by the Integrity Team and Legal department, occasionally on short timelines during the season. * Document the system clearly, write and maintain tests, participate in code review, and standardize conventions across the codebase to ensure long\-term maintainability. **Required Skills/Knowledge** * Proficiency in Python and modern JavaScript/TypeScript, with production experience on both the server and client sides of an application. * Experience building and operating backend services and scheduled or orchestrated jobs on cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, or GCP). * Understanding of sports betting markets — odds, line movement, limits, player props, and market maker behavior — and of basketball data such as play\-by\-play, box score, and tracking data. * Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational data modeling and cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake. * Experience with a modern front\-end framework and demonstrated ability to design usable interfaces for analytical or investigative workflows. * Familiarity with Git\-based development workflows (GitHub or Azure DevOps), CI/CD, containerization (Docker), and automated testing. * Experience integrating third\-party APIs and building robust applications around external services with evolving, incomplete, or inconsistent data. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with non\-technical stakeholders, including attorneys and investigators. * Sound judgment and discretion in handling confidential and legally sensitive information. * Confident individual, able to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage short\-term deliverables along with long\-term projects. * Excels when working as part of a team, collaborating effectively both within BSG Integrity and cross\-functionally. **Preferred Skills/Knowledge** * Experience with Airflow or a comparable orchestration and scheduling platform. * Experience with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, or Unity Catalog. * Working knowledge of applied machine learning and experience integrating model inference into production applications. * Experience building LLM\-based applications (retrieval, summarization, or agentic workflows), particularly for document\-heavy or investigative use cases. * Familiarity with graph databases and graph\-based data modeling; experience with Amazon Neptune or a comparable graph database is a plus. * Experience integrating open\-source intelligence or third\-party intelligence services into production applications. * Experience with data visualization libraries and dashboard design. * Prior work on integrity, surveillance, fraud, AML, or trust and safety systems is a plus. * Experience in sports, gaming, or another regulated or compliance\-driven environment is a plus. **Experience/Education** * Bachelor’s degree required in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related technical field; master’s degree preferred. * Minimum 5 years of professional software engineering experience, including experience developing production backend or full\-stack applications. **Salary Range:** $155,000\-$180,000 **Job Posting Title:** Senior Manager Employees currently are eligible to receive an annual discretionary performance bonus, awarded at the sole discretion of the Company and subject to any terms and conditions set by the Company. Employees and/or eligible dependents may be eligible to participate in the following Company\-sponsored employee benefit programs: medical; dental; vision; life/AD\&D insurance; short\- and long\-term disability; fertility and family\-forming assistance; wellbeing allowance; educational assistance; mental health coaching/therapy; tax advantaged accounts such as HSA and healthcare/dependent care FSAs; a 401(k) retirement plan; and time off benefits that include vacation, sick time, and personal days. We Consider Applicants For All Positions On The Basis Of Merit, Qualifications And Business Needs, And Without Regard To Race, Color, National Origin, Religion, Sex, Gender Identity, Age, Disability, Alienage Or Citizenship Status, Ancestry, Marital Status, Creed, Genetic Predisposition Or Carrier Status, Sexual Orientation, Veteran Status, Familial Status, Status As A Victim Of Domestic Violence Or Any Other Status Or Characteristic Protected By Applicable Federal, State, Or Local Law. The NBA is committed to providing a safe and healthy workplace. To safeguard our employees and their families, our visitors, and the broader community from COVID\-19, and in consideration of recommendations from health authorities and the NBA’s own advisors, any individual working onsite in our New York and New Jersey offices must be fully vaccinated against COVID\-19\. The NBA will discuss accommodations for individuals who cannot be vaccinated due to a medical reason or sincerely held religious belief, practice, or observance. **About the NBA** The National Basketball Association (NBA) is a global sports and media organization with the mission to inspire and connect people everywhere through the power of basketball. Built around five professional sports leagues: the NBA, WNBA, NBA G League, NBA 2K League and Basketball Africa League, the NBA has established a major international presence with games and programming available in 214 countries and territories in 60 languages, and merchandise for sale in more than 200 countries and territories on all seven continents. NBA rosters at the start of the 2024\-25 season featured a record\-tying 125 international players from a record\-tying 43 countries. NBA Digital’s assets include NBA TV, NBA.com, the NBA App and NBA League Pass. The NBA has created one of the largest social media communities in the world, with more than 2\.3 billion likes and followers globally across all leagues, team and player platforms. NBA Cares, the NBA’s global social responsibility platform, partners with renowned community\-based organizations around the world to address important social issues in the areas of education, inclusion, youth and family development, and health and wellness.

jobs.title: Director, Engineering
jobs.description: Company Overview: **Why Choose Us?** ------------------ Novolex is a leading manufacturer of food, beverage, and specialty packaging that supports multiple industries including foodservice, restaurant delivery and carryout, food processing, grocery and retail, and industrial sectors. Novolex manufacturing and sourcing expertise spans a diverse range of substrates including resin, paper, molded fiber, aluminum and more. We provide customers a broad array of stock and customized solutions with 120 product categories, 250 brands and over 39,000 SKUs.**Our Sustainability Commitment** --------------------------------- The Novolex sustainability vision is built upon three pillars: our products, our operations and our people. Each is critically important to our growth and future as a business. These pillars form the foundation of our company\-wide commitment to sustainability, helping us achieve our ambitious goals through our wide\-ranging initiatives. Job Description: 1\. **Purpose**: Why does the position/role exist? – The Director of Engineering provides leadership and direction for Evergreen’s Engineering functions. This role ensures engineering teams fully use information management systems that connect functional areas and software platforms, increasing standardization and automation across the design, build, sold\-order, and problem\-solving cycle for all EPE equipment. The Director also leads cross\-functional teams to develop, commercialize, and support market\-required products and supports Novolex enterprise projects with machinery\-related expertise. Who are the key customers? \- Key customers include the EPE customer base, Sales/Marketing, Manufacturing, Field Service, and top management. External customers include major dairy and citrus juice processors and distributors. What are the key actions, outputs, deliverables, products and/or services? \- Deliverables include engineering services, technical services, and technical manuals. Engineering work should shift resources from administrative, sold\-order, and BOM tasks to engineering activities. Products must meet end\-customer or Marketing Lead Team functional requirements; applicable sanitation, safety, and electrical codes; project schedules and budgets; and the profit target for each sales order. 2\. **Key Accountabilities**: Provide a Strategy \- Develop and communicate short\- and long\-term strategies that help Engineering meet or exceed key performance measures and deliver correctly engineered, reliable equipment on time. Align the strategy with customer, market, and competitive needs. Accelerate product development and commercialization while reducing cost and resource requirements through strong leadership, practical judgment, PMI methodology, and innovative thinking. Customer Satisfaction \- Use engineering resources to reduce product nonconformances and improve product reliability and quality, supporting customer satisfaction and lower warranty expense. Manage the Product Line \- Support all Evergreen commercial products by managing sold\-order and internal processes, providing technical support to internal and external customers, leading product improvement projects, and supporting manufacturing. Analyze machine and option cost structures to improve margins. Track schedules using Microsoft Project, PMI tools, and daily team discussions. Monitor project budgets using finance data, Excel, and PMI tools. People Development \- Maintain a strong leadership pipeline through high standards for selection and evaluation and effective processes for developing and motivating talent. Continually improve these processes. Build the technical and project management skills of direct reports through field training, one\-on\-one mentoring, and PMI courses. Resource Loading Management \- Implement and maintain systems that use Engineering’s technical resources effectively and efficiently. Streamline systems and processes to optimize the engineering support required for the product line. Product Cost Reduction \- Drive continuous product cost reduction. Work Process Redesign \- Ensure engineering and documentation teams fully use information management systems that connect functional areas and software platforms, increasing standardization and automation across the design, build, sold\-order, and problem\-solving cycle for all EPE equipment. Standards \- Work with engineers to establish drafting, design, and part\-description standards for all internal and external resources, ensuring product consistency. Product Data Management \- Administer the Engineering Change Order (ECO) workflow, Publications Change Order (PCO) workflow, and related product data management processes. Technical Manuals \- Lead the creation of accurate, user\-friendly manuals for packaging equipment. Manage translation projects, provide manuals electronically to Field Service, and use advancing technologies to improve publication usability, accuracy, cost, and delivery. 3\. **Key Chall ree required; advanced degree or equivalent experience preferred. Related manufacturing and supply chain experience is required. Proven manufacturing leadership focused on total customer satisfaction is preferred. Project management training, such as PMI Basic Skills, is required. 10\-15 years of successful experience managing and leading multiple project teams of technical professionals. 5\-10 years of capital machinery design and development experience, including working knowledge of the PMO, 3A standards, and current safety and electrical standards. Five years of high\-speed processing or packaging machinery development is preferred. Experience initiating, negotiating, and managing joint product\-development ventures and partnerships with external engineering design firms and equipment developers. Demonstrated knowledge of current technologies and methods for creating and delivering technical information, including using AI to improve equipment and the customer experience. Excellent organizational, verbal, written, and interpersonal skills. Proven ability to achieve results and lead and motivate teams. Excellent project management ability. Strong knowledge of design, build, and configuration management in the capital equipment build business. Experience in working with customers both externally and across departments. Good working knowledge of financial models. Cost accounting and financial justification, both internal and external, are a must to maximize return for the value we offer. Experience in a custom, capital goods manufacturing environment. Demonstrate competence to work with minimal supervision and at all levels in the company. Consistent track record for achieving results. Strong information management (IT) skills The position requires the ability to deal with ambiguity, a willingness to travel, and a dedication to putting in the extra effort needed to meet schedule commitments. Ability to rapidly change direction, thought process, and focus is a must. Company Benefits: **What You'll Get From Us** --------------------------- ### **Benefits** With safety as our top priority and a commitment to employee well\-being an important focus, we offer comprehensive and competitive benefits that include medical, dental and vision insurance as well as a variety of other well\-being resources focused on mental, physical and financial health. Specific benefits and well\-being programs may vary depending on where you work.### **Community Engagement** At Novolex, giving back to the local communities that support us is important. Our Focused Giving Program prioritizes support for organizations whose missions promote sustainability initiatives or address food and hunger needs. We also encourage facility level support of activities in the communities where our employees live and work.### **Training and Development** We offer constant opportunities for advancement. From skills development to advanced education programs, training and development programs and courses are available through MyLearning. Programs include company and industry training curricula, support for formal education through the Tuition Reimbursement Program (Non\-Union), and a Learning Management System that supports and enhances employee skills at all levels of the organization. jobs.title: Engineer 3 - Engineer 5 - Roadway Design Engineer
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ At the Louisiana Department of Transportation and Development (DOTD), we plan, build, maintain, and protect the transportation systems that connect communities, support commerce, and keep Louisiana moving. Please visit our DOTD Career Center for more information about our agency. DOTD is seeking a Roadway Design Engineer to support transportation projects and programs through roadway design, project development, plan preparation, geometric design, engineering estimates, and technical support for transportation improvement projects. This position supports the development, delivery, maintenance, or improvement of transportation infrastructure by applying engineering principles, conducting technical analysis, coordinating projects, and conducting compliance\-related reviews. No prior engineering experience is required — training is provided, with opportunities for career progression and advancement through the Engineering job series. Positions are located in Baton Rouge**,** and report to Engineer 6\-Road Design Squad Leader. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Possession of a current Louisiana license to practice professional engineering. NOTE: Applications will be accepted from persons licensed to practice professional engineering in states other than Louisiana. If one of those applicants is selected for the position, he/she will be required to obtain a Louisiana license prior to appointment. The hiring agency will verify that all licensing requirements are met. NOTE: Louisiana Professional Engineer licenses are issued by the Louisiana Professional Engineering and Land Surveying Board. Licensing requirements may be viewed at www.lapels.com. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ **Job Duties:** Depending on level and assignment, Engineer 3 – Engineer 5 may: * Prepares detailed engineering design drawings and cost estimates for the most complex engineering projects including, but not limited to freeways, complex interchanges and innovative intersections, major urban and rural highways, and major bridge replacement projects. These projects include highly detailed designs that attempt to minimize impacts on environmentally sensitive locations and commercial and residential properties. * Some common tasks include establishing typical sections, setting vertical and horizontal grades. * The incumbent at this level will independently develop and manage design plans for a roadway construction project from inception to letting. * Performs as Project Manager on in\-house or consultant\-designed projects. The incumbent will be responsible for developing and maintaining project scopes; project and plan development schedules and ensuring projects are designed and delivered within the allotted budget. * Manages consultant contracts by developing project scopes, negotiation of man\-hours and fees, establishing contract time requirements, establishing design criteria, monitoring progress for work quality and quantity, reviewing acceptability of plans, and approving invoices for payment. **Position\-Specific Details:** **Career Progression:** This position is part of a Career Progression Group and may be filled as Engineer 3, 4, or 5 based on qualifications and agency needs. **Compensation: These positions qualify for a Special Entrance Rate (SER).** Engineer 3 – $3,083\.20/biweekly Engineer 4 – $3,529\.60/biweekly Engineer 5 –$3,776\.80/biweekly Additional compensation may be considered impart with extraordinary qualifications in accordance with State Civil Service Rules and DOTD policy. **Appointment Type:** This position may be filled as either a probational appointment (open to all qualified applicants); a promotion (open to all statewide classified and Agency\-wide permanent status employees); Job Appointment (temporary appointment in a classified position for a limit of four years); or by detail to special duty. **Additional Information:** This posting may be used to fill multiple vacancies. **How To Apply:** **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. To apply for this vacancy, click on the "Apply" link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. * Information to support your eligibility for the position must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). jobs.title: Research Engineer/Scientist
jobs.description: **Research Engineer / Scientist** **Location:** United States **Employment Type:** Full\-time **Focus:** Frontier AI, Agentic AI, Reinforcement Learning, Computer Use, Multimodal Models, Long\-Horizon Agents **About Our Client** Our client is a stealth\-stage AI company building frontier models focused on human intent understanding, computer use, and autonomous agent systems. The founding team includes leaders from Tesla AI, Google DeepMind, NVIDIA, Physical Intelligence, and Apple. They are building from the ground up and looking for early research talent to help shape the technical direction, research agenda, and product architecture from day one. This is an opportunity to work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI: teaching agents to understand how people work, represent intent, use computers, and complete long\-horizon tasks with increasing autonomy. **About the Role** Our client is hiring a **Research Engineer / Scientist** to own ambitious research bets end to end. This person will work across hypothesis generation, data strategy, model training, evaluation, deployment, and iteration. The role is focused on reinforcement learning, post\-training, continual learning, multimodal agents, and long\-horizon autonomous systems. The team is open to a range of backgrounds, from fresh PhD graduates with strong research internships to senior researchers who have led teams at top AI labs. **What You’ll Do** * Run experiments and train frontier AI models focused on human judgment scaling, computer use, and intent representation learning * Post\-train LLMs and multimodal agents using reinforcement learning and continual learning methods * Work with large\-scale screen recording and behavioral data to understand how individual users work * Build models that can learn user workflows and proactively automate tasks * Design and execute rigorous research experiments that improve autonomous agent capabilities * Own research bets end to end, from hypothesis and data through training, evaluation, deployment, and measurement * Help define the company’s research direction as an early technical team member * Partner closely with founders and engineering leadership on technical architecture and product strategy * Translate cutting\-edge research into systems that can power real product experiences **What We’re Looking For** * Experience in frontier AI research, applied AI research, or research engineering * Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, reinforcement learning, post\-training, continual learning, or multimodal systems * Experience designing and running rigorous experiments * Ability to move from research idea to implemented system * Strong programming and engineering fundamentals * Comfort working with large\-scale datasets and complex model training workflows * Strong judgment around model evaluation, data quality, experimental design, and deployment readiness * Ability to operate in ambiguity and take ownership of open\-ended research problems * Clear communication and ability to collaborate with a small, high\-caliber founding team * Excitement about computer use, autonomous agents, human intent modeling, and the future of AI\-native software **Relevant Research Areas** Relevant experience may include: * Reinforcement learning * Post\-training * Continual learning * Long\-horizon agents * Computer use agents * Multimodal LLMs * Human behavior modeling * Intent representation learning * Human judgment scaling * Behavioral data modeling * Agent evaluation * AI automation * Large\-scale model training **Ideal Background** Our client is open to a range of seniority levels, including: * Fresh PhD graduates with strong research internship experience * Research engineers from frontier AI labs * Applied scientists with experience training and evaluating advanced AI systems * Senior researchers who have led teams or major technical efforts * Builders who can connect research quality with production\-minded execution **Why This Opportunity** * Join a stealth\-stage AI company at the founding team stage * Work directly with leaders from Tesla AI, Google DeepMind, NVIDIA, Physical Intelligence, and Apple * Help define the research agenda from day one * Own ambitious technical bets across reinforcement learning, post\-training, continual learning, and agentic AI * Work on frontier problems in computer use, human intent understanding, and long\-horizon autonomous agents * Build models that learn how people work and help automate real tasks * Shape both technical architecture and product direction early **Ideal Candidate Profile** The ideal candidate is a research\-minded builder who wants to push the frontier of agentic AI. They can design strong experiments, train models, reason deeply about evaluation, and turn ambiguous research questions into working systems. They are excited by the challenge of building AI agents that understand human intent, use computers effectively, and improve through real\-world interaction. This person wants to help shape the research foundation of a company from the earliest stage.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description: **Are you looking to Optimize your life? Start your exciting path to a rewarding career today!** We are Optimum, a leader in the fast\-paced world of connectivity, and we're seeking driven and enthusiastic professionals to join our team, empower lives, fuel businesses, and drive innovation. Connectivity is no longer a luxury, but a necessity. A career at Optimum means you'll be enabling progress and enhancing lives by providing reliable, high\-speed connectivity solutions that keep the world connected. Our successes, now and in the future, are powered by our amazing product, a commitment to our people and culture, and the connections we make in our communities. If you are resourceful, collaborative, and passionate about delivering consistent excellence, Optimum is for you! **Job Summary** --------------- Optimum is a communications and media company that enables our customers through the power of connectivity. With a relentless focus on challenging today's norm while developing the telecommunications of the future, our products and services bring people closer together and connect them to the things that matter most to them, faster and more easily than ever before. To meet the needs of our customers, Optimum is building a company and a workforce that is equipped to deliver on the Optimum promise. That means creating an environment that attracts and retains the best talent and reflects the ideas, perspective and backgrounds of the diverse communities and people we serve across the country. Optimum believes that great ideas and the opportunity to deliver for our customers should come from every member of our team. And when our make\-up and mindset reflect that of the world in which we live, we're all the stronger for it. The Project Manager in the Data \& Analytics department is responsible for planning, coordinating, and delivering data and analytics initiatives using Agile methodologies. This role partners with business stakeholders, scrum masters, data engineers, analysts, data scientists, architects, and technology teams to ensure projects deliver measurable business value on time, within scope, and with appropriate quality and governance. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * The Project Manager will be directly responsible for managing/overseeing project: scope, cost, schedule, risks/issues, procurement and communications. * Apply Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid Agile approaches based on project and team needs. + Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including: + Scrum of scrum + PI planning + Portfolio syncs + PI retrospectives * Partner with 3rd party suppliers and internal stakeholders including scrum masters, data engineers, analysts, data scientists and business stakeholders to define priorities, quarterly commitments, success measures and dependencies. * Identify, manage, and escalate project risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers impacting commitments made by the scrum teams. * Develop, maintain and communicate PI plans, roadmaps and benefits to stakeholders including executives. * Track delivery of scrum teams using Agile metrics such as sprint velocity, burndown/burnup, cycle time, throughput, and delivery predictability. * Create project procurement management plans detailing what needs, quantities, and timelines are required for renewals and new contracts with procurement. * Monitor supplier performance, manage day\-to\-day vendor relationships, and resolve delivery issues. * Track spending against the project budget and report financial variances early. **Qualifications** ------------------ * PMP, PMI\-ACP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), PSM, SAFe, or similar certification * Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Data, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience * 5\+ years of project or program management experience, preferably supporting technology, data or analytics initiatives * Demonstrated experience working in an Agile environment using Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid methodologies * Experience managing cross\-functional technical teams and complex project dependencies * Experience with project and Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Confluence, or similar platforms * Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, and problem\-solving * Key Competencies + Agile project delivery + Stakeholder and vendor management + Planning and prioritization + Risk and dependency management + Facilitation and conflict resolution + Executive communication + Continuous improvement + Outcome and value\-focused delivery * Success Measures / KPIs + On\-time, on\-budget and predictable delivery of data and analytics initiatives + Achievement of project objectives and business outcomes + Sprint and program increment predictability + Reduction of delivery risks and blockers + Stakeholder satisfaction + Adoption and usage of delivered analytics solutions + Improvement in team velocity, cycle time, and delivery efficiency At Optimum, every action and interaction we take part in, is driven by our three Guiding Principles: Do What’s Right, Drive One Optimum, and Make It Happen. These aren’t just words, they help us build trust, create real community, and embrace new ways of thinking. Our employees are empowered to do the right thing for our customers and co\-workers and to recognize and reward these behaviors when we see them. It’s all part of the bigger picture of “Be The Difference” where each employee knows they have the power to enact real change, share new ideas, and understand that learning never stop. If you have the drive to succeed and are ready to embark on a thrilling career, seize this opportunity today, and join our winning team. Together, we'll shape the future of connectivity. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) is building the next generation of AI native engineering systems powering cloud operations, infrastructure automation, and developer productivity at scale. We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer (IC4\) who operates as an AI native builder. This is not a traditional software engineering role centered on manual coding. Engineers on this team use AI assisted development, coding agents, and automation first workflows as the default mode of software creation. This role focuses on rapidly building intelligent systems, internal platforms, operational tooling, and cloud native services using modern AI driven engineering practices. You will work across distributed systems, automation platforms, developer experience, and operational intelligence to dramatically improve engineering velocity, reliability, and scale. Engineers on this team are expected to deeply integrate LLMs, coding copilots, agentic IDEs, and AI orchestration workflows into their daily development process. Success in this role is measured not only by code written, but by the ability to effectively leverage AI systems to accelerate delivery, automate repetitive engineering work, and solve high impact operational problems. As a Principal Software Development Engineer, you will: * Design and build scalable cloud native systems, automation platforms, and intelligent operational tooling. * Use AI assisted development workflows as the primary engineering model for software design, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. * Build systems where humans supervise and orchestrate intelligent automation rather than manually executing repetitive engineering tasks. * Rapidly prototype and productionize solutions using modern AI native development environments and agentic workflows. * Develop internal developer platforms, APIs, operational workflows, and AI enabled engineering systems. * Improve engineering productivity through intelligent automation, workflow orchestration, and self service tooling. * Partner across engineering, infrastructure, and operations teams to solve complex technical and operational challenges. * Drive operational excellence through observability, automated remediation, telemetry, and resilient system design. * Contribute to architecture, technical strategy, and engineering best practices across the organization. Mentor engineers in modern AI native development practices and automation first engineering approaches. * **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field. * 5\+ years of software engineering experience building scalable production systems. * Strong programming skills in Java, Python, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript. * Experience building distributed systems, cloud native applications, APIs, or automation platforms. * Experience with CI/CD systems, cloud infrastructure, containers, and modern software development practices. * Strong systems thinking, debugging, and problem solving skills. Ability to independently drive projects in fast moving and ambiguous environments. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Deep experience using AI assisted development tools such as Cursor, Copilot, Claude, Codex or similar agentic engineering environments. * Strong understanding of AI native software development workflows, prompt driven engineering, and LLM assisted system design. * Experience building developer productivity tooling, workflow automation systems, or operational intelligence platforms. * Familiarity with Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform, and Infrastructure as Code technologies. * Experience with observability platforms, telemetry systems, and production operations. * Knowledge of LLM orchestration frameworks, retrieval systems, vector databases, or AI infrastructure concepts is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to rapidly ship high quality production systems using AI accelerated engineering workflows. * Strong communication and cross functional collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Core Infrastructure Engineering
jobs.description: The OCI AI Infrastructure Network Operations team operates and improves the high\-performance RDMA/RoCE network fabrics powering OCI’s largest AI, GPU, and HPC workloads. As a Senior Manager, you will lead a team responsible for building, operating, and scaling these critical network fabrics and supporting systems. You will combine deep networking expertise in RDMA/RoCE, Clos fabrics, congestion control, telemetry, and performance troubleshooting with strong software engineering and people leadership. You will drive automation, monitoring, resiliency, and operational readiness while partnering across Network Availability, Automation, Monitoring, GNOC, hardware engineering, and service teams. Your team will improve network performance and availability, resolve complex customer issues, and build fault\-tolerant systems that support AI infrastructure at global cloud scale. As a Senior Manager in the AI Infrastructure Network Operations organization, you will: * Lead and develop a team of engineers responsible for RDMA/RoCE fabric operations, performance, automation, and troubleshooting across OCI’s AI/HPC infrastructure. * Drive the design, operation, scalability, reliability, and performance of highly available network and distributed systems supporting hyperscale workloads. * Apply deep expertise in RDMA, RoCE, Ethernet fabrics, congestion control, QoS, telemetry, and large\-scale troubleshooting to improve network performance and availability. * Guide the architecture and development of operational tools, automation platforms, monitoring systems, and infrastructure services, including Infrastructure as Code (IaC). * Drive improvements in resiliency, observability, testing, and automation while simplifying and scaling operational workflows. * Lead operational readiness, customer escalations, NOC events, and complex production incidents, coordinating resolution across networking, software, hardware, and operations teams. * Define team roadmaps and data\-driven KPIs focused on fabric health, engineering efficiency, operational backlog, customer impact, performance, and service availability. * Partner with Network Availability, Network Automation, Network Monitoring, GNOC, deployment, hardware, and service teams to deliver reliable infrastructure at cloud scale. * Ensure operational planning, security, compliance, change management, staffing, on\-call coverage, and service\-level expectations are met. * Drive continuous improvement in engineering practices, processes, tooling, and operational efficiency. * Attract, mentor, and develop engineers across networking, software development, automation, and distributed systems while building a high\-performing engineering organization. Participate in the manager on\-call rotation and provide technical and organizational leadership during high\-severity incidents. * **Preferred Experience** * Strong background in operating or building network for large\-scale cloud. * Experience with RDMA/RoCE, GPU/HPC networking, Clos fabrics, congestion management, telemetry, and performance debugging.

release plans. * Architect and implement AI\-enabled applications using appropriate methods, including classical ML, document intelligence, NLP, LLM integrations, RAG, agentic workflows, multi\-agent repositories. * Serve as the technical primary point of contact for assigned Federal Agency stakeholders and provide planned/unplanned coverage for other key personnel. * Act as, or work directly with, the designated Security Lead to certify security evidence for each applicable deliverable. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, data science, software engineering, information systems, statistics, engineering, or comparable field; Master’s degree preferred. * Seven or more years of hands\-on experience in AI/ML engineering, software engineering, cloud engineering, enterprise architecture, or data engineering, including delivery of AI\-enabled systems. * At least two years of hands\-on production experience in one or more of generative AI, LLM integration, RAG, model evaluation, AI agents, or production AI system operations. * Demonstrated ability to deliver across AI, application development, data engineering, UX, Generative AI or Machine Learning certification * Google Cloud Generative AI / ML credential * Databricks Generative AI Engineer credential * NVIDIA Generative AI credential * Certified Artificial Intelligence Professional (CAIP) * Equivalent recognized AI/ML certification Certification evidence must be supplied at onboarding and annually thereafter. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Modernization
jobs.description: Overview: The Software Engineer, Modernization is at the center of our modernization effort: systematically identifying and eliminating technical debt, re\-platforming legacy systems onto clean, cloud\-native architectures, and building solutions that are built to last. This person leverages AI heavily throughout their workflow — using it to accelerate analysis, generate refactored code, and uncover patterns across large legacy codebases. Starting base pay for this role is between $97,000 and $122,000\. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, training, location, and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role will be eligible for a bonus as well as competitive medical, dental, and vision benefits, wellness reimbursement, life insurance, and a 401(k) with company match. We offer vacation and sick leave benefits (under a flexible time off policy in most states). Responsibilities: *Technical Debt Reduction \& Legacy Modernization** Systematically identifies, prioritizes, and remediates technical debt across existing codebases, partnering with Engineering Leads to build and execute a structured modernization backlog. * Refactors and re\-platforms legacy .NET and C\# applications onto modern, cloud\-native architectures \- improving maintainability, performance, and scalability without disrupting active product delivery. * Decomposes monolithic systems into clean, loosely\-coupled microservices and APIs, establishing clear domain boundaries and reducing interdependencies that slow delivery velocity. * Replaces brittle, over\-engineered, or redundant systems with simpler, more sustainable solutions that are easier to understand, test, and evolve. * Uses AI\-assisted tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to analyze legacy code at scale \- accelerating impact analysis, generating refactoring candidates, and producing documentation for undocumented systems. *Cloud\-Native Re\-platforming** Migrates workloads from legacy infrastructure to cloud\-native patterns on AWS, leveraging Lambda, containers (ECS/EKS), Step Functions, Temporal, and managed services to reduce operational overhead and improve scalability. * Applies modern software design patterns \- including event\-driven architecture, CQRS, and domain\-driven design \- to re\-architected systems, positioning them to support future innovation and client scale. * Implements database migration and schema modernization using Flyway, ensuring safe, versioned transitions away from legacy data models. * Builds containerized services using Docker, establishing consistent deployment and runtime environments across development, staging, and production. * Authors infrastructure\-as\-code using Terraform or AWS CDK to replace manual, brittle environment configurations with repeatable, auditable provisioning. *Standards, Simplicity \& Scalability** Champions engineering simplicity as a first\-class design principle \- pushing back on unnecessary complexity and advocating for solutions that are easy for the next Engineer to understand and change. * Establishes and documents patterns for modernized systems, creating reusable blueprints that accelerate future re\-platforming efforts and provide a consistent architecture baseline across the Engineering organization. * Instruments modernized systems with observability best practices \- structured logging, distributed tracing, and metrics \- so that operational visibility improves alongside code quality. * Contributes to and enforce Engineering standards around code quality, testing, documentation, and API design, ensuring modernized systems raise the bar rather than just moving problems. * Designs modernized systems with client scale in mind \- ensuring they can support increased load, faster release cadences, and rapid product iteration as the business grows. *AI\-Augmented Development** Actively integrates AI development tools into your daily workflow to accelerate refactoring, generate test coverage for legacy code, and produce migration documentation. * Uses AI to perform large\-scale codebase analysis \- identifying duplication, dead code, anti\-patterns, and high\-risk areas across legacy systems that would take weeks to assess manually. * Partners with the AI Platform \& Backend Services team to identify modernization opportunities that can be unlocked by new AI\-powered capabilities. * Contributes to team best practices around responsible and effective use of AI\-assisted development, sharing techniques that improve team\-wide velocity and code quality. *Collaboration \& Delivery** Works closely with Engineering Managers, Architects, and Product teams to sequence modernization work alongside active feature development, minimizing disruption to product delivery. * Participates in architecture reviews and design discussions, bringing a modernization lens to new initiatives to pre ainerized environments * Experience with version control and collaborative development workflows using Git and GitHub * A demonstrated ability to communicate about technical complexity clearly — to both technical peers and non\-technical stakeholders *Preferred Qualification:* * Experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, including using AI for codebase analysis and refactoring acceleration * Familiarity with workflow orchestration using Temporal or AWS Step Functions in a production environment * Experience with database migration tooling such as Flyway and safe schema evolution practices * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code tooling (Terraform, AWS CDK, or Pulumi) * Familiarity with event\-driven architecture patterns and asynchronous messaging (SQS, SNS, EventBridge, or Kafka) * Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development environment * A strong personal conviction that simple, well\-structured systems are a competitive advantage — and a track record of building them Benefits: * Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses * Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\* * All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote * Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance * Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements * Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account * Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4% * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications * Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications * Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management * Additional coverages available – Pet Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Voluntary Life \& AD\&D coverage *\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK* Who We Are: Origami Risk delivers single\-platform SaaS solutions that help organizations best navigate the complexities of risk, insurance, compliance, and safety management. Founded by industry veterans who recognized the need for risk management technology that was more configurable, intuitive, and scalable, Origami continues to add to its innovative product offerings for managing both insurable and uninsurable risk; facilitating compliance; improving safety; and helping insurers, MGAs, TPAs, and brokers provide enhanced services that drive results. A singular focus on client success underlies Origami’s approach to developing, implementing, and supporting our award\-winning software solutions. *Origami Risk is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We thrive and benefit from diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable environment for all employees. We do not discriminate against any individual based upon race, religion, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, color, sex, national origin, age, marital status, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.* ***Caution****: Be alert to recruiting scams. Docker or Kubernetes. * Automated testing and DevOps practices. * Experience supporting business\-critical line\-of\-business applications where downtime is visible to real users. **WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** --------------------------------------------- * This is a remote\-first role with occasional travel for meetings, training, or industry events. * Regular virtual collaboration across distributed teams. * Frequent computer\-based tasks, including data analysis and report generation. **WHY JOIN US?** ---------------- * Be part of a forward\-thinking company in a rapidly growing PEO sector. * Opportunity to influence strategy and shape operations at an enterprise level. * Work with a company positioned to be the leading provider of PEO services in the U.S. * Competitive compensation and benefits package, with opportunities to lead thought leadership initiatives. ### **Fraud Alert: Peoplease is aware of an active employment scam in which fraudulent parties are sending fake job offer letters impersonating our company.** **Peoplease will never:** * Send an unsolicited job offer without you submitting an application and interviewing * Ask you to pay fees, purchase equipment, or provide banking details to secure a position **When in doubt, verify.** Contact our HR team directly at **MyHR@peoplease.com** before responding to any suspicious communication.

jobs.title: Stationary Operating Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our directorates related to Mission Support \& Operations include Office of General Counsel, Business Services, Communications and External Engagement, Operational Systems, Communications and Information Technology, and Performance Management. The Operational Systems Directorate (OSD) leads delivery of PNNL’s 10\-year, $1\.2 billion campus construction portfolio— the single largest construction and modernization effort in the Laboratory’s history. OSD oversees operations and facility services, maintenance, and infrastructure planning. A team of nearly 800 staff comprise OSD, spanning in a wide range of disciplines, including craftspeople, engineers, construction professionals, technicians, scientists, administrators, and specialists. Together, they ensure that PNNL’s assets, services, and OSD\-led programs are managed and performing safely, securely, reliably, effectively, and efficiently. The directorate stewards more than $250 million in annual budget authority; managing more than 2\.5 million square feet of facility space across two campuses; overseeing approximately 200 regulatory program areas; and executing a multi\-million\-dollar facility and infrastructure project portfolio. The Facilities \& Infrastructure Operations (F\&IO) Division is responsible for operating and maintaining PNNL’s buildings, grounds, and utilities. The F\&IO team includes plant engineering, fabrication, craft services, duplicating and mail services, facility program support, relocations, and receiving. F\&IO is home to approximately 363 staff including more than 250 bargaining unit (union) staff. Bargaining Unit: * Weekly Pay: $1,719\.68 * This is a bargaining unit position and will be under the Battelle/HAMTC Collective Bargaining Agreement. As a condition of employment, unless otherwise exempted, the staff member will be required to join the appropriate union affiliated with the Hanford Metal Trades Council (HAMTC) after 30 days of continuous service and pay union dues or pay agency fees to such union in lieu of joining Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance, employee assistance program, and business travel insurance. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company funded pension plan and may enroll in our 401k savings plan. Employees may accrue up to 80 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year. Employees receive 56 hours of paid personal (sick) time per calendar year. Responsibilities: The **Stationary Operating Engineer** operates and maintains building systems equipment, e.g., steam engines, air compressors, air dryers, chillers, condensers, vacuum pumps, generators, motors, water treatment systems, fans and boilers to provide utilities, such as light, heat, ventilation, or power, for building operation; monitors meters and gauges and adjusts controls of equipment to verified operating conditions. Records data, e.g. temperature of equipment, fuel consumption. Monitors and records system status information for maintenance and/or minor modification requirements. For purposes of job assignments, may perform any Power Operator Journeyman job functions for which the staff member, as determined by management, is qualified. Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications:* 2 years of related experience * A High School diploma or equivalent * Must have a valid state\-issued driver's license * This position requires the physical capabilities to work outside while traversing uneven terrain, to climb ladders, and maintain standing positions Preferred Qualifications: * Technical Institute graduate or relevant Associate degree * TAB (Testing, Adjusting, and Balancing) of air and hydronic systems * Building Automation System/Direct Digital Controls operation * Maximo or other Computer Maintenance Management System software * Building Commissioning/Start\-Up process * Skills in utilizing electronic work request systems/tracking for tablets or Smartphones * Ability to lift up to 50 pounds Hazardous Working Conditions/Environment: Not Applicable Testing Designated Position (TDP): This is not a Testing Designated Position (TDP). About PNNL: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world\-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them! At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45\-minute flight (or \~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs.
