jobs.title: Heavy Equipment Operator-Union
jobs.description: Position Description Penhall Company is recruiting a **Heavy Equipment Operator** to join it's team. This position is responsible for safely operating heavy equipment such as excavators, skid steers, and loaders to support construction, demolition, and concrete removal projects. This role involves equipment maintenance, material handling, and working closely with field crews to ensure job site efficiency and safety. You'll also perform maintenance tasks such as greasing, cleaning and inspecting equipment. Must be willing and able to work extended shifts, including nights and weekends, when required. This position is deemed as a Safety Sensitive position and will require negative result for preemployment Drug and Alcohol testing in order to complete offer of employment for anyone who will be operating heavy equipment or company vehicles. **This position is covered by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA) with the Operating Engineers union. Will be required to join the union and maintain membership in good standing. Current union members welcome to apply. Pay rate is union scale.** **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Operate heavy construction equipment including excavators, front\-end loaders, skid steers, and related machinery. * Load dump trucks with broken concrete using appropriate equipment. * Break concrete using an excavator with hydraulic breaker attachments. * Operate machinery in support of building, bridge, and highway construction or demolition. * Inspect, fuel, and maintain equipment at the beginning and end of each shift. * Communicate clearly with dispatch and job site supervisors regarding tasks and updates. * Perform routine maintenance and minor repairs to equipment as needed. * Accurate completion of work orders and time cards. * Complete all necessary paperwork (may include, but is not limited to, daily logs, inspection logs, equipment inspection, hours of service, etc.) * Deal with co\-workers, customers and the public in a courteous and respectful manner. * Communicate any unsafe conditions or accidents/injuries in a timely manner to the supervisor in order to facilitate prompt correction or reporting. * Adhere strictly to all safety protocols and procedures. * Assist team members and perform other job\-related duties as assigned. **Essential Core Competencies:** * Safety Focused: Consistently prioritizes job site safety and equipment operation standards. * Results Orientation: Focused on task completion, quality, and productivity. * Communicates Effectively: Clear and respectful communication with dispatch and crews. * Adaptability: Comfortable working in varying site conditions and project demands. * Team Player: Collaborates with field teams to support project success. * Reliability: Maintains consistent attendance and performance standards. **Employer Disclosure Statement** The above statements and job description is not intended to describe the nature and level of work being performed within this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and tasks. Other similar or additional duties are performed as signed. We E\-Verify. We will provide the Federal Government with information from your Form I\-9 to verify you are legal for employment in the United States. Position Requirements * High school diploma or equivalent required. * Valid Commercial driver’s license with a clean driving record. * Current DOT medical certificate. * Minimum 3 years of verifiable experience operating heavy equipment. * Mechanical aptitude. * Valid Commercial driver’s license with a clean driving record * Current DOT medical certificate * Strong knowledge of heavy equipment operation, capabilities, and safety practices. * Excellent mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills. * Reliable and punctual attendance. * Proficient with computers and mobile devices (iPhone and iPad), knowledge of Microsoft Outlook, Word and Excel, internet browsers and Windows * Display a professional and courteous attitude to co\-workers, supervisors and the general public at all times * Versatility, flexibility, and a willingness to work within constantly changing priorities and sometimes conflicting deadlines * Ability to follow instructions and work independently. * Strong communication skills. * Dependable, safety\-minded, and team\-oriented. **Physical and Additional Requirements:** * Must be able to lift 50 pounds regularly. * Must be able to work extended shifts, including nights and weekends, when required. * Must be able to operate machinery in all weather conditions and terrain types. * Must comply with all Penhall Company safety regulations. Application Instructions **Apply today to be considered for this open position\-interviewing now!** ========================================================================== Penhall Company has been shaping the future of concrete services for over 65 years. As the nation’s leader in concrete cutting, coring, scanning, and demolition, and ranked 3rd in Demolition by ENR's 2023 Top Specialty Contractors, we deliver more than just expertise—we deliver results. With safety at the core of our operations and state\-of\-the\-art technology in our hands, we ensure every project is executed with precision, efficiency, and care. At Penhall Company, everything we do is built on our commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our employees, and our communities. Every single Penhall Company employee moves our company forward. If you are self\-motivated and find a job well\-done to be the ultimate reward, you'll fit right in! Equal Opportunity Information Penhall Company is a Drug\-Free Workplace and Equal Opportunity Employer. We recruit, hire, employ, train, promote, and compensate individuals based on job\-related qualifications and abilities. Penhall Company has a longstanding policy of providing a work environment that respects the dignity and worth of each individual and is free from all forms of employment discrimination, including harassment, because of race, color, sex, gender, age, religion or religious creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We provide reasonable accommodation to qualified veterans/individuals with disabilities or based on a sincerely held religious belief, in accordance with applicable laws. If you need to inquire about an accommodation, or need assistance with completing the application process, please email hr@penhall.com. **AI\-Assisted Hiring and Automated Decision Tool Disclosure** The Company may use Artificial Intelligence (“AI”), machine learning technologies, and/or automated decision\-making tools to assist in certain aspects of the recruitment and hiring process, including reviewing applications, resumes, assessments, and candidate qualifications. These tools are used to support the evaluation process and are not used as the sole basis for employment decisions. All employment decisions are ultimately made by qualified Company representatives. The Company maintains human oversight of hiring decisions and does not permit automated systems to make final employment determinations independently. The Company is committed to equal employment opportunity and to complying with all applicable federal, state, and local employment, privacy, and anti\-discrimination laws. The Company does not intentionally use AI systems in a manner that unlawfully discriminates against applicants or employees based on any protected characteristic under applicable law. Applicants may request reasonable accommodations, alternative evaluation methods, or additional information regarding the Company’s use of automated tools by contacting Human Resources. Where required by applicable law, the Company may provide additional notices regarding the use of automated decision\-making tools, data practices, retention periods, or bias audit information.

jobs.title: Engineering Management Trainee
jobs.description: Perdue Foods has a goal of becoming the most trusted name in premium proteins by creating products for consumers and for retail and foodservice customers around the globe while changing the way animals are raised for food. It is part of Perdue Farms, a fourth\-generation, family\-owned food and agricultural business deeply rooted in tradition yet with a forward\-thinking mindset. We believe that success starts with our people, and our culture is built on a foundation of teamwork, integrity, and respect, where every voice matters and everyone is encouraged to contribute to our shared goals. We are dedicated to creating a supportive, inclusive environment where associates feel valued and inspired to make an impact, both within the company and in the communities we serve. From promoting growth and development to prioritizing work\-life balance, we’re committed to helping our team members thrive. **That's Perdue.** **Summary** Are you ready to launch your career as a future engineering leader at Perdue? As part of our Engineering Management Trainee (Pathways) Program, beginning in June 2027, you’ll embark on a 24\-month leadership development journey designed to prepare the next generation of engineering leaders. Through hands\-on learning, meaningful projects, structured rotations, mentorship, and leadership development, you’ll gain real\-world experience in plant operations, engineering work processes, project management, and capital project execution while building the technical and leadership skills needed to make a lasting impact. During your first year, you’ll explore key engineering, operational, and support areas and develop a strong foundation in engineering practices, project execution, and plant operations before transitioning into an engineering leadership assignment. Your second year will accelerate your growth through personalized development, mentorship, cohort learning, meaningful project work, and advanced technical experiences designed to prepare you for long\-term success. This program is ideal for motivated, curious, and driven individuals who are eager to learn, take on meaningful challenges, and build a rewarding career helping drive innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement at Perdue. **Benefits** * Participate in up to two (2\) Regional Pathways Training events alongside fellow participants from across the organization. These experiences include leadership development, networking opportunities, company tours, community service initiatives, social events, and direct interaction with senior leaders. * Competitive hourly pay during EMT I, with transition to a salaried, exempt position upon successful progression to EMT II at approximately six months, and an additional scheduled pay progression at 12 months. * Comprehensive benefits package, including a transition bonus and relocation assistance for eligible participants. * Opportunity to advance into an Associate Plant Engineer or comparable engineering assignment upon successful completion of the first 12 months of the Pathways Program, based on business need and demonstrated readiness. * During your second year, you’ll continue accelerating your career through advanced engineering and leadership development, personalized career mapping, enhanced learning opportunities, cohort learning, and dedicated mentorship. The salary range for this position is $78,000 \- $84,400 per year with scheduled increases at the sixth and twelfth months of employment. In addition to the base salary, Perdue offers a competitive benefits package, including medical/Rx, 401(k) with employer match after 1 year, critical illness, accident insurance, dental, vision, life insurance, optional group life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability protection, flexible spending accounts and paid time off. **Schedule**: Department and shift assignments will vary throughout the rotational program and will be determined based on the participant’s assigned rotation and business needs. Specific schedules will be communicated prior to each rotation. **Principal Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **EMT I 0\-6 months** * Participate in structured rotations across key operational, support, and engineering areas to build an end\-to\-end understanding of plant operations, production systems, engineering work processes, interdepartmental communication, and the connection between engineering decisions and business results. * Learn and apply Perdue’s expectations for associate safety, food safety, quality, environmental compliance, engineering standards, and operational requirements while working alongside experienced engineers, project managers, maintenance leaders, operations leaders, and frontline associates. * Develop working knowledge of project management, technical engineering, capital project execution, engineering work processes, facility infrastructure, equipment and production systems, and project documentation through hands\-on learning and ob project updates, performance results, schedule or budget risks, technical challenges, and improvement opportunities to engineering leadership and cross\-functional partners; prepare and deliver presentations on assigned projects or engineering topics. * Develop working knowledge of capital planning and forecasting by supporting project prioritization, cost estimates, spend tracking, and longer\-term capital planning activities within established guidelines. * Demonstrate readiness for an Associate Plant Engineer or comparable engineering assignment by independently leading defined project activities, making sound decisions within established guidelines, escalating risks appropriately, and balancing safety, compliance, quality, scope, schedule, cost, and operational priorities. * Continue participating in Pathways cohort learning and leadership development, including topics such as continuous improvement, associate and food safety, project management, leading cross\-functional teams, business acumen, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and presenting to leadership, while applying those learnings to the workplace. **Minimum Education and Experience** * Minimum cumulative GPA of 3\.0\. * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university completed within 24 months of the Pathways Program start date. * For the June 2027 program, eligible graduation dates include: May 2025 – May 2027 * Preferred degree concentrations include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or a related field. * Demonstrated leadership potential and interest in a career in engineering, project engineering, or project management. * Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and influence across business functions. * Ability to work well within a team setting, as well as independently. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced manufacturing and project environment. * Must be willing to travel to Perdue facilities and project sites for rotations, meetings, project work, and development opportunities. * Must be willing to relocate for career opportunities. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office; AutoCAD experience. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Project management, construction, manufacturing, maintenance, or engineering\-related experience. **Physical Requirements and Environmental Factors** * Position is active in project and plant environments, where floor activities such as troubleshooting, field verification, project execution, and redesign of existing systems may be routine. * Ability to move throughout plant, office, construction, feed mill, hatchery, wastewater, and other facility environments as applicable, including accessing equipment, files, supplies, ladders, stairs, and work areas. * May be exposed to wet or moist floors, metal or plastic grating, temperature and humidity extremes, noise, chemicals, operating equipment, and other conditions associated with poultry processing and industrial environments. * May need to move equipment occasionally and perform bending, twisting, reaching, lifting up to 50 lbs., sitting, standing, walking, and grasping depending on the project or task required. * Must use and/or wear protective and safety equipment required for the job and follow applicable safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout where required. * Must be able to work at heights and on or around operating equipment as required by the assignment. *Perdue Farms Inc. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

jobs.description: Perdue Foods has a goal of becoming the most trusted name in premium proteins by creating products for consumers and for retail and foodservice customers around the globe while changing the way animals are raised for food. It is part of Perdue Farms, a fourth\-generation, family\-owned food and agricultural business deeply rooted in tradition yet with a forward\-thinking mindset. We believe that success starts with our people, and our culture is built on a foundation of teamwork, integrity, and respect, where every voice matters and everyone is encouraged to contribute to our shared goals. We are dedicated to creating a supportive, inclusive environment where associates feel valued and inspired to make an impact, both within the company and in the communities we serve. From promoting growth and development to prioritizing work\-life balance, we’re committed to helping our team members thrive. **That's Perdue.** **Summary** Are you ready to launch your career as a future engineering leader at Perdue? As part of our Engineering Management Trainee (Pathways) Program, beginning in June 2027, you’ll embark on a 24\-month leadership development journey designed to prepare the next generation of engineering leaders. Through hands\-on learning, meaningful projects, structured rotations, mentorship, and leadership development, you’ll gain real\-world experience in plant operations, engineering work processes, project management, and capital project execution while building the technical and leadership skills needed to make a lasting impact. During your first year, you’ll explore key engineering, operational, and support areas and develop a strong foundation in engineering practices, project execution, and plant operations before transitioning into an engineering leadership assignment. Your second year will accelerate your growth through personalized development, mentorship, cohort learning, meaningful project work, and advanced technical experiences designed to prepare you for long\-term success. This program is ideal for motivated, curious, and driven individuals who are eager to learn, take on meaningful challenges, and build a rewarding career helping drive innovation, operational excellence, and continuous improvement at Perdue. **Benefits** * Participate in up to two (2\) Regional Pathways Training events alongside fellow participants from across the organization. These experiences include leadership development, networking opportunities, company tours, community service initiatives, social events, and direct interaction with senior leaders. * Competitive hourly pay during EMT I, with transition to a salaried, exempt position upon successful progression to EMT II at approximately six months, and an additional scheduled pay progression at 12 months. * Comprehensive benefits package, including a transition bonus and relocation assistance for eligible participants. * Opportunity to advance into an Associate Plant Engineer or comparable engineering assignment upon successful completion of the first 12 months of the Pathways Program, based on business need and demonstrated readiness. * During your second year, you’ll continue accelerating your career through advanced engineering and leadership development, personalized career mapping, enhanced learning opportunities, cohort learning, and dedicated mentorship. **Schedule**: Department and shift assignments will vary throughout the rotational program and will be determined based on the participant’s assigned rotation and business needs. Specific schedules will be communicated prior to each rotation. **Principal Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** **EMT I 0\-6 months** * Participate in structured rotations across key operational, support, and engineering areas to build an end\-to\-end understanding of plant operations, production systems, engineering work processes, interdepartmental communication, and the connection between engineering decisions and business results. * Learn and apply Perdue’s expectations for associate safety, food safety, quality, environmental compliance, engineering standards, and operational requirements while working alongside experienced engineers, project managers, maintenance leaders, operations leaders, and frontline associates. * Develop working knowledge of project management, technical engineering, capital project execution, engineering work processes, facility infrastructure, equipment and production systems, and project documentation through hands\-on learning and observation. * Support daily engineering and operational activities under the direction of experienced leaders, gaining exposure to project meetings, equipment layouts, technical documentation, project schedules, cost considerations, field activities, and issue escalation. * Build relationships with frontline associates and cross\-functional partners while demonstrating teamwork, integrity, respect, accountability, and a willingness to learn. * Use operational, project, and project updates, performance results, schedule or budget risks, technical challenges, and improvement opportunities to engineering leadership and cross\-functional partners; prepare and deliver presentations on assigned projects or engineering topics. * Develop working knowledge of capital planning and forecasting by supporting project prioritization, cost estimates, spend tracking, and longer\-term capital planning activities within established guidelines. * Demonstrate readiness for an Associate Plant Engineer or comparable engineering assignment by independently leading defined project activities, making sound decisions within established guidelines, escalating risks appropriately, and balancing safety, compliance, quality, scope, schedule, cost, and operational priorities. * Continue participating in Pathways cohort learning and leadership development, including topics such as continuous improvement, associate and food safety, project management, leading cross\-functional teams, business acumen, problem\-solving, decision\-making, and presenting to leadership, while applying those learnings to the workplace. **Minimum Education and Experience** * Minimum cumulative GPA of 3\.0\. * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university completed within 24 months of the Pathways Program start date. * For the June 2027 program, eligible graduation dates include: May 2025 – May 2027 * Preferred degree concentrations include Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or a related field. * Demonstrated leadership potential and interest in a career in engineering, project engineering, or project management. * Strong written and verbal communication, interpersonal, analytical, problem\-solving, and organizational skills. * Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams and influence across business functions. * Ability to work well within a team setting, as well as independently. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and work in a fast\-paced manufacturing and project environment. * Must be willing to travel to Perdue facilities and project sites for rotations, meetings, project work, and development opportunities. * Must be willing to relocate for career opportunities. * Working knowledge of Microsoft Office; AutoCAD experience. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Project management, construction, manufacturing, maintenance, or engineering\-related experience. **Physical Requirements and Environmental Factors** * Position is active in project and plant environments, where floor activities such as troubleshooting, field verification, project execution, and redesign of existing systems may be routine. * Ability to move throughout plant, office, construction, feed mill, hatchery, wastewater, and other facility environments as applicable, including accessing equipment, files, supplies, ladders, stairs, and work areas. * May be exposed to wet or moist floors, metal or plastic grating, temperature and humidity extremes, noise, chemicals, operating equipment, and other conditions associated with poultry processing and industrial environments. * May need to move equipment occasionally and perform bending, twisting, reaching, lifting up to 50 lbs., sitting, standing, walking, and grasping depending on the project or task required. * Must use and/or wear protective and safety equipment required for the job and follow applicable safety procedures, including Lockout/Tagout where required. * Must be able to work at heights and on or around operating equipment as required by the assignment. *Perdue Farms Inc. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior Associate Scientist - Conjugation Process Development
jobs.description: **What You Will Achieve** A Senior Associate Scientist (R2\) position is available in the Conjugation Process Development group of Bioprocess R\&D in USA \- WA \- Bothell. We’re seeking a passionate and creative individual to join a dynamic team of scientists and engineers focused on developing robust, scalable, and high productivity conjugation processes for the manufacture of antibody\-drug conjugates (ADCs) for early\- and late\-phase clinical programs. The work will also involve working with commercial and clinical production facilities to ensure accurate technology transfer and successful large\-scale production. You may also be involved in cutting\-edge technology development projects that seek to discover new innovations for ADC process development and/or manufacturing. **How You Will Achieve It** * Design, plan, and execute milligram to gram\-scale conjugation experiments in the development laboratory. * Ensures timely, effective, and high\-quality documentation in electronic laboratory notebooks and internal technical reports. * Communicate results and findings to stakeholders on a regular basis; present data/strategy to colleagues and management in internal and external venues (technical meetings, project team meetings, and conferences, etc.) as appropriate. * Assist in or lead the technology transfer of manufacturing processes to clinical and commercial manufacturing facilities. Provide support and troubleshoot during manufacturing campaigns as needed. * Work collaboratively with colleagues both within the group and cross\-functionally; contribute to maintaining and improving upon our safe, effective and efficient lab operations. **Qualifications** **Must\-Have** * BS/BA in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Chemical/Biochemical Engineering, or other related disciplines with 3\-4 years of experience, or MS in the above fields with 0\-2 years of experience. * Relevant research experience in a laboratory setting. * Ability to grasp scientific concepts, interpret complex data, and formulate new hypothesis. * Competency in standard biochemical lab techniques and the ability to design and carry out complex experiments and interpret data. Demonstrated effectiveness in collaborative projects, and ability to communicate effectively with scientists and management in a highly matrixed organization. * **Nice\-to\-Have** * Practical knowledge and/or experience with bioconjugation, protein purification, analytical biochemistry, scale up, GLP/GMP practices, and technology transfers to manufacturing sites. * Team oriented, with excellent oral and written communication skills. * Well organized and great attention to detail. Work Location Assignment: On Premise The annual base salary for this position ranges from $68,600\.00 to $114,300\.00\. systems and database settings for new cells and parts for traceable content. * Program PLCs, barcode readers, HMIs, Robots, and PCs as necessary. * Modify and upgrade as required existing production equipment. * Help develop and maintain cost effective general specifications and standards for machine controls and programming. * Coordinate all project controls/electrical activities to ensure that A ServiceNow\-invested company, Prodapt has been recognized by Gartner as a Large, Telecom\-Native, Regional IT Service Provider. jobs.title: Lead Engineer - Full Stack (Remote)
jobs.description: **Progressive Leasing** is a leading provider of in\-store and e\-commerce lease\-to\-own solutions. With more than 20 years in FinTech, we’ve grown from start\-up to industry leader by innovating, simplifying, and valuing people. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with three business segments: Progressive Leasing, Purchasing Power (a leading employee purchase program for consumer products and services using payroll deduction), and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform. Progressive Leasing is a leading provider of in\-store and e\-commerce lease\-to\-own solutions. As an almost 20\+ year old FinTech company that has gone from start\-up to industry leader, we know how to innovate, simplify, and value all people. We are a company founded on our grit and we are constantly looking to the future. As an ever\-evolving group of entrepreneurs and technologists, we strive to do the right thing period in all aspects of our work. We are a subsidiary of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), an exciting FinTech holding company, with three business segments including Progressive, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform. We are currently hiring a **Lead Engineer \- Full\-Stack (Remote)** to help grow our company and ensure our mission is achieved! This is a remote\-eligible role that can be performed from anywhere in the continental US or from our corporate headquarters in Draper, Utah. As a Lead Engineer, you will own the architecture and delivery of full\-stack solutions, guide a distributed engineering team, and drive technical strategy that aligns with product goals across web and API layers. *This role is a work from home position and can be performed remotely anywhere in the continental US or in our corporate office in Draper, Utah.* *Employee Value Proposition (EVP): PROG is dedicated to providing people with opportunity; opportunity for inclusive collaboration, opportunity for innovation, and opportunity for development.* **WE ARE:** A technology organization dedicated to designing and delivering winning engineering and product strategies in a fun and engaging environment. We provide our employees with challenging opportunities where passion, tenacity, innovation and diligence are rewarded. We want your passion, your creativity and your mastery in rallying support for the ideas that will advance our initiatives. With your broad technical and strategic expertise, you will plan, architect and implement highly effective engineering, platform and operational strategies, solutions and initiatives to drive adoption and scale for our clients. **YOU ARE:** A software professional who leads with technical depth and delivers solutions for complex, large\-scale business problems. You are equally at home in an Angular / C\# API codebase, designing a BFF architecture, and mentoring engineers across time zones. You create and deliver customized experiences for customers across all channels. **YOUR DAY\-TO\-DAY:** **Technical Leadership** * Own the architecture, quality, and delivery of the Angular application and related APIs/services * Define and enforce coding standards, patterns, and best practices across mobile and full\-stack development; drive the adoption of an A.I. first engineering mindset * Drive technical roadmap decisions and align them with product goals, timelines, and the broader engineering organization * Provide technical expertise in architecture, design, testing, and implementation — spanning web UI through backend API contracts and LLM integration patterns * Lead in\-depth code reviews and conduct root cause analysis of critical production issues * Actively engage in and may influence the direction of industry groups or open\-source communities **Delivery \& Execution** * Own end\-to\-end delivery of web features from technical scoping through release and production monitoring * Break down complex requirements into actionable engineering tasks, milestones, and clear ownership across a distributed team * Identify and proactively mitigate technical risk throughout the development lifecycle * Maintain and improve CI/CD pipelines and release management processes for both platforms * Create and maintain best practices for observability and logging for all layers of the application * Develop and deploy solutions with performance, security, and accessibility in mind from the start **Team \& Collaboration** * Lead and mentor a geographically distributed team across two hubs (Americas and India), fostering strong engineering culture and clear accountability across time zones * Work collaboratively with technical and business team members (Product, Design, QA, Backend) to develop and maintain business solutions following Agile principles * Initiate and lead efforts toward organizational goals; be influential in building a dynamic, productive engineering organization and continuously improving practices * Participate in hiring — reviewing resumes, conducting technical interviews, and evaluating candidates; jobs.title: Internship - Scientific Software and Compilation
jobs.description: **About QuEra Computing, Inc.** QuEra Computing is building the world's most powerful neutral\-atom quantum computers. Our systems are designed to scale and enable groundbreaking advances in science and technology. We collaborate closely with leading academic and industry partners to push the boundaries of quantum computing, error correction, and fault tolerance. **Summary** QuEra Computing Inc. seeks creative and collaborative Scientific Software Interns to help advance the software that connects high\-level quantum applications to neutral\-atom quantum computers. Working with software engineers, experimental and computational physicists, and a community of industry and academic collaborators, you will contribute to research and engineering at the intersection of programming languages, compilers, and quantum computing. We offer a range of research and engineering projects, from investigating new compilation methods and developing prototypes to building software infrastructure and integrating with quantum hardware. Projects span quantum circuits, atom movement, and pulse\-level control. Each intern will work with a mentor on a project matched to their interests, experience, and team priorities. Our compiler stack is evolving from Python toward Rust, creating opportunities to contribute to existing tools, including our open\-source compiler framework Kirin, as well as new infrastructure. Depending on the project, your contributions may include algorithms, research findings, benchmarks, or tested and documented software that supports the next generation of neutral\-atom quantum computing. **Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and those received before Nov. 15, 2026 are guaranteed full consideration.** **Internship terms are flexible, including outside the summer, and can be arranged around candidates' availability.** **Responsibilities** Responsibilities will vary by project and may include: * Investigate research questions in quantum compilation, programming languages, or scientific software; develop prototypes and evaluate approaches through experiments and benchmarks * Develop domain\-specific languages, intermediate representations, compiler analyses, and transformations for quantum circuits, atom movement, or pulse\-level control * Build and improve compiler infrastructure in Rust or Python, and support integration with quantum hardware platforms * Collaborate with your mentor, software engineers, and physicists to define project goals, discuss technical approaches, and communicate results * Contribute tests, documentation, and reproducible examples or experiments appropriate to your project **Qualifications** * Experience programming in Python, Rust, or another relevant language, and willingness to learn the tools needed for your project * A foundation in computer science or computational methods, demonstrated through coursework, research, personal projects, or other relevant experience * Interest in research, software engineering, or both, applied to compilers and scientific software for quantum computing * Ability to approach technical problems systematically and communicate ideas, questions, and results clearly * Enthusiasm for collaborative work and for building tools used by researchers and developers **Preferred Qualifications** The following backgrounds are relevant to different projects; applicants are not expected to have experience in all of them: * Academic training or research in computer science, physics, applied mathematics, or a related field * Experience with compiler development, intermediate representations such as Static Single Assignment (SSA), program analysis, or optimization * Knowledge of programming language design, type systems, or programming language theory * Experience with Rust, systems programming, or Python\-based scientific software * Experience designing experiments, evaluating algorithms, or developing reproducible benchmarks * Familiarity with quantum computing, quantum error correction, or atomic, molecular, and optical (AMO) physics * Experience with version control, code review, testing, debugging, profiling, or contributions to open\-source projects **Why Join QuEra?** You will be part of a collaborative, fast\-moving team at the forefront of quantum technology. This internship offers exposure to both cutting\-edge theory and practical implementation, with opportunities to contribute to peer\-reviewed research and real\-world quantum hardware development. *On\-site internship. There is no relocation offered for this role.* QuEra is committed to cultivating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description: **Company Description** Join Renesas, a renowned global leader in semiconductor solutions, as a Marketing Specialist and take your career to the next level! This is an incredible opportunity for someone passionate about B2B marketing and integrated marketing communications to make a real impact in a dynamic, collaborative environment. In this role, you will engage with diverse teams across the globe, expanding your professional network while working on exciting projects that drive innovation. If you thrive in a fast\-paced setting and enjoy managing multiple assignments, this is the perfect position for you. Your organizational skills and ability to adapt to shifting priorities will be crucial as you contribute to our mission of delivering cutting\-edge semiconductor solutions. **Job Description** The Marketing Specialist, NPI (New Product Introduction) Campaigns, drives the successful broad\-market launch of new Renesas products. Within the UX Marketing organization, you will plan, coordinate, and execute integrated marketing communications campaigns that build awareness, spark engagement, and drive lead generation across our product groups. **Roles \& Responsibilities** * Support the development and execution of integrated marketing campaign plans across advertising, email, social media, blogs, collateral, web and other digital channels. * Partner with product marketing and cross\-functional teams including graphics, web, email, events, PR and social media to coordinate campaign deliverables and timelines. * Contribute to the development of product launch messaging and campaign positioning based on guidance from key stakeholders. * Create and coordinate marketing communications content including email, digital advertising, landing pages, web content and promotional materials. * Track campaign activities, project milestones and deliverables to help ensure launches are completed according to schedule. * Coordinate cross\-functional campaign meetings, document actions and follow up with stakeholders on assigned deliverables. * Support event\-related marketing activities, including messaging, communications materials and event logistics as required. * Use marketing analytics and reporting tools to develop campaign summaries and monitor key performance indicators. * Analyze campaign performance and identify opportunities to improve messaging, content or campaign execution **Qualifications** * Approximately 2\+ years of relevant marketing, communications, project coordination or related professional experience preferred. Candidates with relevant graduate education, internships or substantial project\-based experience may also be considered. * Demonstrated ability to manage time effectively, organize priorities and solve routine project or execution challenges independently. * Ability to manage multiple projects and assignments simultaneously while maintaining attention to deadlines and detail. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare and present information to internal stakeholders. * Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional, collaborative environment and coordinate activities across different teams * Demonstrated ability to follow projects and deliverables through completion and proactively follow up with contributors to maintain project timelines. * Comfortable working within established marketing processes while adapting to changing priorities and business requirements. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including PowerPoint, Excel, Word and SharePoint, or comparable productivity platforms. * Prior exposure to digital marketing campaigns, content development, marketing automation, web content, events or campaign analytics is preferred. * Experience in B2B technology, semiconductor, electronics or other technical industries is preferred but not required. **Education**: * Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business or a related discipline preferred; relevant graduate education is a plus. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement. Renesas Electronics deals with dual\-use technology that is subject to U.S. export controls regulations. Under these regulations it may be necessary for Renesas to obtain U.S. government export license prior to release of technology to certain persons. The decision whether or not to file or pursue an export license application is at the sole discretion of Renesas.

jobs.title: Executive Director, Head of Commercial & Enterprise Applications
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** Revance is seeking a hands\-on, strategic leader to own the ongoing support, enhancement, and roadmap for our commercial and enterprise application portfolio. Reporting to the CTO, the Executive Director, Head of Commercial \& Enterprise Applications is accountable for the health, scalability, and continuous improvement of the systems that run our commercial and business operations, including the Salesforce platform (Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Loyalty Cloud, Service Cloud, Commerce Cloud), life sciences CRM (IQVIA OCE), ERP (Aptean Ross), contact center (Five9\), payment gateways, and sales training and marketing applications (Allego, Docebo, Exfluential, and others). This is a player\-coach role for a thought leader who builds best practices for scale, engineers quality in at the source, and drives toward a "zero incidents" support model. * **Reporting to:** Chief Technology Officer * **Location:** Nashville, TN; Dallas, TX; Los Angeles, CA; San Francisco, CA; or Johnson City, TN onsite (hybrid) * **Salary:** \*$225,000\-$250,000 \+ performance bonus \+ equity * *The final salary offered will depend upon factors that may include but are not limited to the quality and length of experience, education, and geographic location.* **What You'll Do:** **Platform Ownership** * Own the Salesforce platform end to end, spanning Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Loyalty Cloud, Service Cloud and Commerce Cloud, together with the life sciences CRM (IQVIA OCE) that the field force runs on. This platform is the core of the portfolio and the largest part of the role. * Ensure the CRM and Salesforce technology stack is architected to scale with a dynamic commercial business: a platform that absorbs new products, channels, geographies and commercial models without a rebuild, supported by a clean data model, configuration standards and disciplined release practices. * Drive tighter integration across the portfolio so the platforms operate as one system rather than a set of connected tools, creating a seamless experience for the field, for customers, and for the practices we serve. * Lead the implementation of new commercial technology, including Salesforce Commerce upgrades and the next wave of platform capability, from business case through delivery and adoption. * Own the ERP (Aptean Ross) and the order to cash flow it supports, ensuring the commercial front end and the ERP back end operate as a single process from quote through order, fulfillment, invoice and cash. * Own the remainder of the portfolio: contact center (Five9\), payment gateways, and sales training and marketing applications. **Delivery \& Partnership** * Lead and grow a team of business analysts, functional experts, solution architects and project managers; set clear standards for solution design, delivery, and documentation. * Direct third\-party partners handling programming, customizations, and managed services; own statements of work, delivery quality, and vendor performance. * Partner with the Data \& AI group's data engineering and integration team to define the integration and data architecture for the application portfolio and coordinate execution; drive integration alignment with platform vendors such as Aptean (Ross) and Salesforce. * Partner with business leaders across Commercial, Finance, Supply Chain, and Customer Service to translate business strategy into an application roadmap with measurable outcomes. **Thought Leadership \& AI\-Driven Improvement** * Serve as a thought leader for continuous improvement; create and institutionalize best practices, reusable patterns, and governance that let the portfolio scale with the business. * Leverage AI and automation to improve processes across the portfolio and the IT function itself — intelligent ticket triage, automated testing, agent\-assisted support, and workflow automation. * Evaluate emerging platform capabilities and rationalize the application landscape to reduce cost, complexity, and technical debt. **Business Process \& Change Management** * Lead business process analysis and re\-engineering with functional stakeholders before automating; ensure solutions simplify processes rather than codify inefficiency. * Drive user adoption through structured change management, training, and stakeholder communication for every major release. * Measure adoption and business value realization post\-go\-live and feed results back into the roadmap. **Operational Excellence \& "Zero Incidents"** * Build support processes and a maturity roadmap oriented toward zero incidents: proactive monitoring, root\-cause elimination, problem management, and resilient release practices. * Design solutions that minimize rework and error handling for IT: strong requirements discipline, architectural guardrails, automated testing, and quality gates in the DevOps lifecycle. * Establish and report on KPIs for system availability, incident and defect trends, delivery predictability, and business sati *What You'll Bring** * 12\+ years of progressive IT experience with 6\+ years leading enterprise application teams; pharmaceutical, biotech, or life sciences commercial systems experience strongly preferred. * Deep hands\-on Salesforce multi\-cloud expertise across at least two of Marketing, Experience, Loyalty and Service Cloud. This is the core of the role and is not flexible. Plus working ownership of at least one of: ERP (Aptean Ross or comparable), life sciences CRM (IQVIA OCE, Veeva), or contact center platforms (Five9 or comparable). * Full\-lifecycle experience implementing or replatforming a major CRM or ERP, from selection and design through deployment and stabilization. * Experience owning the quote to cash or order to cash process end to end across CRM and ERP, including the integration seam between them. * Proven track record building high\-performing internal teams while managing outsourced development and managed\-services partners. * Demonstrated success implementing ITIL\-based support models, DevOps practices, and quality\-first delivery that measurably reduced incidents and rework. * Financial stewardship: vendor spend management, license optimization, and building business cases for major initiatives. * Organizational change management experience driving adoption of new platforms and processes. * Experience applying AI/ML and automation to IT operations and business process improvement is a plus. * Strong executive presence: able to influence senior business stakeholders, communicate technical trade\-offs in business terms, and manage competing priorities. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field required; advanced degree preferred. **Minimum Qualifications:** * Doctorate degree \& 6 years of directly related experience, or Master's degree \& 8 years of directly related experience, or Bachelor's degree \& 10 years of directly related experience * 5 years of managerial experience directly managing people, projects, programs or resources **Company Summary:** Revance is a global company developing, producing, and distributing industry\-leading, differentiated products across aesthetics, skincare, and therapeutics. Revance drives innovation beyond convention to offer treatment options for individuals across generations. The Company's vision is to redefine excellence in aesthetics, skincare, and therapeutics through science\-powered innovation, with an unwavering commitment to its providers, patients, and consumers. Revance's award\-winning products are the result of robust research and development, a cornerstone for the Company, driven by renowned scientists. For more information about Revance, please visit us at www.revance.com. **What Revance invests in you:** * Competitive Compensation including base salary and annual performance bonus. * Flexible PTO, holidays, and parental leave. * Generous healthcare benefits, HSA match, 401k match, employer paid life and disability insurance, pet insurance, wellness discounts and much more! *This section of the job description is required by the American with Disability Act (ADA). The ADA requires that job descriptions reflect the physical and mental demands required to effectively perform the essential duties of the job. The ADA prohibits employers from discriminating against a "qualified individual with a disability" in all aspects of the employment relationship. A "qualified individual with a disability" is "an individual who meets the education, experience, skill, and other job\-related requirements of a position held or desired, and who, with reasonable accommodation, can perform the essential functions of a specified job."* *Revance is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.*

jobs.title: Senior Unreal Developer
jobs.description: : **Sr. Unreal Engine Developer – Remote in US or Hybrid in Cary, NC** We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence \- and questions into answers. If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world\-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more. **About the job** The Games Analytics team is looking for a Sr. Unreal Engine Developer to help grow our new division at SAS and prepare our projects for mature production and deployment pipelines. Join us in our quest to unlock the power of video game engines for analytics and digital twins, build specialized tools and connectors for publishers and studios, and develop new lines of business across the industry. This is a senior seat on a young team, which means the patterns you set — architecture, pipeline, coding standards — are the ones the division builds on for years. You will work on photoreal simulation with real production data behind it, mentor the developers coming up behind you, and have unusual latitude to shape how one of the largest analytics companies in the world uses real\-time 3D. **As a Sr. Unreal Engine Developer, you will:** * Lead the design and development of photorealistic digital twin environments in Unreal Engine 5, integrating real\-time simulation and visualization of industrial systems, robotic fleets and logistics operations at the visual fidelity, performance and interactivity an enterprise analytics platform demands. * Collaborate with optimization experts, IoT engineers and software architects to build immersive, data\-driven experiences, connecting Unreal Engine visualizations to real\-time telemetry, sensor inputs and machine learning output from SAS analytics pipelines. * Develop and optimize custom Blueprints and C\+\+ modules supporting advanced simulation logic, physical system behavior and user interaction; implement dynamic asset loading, level streaming and runtime procedural generation for digital twin scenarios that scale. * Evaluate, integrate and extend Unreal Engine plugins, including our group's own SAS Connector and the third\-party plugins our digital twin products depend on. * Drive best practices in Unreal Engine pipeline management, version control (Perforce, Plastic SCM) and cross\-functional integration with cloud services, REST APIs and digital twin orchestration layers. * Mentor junior developers and contribute to the long\-term technical strategy for digital twin innovation across the enterprise. * Be encouraged to participate in open\-source projects on behalf of SAS. * Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization's secure software development goals. * Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do. **Required qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field. Advanced degree preferred. * Minimum 8 years of professional experience developing interactive 3D applications with Unreal Engine, including expert proficiency in both Blueprints and C\+\+. * Production experience with Unreal Engine server/client architecture and network replication. * Experience integrating external data sources or APIs — JSON, REST, WebSocket or MQTT — into real\-time applications, ideally for simulation or enterprise use cases. * A portfolio of shipped real\-time 3D or simulation projects demonstrating photorealistic rendering, physics simulation or complex user interaction design. * Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications. **Additional competencies, knowledge and skills** * **Technical/Professional Knowledge \& Skills** – Keeps current with developments in real\-time 3D and applies deep engine expertise to solve difficult problems, evaluate trade\-offs and accomplish challenging technical goals. * **Collaborating** – Works cooperatively across engineering, analytics and art disciplines to help the team achieve its goals, sharing knowledge and giving and seeking feedback. * **Innovation** – Creates novel solutions with measurable value for internal and external customers; experiments with new approaches to solve work problems and seize opportunities. * Prior experience at a AAA game studio, or working directly on digital twin products. * Experience leading a team of five or more application developers. * Working understanding of analytical, statistical and optimization tools, particularly for ingesting and processing game event data. * Knowledge of at least one key SAS product — CI360, Intelligent Decisioning or Event Stream Processing. **World\-class benefits** Highlights include...* Comprehensive medical, prescription, dental and vision plans. * Medical plan options include: + PPO with low annual deductible and copays. + HDHP combined with a health savings account with a contribution from SAS (no access to on\-site health care center). * Onsite Health Care Center (HQ) that’s free to employees and family members enrolled in the PPO plan. There's a pharmacy too! Not local to HQ? The pharmacy will ship prescriptions for no additional charge! * An industry\-leading 401k plan. * Tuition Assistance Program and programs and resources to support your development * Generous time away including vacation time, a variety of paid holidays, and our much\-loved U.S. Winter Wellness Break between December 25 and January 1\. * Volunteer Time Off, parental leave and unlimited paid sick days. * Generous childcare benefits for all full\-time employees. **You are welcome here.** At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers. **Additional Information:** To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and should not require, now or in the future, sponsorship for employment visa status. SAS is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by law. Read more: Know Your Rights. Resumes may be considered in the order they are received. SAS employees performing certain job functions may require access to technology or software subject to export or import regulations. To comply with these regulations, SAS may obtain nationality or citizenship information from applicants for employment. SAS collects this information solely for trade law compliance purposes and does not use it to discriminate unfairly in the hiring process. *SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.* Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more. \#SAS

jobs.title: START-UP FOUNDING SENIOR FULL STACK ENGINEER
jobs.description: **START\-UP FOUNDING SENIOR FULL\-STACK ENGINEER** **Build what personal injury should have become 10 years ago.** You know where your Uber is. You know where your Amazon package is. After an accident? Patients, doctors and lawyers are still chasing calls, texts, paperwork and each other. **We’re fixing that.** HelpAfterAccident.com is building the coordination layer for accident recovery — **one intake, one journey, everyone connected.** We’ve already coordinated thousands of recoveries. Now we’re turning what worked manually into software and scaling it. We need a **Founding Senior Full\-Stack Engineer** who can build fast, make smart architecture decisions and own product from idea → production. **YOU SHOULD BE DANGEROUS WITH:** * Full\-stack product engineering * Modern front\-end \+ back\-end development * APIs, integrations \+ real\-time workflows * AI \+ automation * Cloud infrastructure * Databases, security \+ scalable architecture * Shipping without a giant team or perfect requirements We care less about your perfect tech stack and more about whether **you can actually build.** **THIS IS STARTUP LIFE.** **Full\-time. All\-in. Obsessive.** If you're looking for **9–5, weekends off and work\-life balance from day one, look elsewhere.** For the first **45–60 days: $500/month \+ founding equity options.** It's a prove\-it period for both sides. We're looking for someone who believes in what we're building and wants **real ownership** if we win. No layers. No committees. No hiding behind tickets. No waiting three days to solve a three\-hour problem. You'll work directly with the founder and have a real hand in **what we build, how we build it and what this company becomes.** **BEFORE YOU APPLY** Be prepared to provide **verifiable professional references.** **We verify who we hire.** We use independent third\-party and, where appropriate, official government verification resources to confirm **identity, work authorization, professional history and technical/coding skills.** If your experience is real, your skills are real and you want to build something from the ground up, **we want to talk.** **Remote \| Orlando HQ** **Nobody owns recovery. We will.** Pay: From $500\.00 per month People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Application Question(s): * 1\. STARTUP FIT This is NOT a corporate 9–5\. Expect a messy codebase, ambiguity, pressure, and long days/nights when shipping. Is this genuinely what you want? Yes/No 2\. COMPENSATION Initial compensation is $500/month. Those who convert to our long\-term core team may become eligible for increased compensation \+ equity under separately agreed terms. Do you understand and accept? Yes/No 3\. PROVE YOU CAN BUILD Send ONE link: GitHub, live product, app, startup, portfolio, etc. Add one sentence explaining what YOU built. 4\. AVAILABILITY How soon can you start? How many hours can you realistically commit daily/weekly during launch? 5\. YOUR STRONGEST SEAT A) Full Stack \+ DevOps \+ Architecture/Leadership B) Full Stack \+ Product/Frontend C) Backend \+ Platform/Infrastructure Pick ONE. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: MarkLogic Developer-3777
jobs.description: Overview: The MarkLogic Developer is responsible for the development, maintenance, and operational support of enterprise MarkLogic database platforms supporting content\-centric and metadata\-driven applications. This role builds and supports XML/JSON\-based data models, semantic data integrations, and search\-driven solutions using MarkLogic, following architecture and governance standards established by senior engineering staff. The MarkLogic Developer helps ensure performance, scalability, and data integrity across environments while supporting compliance, governance, and secure data access practices, and works closely with senior engineers, software engineering, data governance, and compliance stakeholders to support secure, high\-availability NoSQL platforms and enterprise search, metadata management, and data harmonization initiatives. Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain MarkLogic data models, including XML, JSON, and semantic (triple) data structures, in accordance with established architecture standards. * Build and optimize XQuery and SPARQL queries for search, ingestion, and transformation workflows. * Support ingestion pipelines, data harmonization flows, and metadata enrichment processes. * Assist with configuration and maintenance of MarkLogic clusters, including forests, databases, and indexes, under the direction of senior engineering staff. * Monitor system performance and support optimization efforts, including indexing strategies, search relevance tuning, and query efficiency. * Support capacity planning and provide input on high availability, replication, and disaster recovery configurations within MarkLogic. * Follow established standards for data modeling, metadata, taxonomy, and content structure governance. * Collaborate with application engineers and architects to support API\-driven and search\-first architectures leveraging MarkLogic. * Participate in database and content deployment pipelines, including version control, CI/CD integration, and automated promotion across environments. * Support compliance with SOC 2, ISO 27001, and applicable standards by implementing RBAC, compartmentalization, encryption, and audit logging within MarkLogic. * Support implementation of DataOps practices, including Infrastructure\-as\-Code (IaC), Configuration\-as\-Code (CaC), and Data\-as\-Code (DaC), for MarkLogic environments. * Contribute to enterprise data governance initiatives, including lineage, taxonomy alignment, and stewardship practices. * Produce documentation including data flow diagrams, runbooks, and operational procedures. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: **Education:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a closely related technical field. (Preferred) * Relevant certifications in NoSQL, MarkLogic, or data engineering. (Preferred) **Experience:** * 2\+ years of experience in database engineering or data platform engineering roles. (Required) * 1\+ years of hands\-on experience with MarkLogic Server. (Required) * Experience with document\-oriented, metadata\-driven, or semantic data platforms. (Preferred) * Experience with: * XQuery and/or Server\-Side JavaScript (SJS) * MarkLogic indexing, search configuration, and query optimization * Data ingestion frameworks (MLCP, Data Hub Framework, or equivalent) * Experience implementing or supporting security controls including RBAC, element\-level permissions, and encryption. (Required) * Experience working in CI/CD environments with automated deployment pipelines. (Preferred) * Experience using Git or other version control systems. (Preferred) * Exposure to DataOps or DevOps practices and tooling. (Preferred) * Experience with REST APIs, search APIs, and integration patterns involving MarkLogic. (Preferred) * Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2 or ISO 27001\. (Preferred) * Experience with cloud\-hosted MarkLogic deployments (Azure). (Preferred) * Familiarity with relational databases and hybrid architectures. (Preferred)

jobs.title: Software Developer Engineer in Test
jobs.description: **Software Developer Engineer in Test \- REST** **Role and Responsibilities** ============================= The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) will build robust, scalable automation frameworks that ensure our products remain high\-quality and reliable. The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) moves beyond basic script recording and is comfortable writing clean, maintainable C\# code. The Software Development Engineer in Test will leverage Playwright to create modern end\-to\-end test suites that move at the speed of our CI/CD pipeline. The Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) is expected to perform these and additional duties and responsibilities professionally and efficiently, contributing to the overall success of Liviniti:* **Framework Development:** Develop and maintain automated test frameworks from scratch using C\# and Playwright. * **Test Strategy:** Collaborate with developers and product managers to identify high\-risk areas and define automation coverage for web applications and APIs. * **CI/CD Integration:** Integrate automated suites into Azure pipelines to facilitate continuous testing and "shift\-left" practices. * **Code Reviews:** Participate in PR reviews for both application and test code, ensuring adherence to SOLID principles and clean code standards. * **Debugging \& Reporting:** Root cause analysis of flaky tests and production defects, providing detailed technical reports and metrics to stakeholders. * Ability to communicate QA status, progress, and risks to management * Advise team on project status and opportunities for improvement * Abide by all obligations under HIPAA related to Protected Health Information (PHI) * If a HIPAA violation is discovered, whether individually or by another, you must report the violation to the Compliance Officer and/or Human Resources. * Attend, complete, and demonstrate competency in all required HIPAA Training offered by the company * Flexibility to understand, appreciate, and embrace that this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice. **Required Skills and Competencies** ==================================== * Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools, and processes * 3–5 years of professional experience in software testing or development. * Strong proficiency in C\# and the .NET Core/6\+ ecosystem. * Proven experience using Playwright (preferred) or Selenium for cross\-browser testing. * Hands\-on experience testing RESTful APIs using tools like RestSharp or Playwright’s native API testing capabilities. * Ability to write SQL queries to validate data integrity and perform test data setup * Expert knowledge of Git (branching, merging, rebasing). * Snowflake experience * Microsoft Teams * Flow charts such as Lucid Charts * Understanding and some experience in Figma * Find cost\-effective solutions to improve monthly QA efforts * Ability to communicate effectively * Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment * Ability to troubleshoot problems in unknown situations and provide effective feedback on a path forward * Ability to work independently and make logical business decisions given general guidance * Ability to consolidate ideas and collaborate with cross\-functional working groups * Ability to communicate at all management levels within an organization, including internal, customers, vendors, and business partners. * Industry certifications in QA or testing (e.g., ISTQB certification). * Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban). * Knowledge of continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) processes. What We have to Offer Our benefits package is designed to keep our employees happy and healthy \- physically, mentally and financially.. * Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance * Disability and Life insurance * Employee Assistance Program * Remote work options * Generous Paid\-Time off * Annual Reviews and Development Plans * Retirement Plan with company match immediately 100% vested Supervisory Responsibility This position has no direct supervisory responsibilities. **Position Type and Expected Hours of Work** ============================================ * Full\-time/Salaried/Exempt. * Some flexibility in hours is allowed, but the employee must be available during the “core” work hours of 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM CT. We cover clients in all 50 states; work times must be adjusted to cover meetings in all time zones.
