jobs.description: Overview: Being good neighbors – helping people, investing in our communities, and making the world a better place – is who we are at State Farm. It is at the core of how we operate and the reason for our success. We're moving with urgency to become a Next Gen Good Neighbor, with technology that strengthens human connections and enhances the customer experience. As an employee, you'll spend less time navigating systems and more time applying judgment, empathy, and expertise in the moments that matter most. **HYBRID:** Qualified candidates (in or near hub locations listed below) should plan to spend time working from home and some time working in the office as part of our hybrid work environment. Hybrid work arrangement for Enterprise Technology is defined as residing with a 180\-mile radius of the Hubs and Corporate. **HUB LOCATIONS:** Dunwoody, GA; Richardson, TX; Tempe, AZ; or Bloomington, IL **SPONSORSHIP: Applicants are required to be eligible to lawfully work in the U.S. immediately; employer will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work authorization (e.g., H\-1B visa) for this opportunity.** Grow Your Skills, Grow Your Potential: Responsibilities: We are seeking data\-minded, software engineering candidates to help enable collection and sharing of digital data. As a member of this team, you will help connect our digital experience data into the larger State Farm data ecosystem. With a focus on enabling a simplified, seamless, efficient, and personalized “omni\-channel” customer experience across all internal and external State Farm interaction channels. This posting is for 3 software engineers in the Digital Insights enablement suite within Digital Experience. The primary role of the product suite is to ensure a user's digital journey is represented properly in data for reporting, analytics and optimization efforts. This position works horizontally across multiple product teams to enable collection of user experience data needed for analytic insights on product functionality. The product suite provides a great opportunity to learn about behavior analytics and building a comprehensive data trail of the journey for customers and associates, as well as exposure to many different applications and technologies used by various product teams in the organization. Our capabilities span many technologies including front end JavaScript, AWS services (Lambda, S3, SNS/SQS, ECS, Redis Cache), and APIs to enable the collection and exchange of data. The ideal candidates will have an eagerness to work through product development during various stages of ambiguity/uncertainty. Applicants are required to have a creative mindset, innovative spirit, and a demonstrated ability to harness the possibilities of technology. Qualifications: **Necessary Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of software development experience * Frontend JavaScript development * Experience with AWS tech stack (Lambda, CloudFront, Route53, Eventing Frameworks (SNS, SQS), S3, API gateway, Load Balancing, VPS, Subnets, Security Groups) * Knowledge of building AWS infrastructure using Terraform * Knowledge of version control, CI/CD pipeline, Unit testcases and DevOps * Strong oral and written communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical knowledge effectively * Demonstrated learning agility and the desire for continuous growth inside and outside of current role * Ability to apply broad technical acumen and experience to an iterative delivery approach. * A strong drive for results. * Ability to adapt and foster innovation, encourage diversity of thought, and incorporate new ideas. * Experience with web page tagging/tracking, native Android and iOS application tagging, script development \& testing, jQuery development, Java Script, .CSS manipulation, HTML, Browsers (Chrome, FireFox, Edge, etc.) \& Developer Tools, Single Page Architecture such as Ember, Angular, React, etc. * Demonstrated usage of AI tools to look for efficiencies, leverage as a thought partner for innovation, performing data validation, and assist in code development. **Preferred Qualifications:** * GIT, GitHub, GitLab, etc. around continuous integration and continuous delivery infrastructure * Containers \& container based APIs using a container frameworks Docker or Kubernetes * API development experience using Java, Spring boot Our Benefits: Because work\-life balance is a priority at State Farm, compensation is based on our standard 38:45\-hour work week!* Potential starting salary range: $97,000 \- $160,000 * + Starting salary will be based on skills, background, and experience + High end of the range limited to applicants with significant relevant experience * Potential yearly incentive pay up to 15% of base salary **At State Farm, we offer more than just a paycheck. Check out our suite of benefits designed to give you the flexibility you need to take care of you and your family!*** **Get Paid!** On top of our competitive pay, you are eligible for an annual raise and bonus. * **Stay Well!** Focus on you and your family’s health with our robust health and wellbeing programs. State Farm pays most of your healthcare premium, and we offer multiple healthcare plan options, including a high deductible plan. All medical plans provide 100% coverage for in\-network preventative care, AND you and your family have access to vision, dental, telemedicine, 24/7 mental health professionals, and much more! * **Develop and Grow!** Take advantage of educational benefits like industry leading training programs, top\-notch tuition assistance programs, employee resource groups, and mentoring. * **Plan Ahead!** Plan for those big moments in life with benefits like fertility/IVF/adoption assistance, college coaching, national discount programs, interactive monthly financial workshops, free financial coaching, and more. You can also start a savings account or consider financing through our State Farm Federal Credit Union! * **Take a Little “You” Time!** You will have access to our generous time off policies designed so you can plan around holidays, family events, volunteering, or just to take a relaxing day off. With the opportunity to initially earn up to 20 days annually plus parental leave, paid holidays, celebration day, life leave (40 hours/year), bereavement leave, and community service/education support days, there will be plenty of time for you! * **Give Back!** We offer several ways to give back through our Matching Gift Program, Good Neighbor Grant Program, and the Employee Assistance Fund. * **Finish Strong!** Plan for retirement using free financial advisors and a 401(k) plan with company contributions of up to 7% of your salary. **Visit our** **State Farm Careers** **page for more information on our** **benefits****,** **locations****, and the** **hiring process** **of joining the State Farm team!**

jobs.title: Oracle DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** We’re the world’s leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium. We are the way the world moves value – across borders, through cities and overseas. No other organisation can address the scale, precision, pace and trust that this demands, and we’re proud to support the global economy. We’re unique too. We were established to find a better way for the global financial community to move value – a reliable, safe and secure approach that the community can trust, completely. We’re always striving to be better and are constantly evolving in an ever\-changing landscape, without undermining that trust. Five decades on, our vibrant community reflects the complexity and diversity of the financial ecosystem. We innovate diligently, test exhaustively, then implement fast. In a connected and exciting era, our mission has never been more relevant. Swift now has a presence in 200\+ countries and legal territories to serve a community of more than 12,000 banks and financial institutions. **Role Summary** We are looking for a motivated and solution\-oriented **Oracle DevOps Engineer** to join our Database Platform team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong engineering instincts with a passion for automation and continuous improvement. The successful candidate will work closely with Oracle database specialists and platform engineers to automate operational processes, improve platform reliability, and deliver scalable solutions across the Oracle estate. We are less concerned with deep expertise in every Oracle technology from day one and more interested in finding someone who is curious, technically strong, and able to analyze problems, identify opportunities for improvement, and build practical automation solutions. This is a hands\-on engineering role where you will be expected to challenge manual processes, develop automation, and help evolve the Oracle platform using DevOps principles. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions for Oracle database administration and platform operations. * Write and maintain Ansible playbooks, roles, and automation workflows. * Develop Python and shell scripts to automate operational tasks, reporting, monitoring, and remediation activities. * Analyze recurring operational issues and transform manual procedures into reliable, reusable automation. * Support Oracle database platforms, including installation, configuration, patching, health checks, and lifecycle management. * Collaborate with DBAs, infrastructure teams, and application teams to deliver scalable platform solutions. * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure\-as\-Code practices. * Participate in problem management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, and automation standards. * Help drive a DevOps culture focused on efficiency, reliability, and operational excellence. **Required Skills \& Experience** * 3\-7 years of experience in a systems engineering, DevOps, platform engineering, or database engineering role. * Experience developing automation using **Ansible** . * Programming or scripting experience with **Python** , Shell scripting, or similar technologies. * Experience working in Linux environments. * Familiarity with source control systems such as Git and collaborative development practices. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. * Ability to identify repetitive work and engineer practical solutions to eliminate manual effort. * Strong communication and collaboration skills. **Oracle Database Experience** We are open to candidates with varying levels of Oracle experience provided they demonstrate strong automation and engineering capabilities. Ideal candidates will have experience with some of the following: * Oracle Database Administration * Oracle RAC * Oracle Data Guard * Enterprise Manager * Database performance analysis and tuning * Backup and recovery concepts * Database patching and upgrade activities **Training and mentorship will be provided to help successful candidates build their Oracle DBA expertise, platform knowledge, and database engineering skills. We welcome candidates with strong automation and DevOps backgrounds who are eager to learn and grow in the Oracle database domain.** **Desired Experience** * Jenkins, CloudBees, GitHub Actions, or other CI/CD platforms. * Infrastructure\-as\-Code and configuration management. * Monitoring and observability tooling. * REST APIs and automation integrations. * Experience supporting mission\-critical production environments. **What Success Looks Like** * Taking complex or repetitive Oracle operational tasks and transforming them into reliable, reusable automation. * Building and maintaining high\-quality Ansible playbooks, Python tooling, and automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and operational risk. * Proactively identifying inefficiencies and working with DBAs and platform engineers to deliver practical improvements. * Increasing the consistency, scalability, and reliability of database platform operations. * Demonstrating ownership from problem identification through solution implementation. * Continuously expanding your Oracle database knowledge while applying engineering and DevOps practices to modernize platform operations. * Becoming someone the team relies on to turn operational challenges into sustainable technical solutions. The estimated salary range for a new hire into this position in Virginia is $82,361 USD Annual to $152,955 Annual USD. Salary may vary depending on job\-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Our compensation packages include a competitive base salary and bonus opportunity for all employees contingent on personal and company performance. Our generous benefits program includes medical, dental, vision and life insurance with no premium costs for our employees and their families, and retirement plan plus matching 401k **.** **What we offer** *We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals – like you – with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone’s voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.* *We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation related to accessibility during your application or interview, please contact* *accessibility\-Sysgroup@swift.com* *or indicate this in your application.* *Please note that this mailbox is not monitored for general recruitment enquiries and should only be used for accessibility or accommodation\-related requests (for example related to vision, hearing or neurodiversity).* *All requests are confidential and will not affect your candidacy.* *Don’t meet every single requirement? At Swift, we are dedicated to building a workplace where people can bring their full selves and ideas to the team, so if you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single qualification.*

jobs.title: MFG & PROCESS TECHNICIAN II
jobs.description: **Digital Data Networks (DDN) Business Unit \| TE Connectivity** **The Opportunity** Join TE Connectivity's innovative Passive Optics organization as an **Technician II** and play a critical role in developing the next generation of optical connectivity solutions powering AI, cloud computing, and hyperscale data centers. You'll work alongside engineers and manufacturing teams to build, test, troubleshoot, and optimize optical systems, prototypes, and automation equipment that enable industry\-leading optical interconnect technologies. **Why This Role Matters** As demand for optical connectivity continues to accelerate, precision manufacturing and testing of optical components are more important than ever. Your hands\-on expertise will directly support the development of advanced optical products and manufacturing processes that power the world's most demanding computing and communication networks. **Job Requirements** -------------------- **Optical Assembly \& Testing** * **Optical System Preparation:** Assist development teams with cleaning and inspecting optics and other precision parts * **Fiber Optic Handling:** Prepare, ribbonize, splice, and test optical fiber and connector assemblies. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next\-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more. Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity. * Total Compensation \= Base Salary \+ Incentive(s) \+ Benefits **BENEFITS** * A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits. **EOE, Including Disability/Vets** **IMPORTANT NOTICE REGARDING RECRUITMENT FRAUD** TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. jobs.title: Civil Engineer - Mid
jobs.description: Overview: Tactica Solutions is searching for a Civil Engineer to lead asset planning for the installation’s facilities, transportation networks, and airfield pavements. This position uses PAVER and BUILDER data to assess infrastructure condition, develop lifecycle strategies, prioritize civil projects, and support sound investment decisions. The Civil Engineer also ensures data quality, coordinates with key stakeholders, and helps align infrastructure requirements with operational and mission needs. Location: Hickam Air Force Base, Hawaii.* Lead the development and continuous update of the Transportation Networks and Airfield Pavements (TNAP) AMP using PAVER data. Produce an annual TNAP AMP Report detailing network health, five\-year project requirements, and investment strategies. * Consolidate structural and architectural condition data from BUILDER SMS to develop comprehensive lifecycle strategies for base facilities. Provide Facilities Sub\-AMP inputs, including lifecycle cost analyses and risk\-based project prioritization lists. * Apply Air Force comprehensive asset management principles to score, rank, and align proposed civil projects with the installation’s overarching AMP goals. Develop an Integrated Priority List (IPL) of civil infrastructure projects mapped directly to AMP deficiencies. * Oversee quality assurance and quality control of facility and pavement condition assessment data to ensure AMPs are based on accurate, ground\-truthed metrics. Prepare quarterly SMS Data Quality Review Reports. * Coordinate with multiple flights and stakeholders to gather insights and ensure projects align with operational needs. Maintain documented stakeholder collaboration and communication logs. * Perform physical inventories—including plants and systems, real property installed equipment, occupants, and facility footprints—to ensure accurate assignment information. Conduct compliance inspections of installation\-leased or federally owned facilities every five years and historic properties every three years. Requirements: Education / Certification: * Bachelor’s degree in civil engineering or an equivalent field from an institution accredited in the United States. Required Experience: * At least 3 years of military facility/infrastructure experience. * At least 5 years of civil engineering experience. Position may require typing and reading from a computer screen. jobs.title: Data Management Specialist - Mid

access as personnel in\-process and out\-process. * Install and support NexGen IT, Sustainment Management Systems, Builder, Paver, Commercial Off\-the\-Shelf (COTS), and government\-developed applications on servers, desktops, and laptops. * Identify and troubleshoot computer, network, software, and job\-processing issues; coordinate resolutions with the Communications Squadron and other entities; and recommend corrective actions when standard procedures do not apply. * Serve as the Functional Systems Administrator (FSA) and Client Support Administrator (CSA) for NIPRNET, SIPRNET, and automated information system support; attend required meetings and complete required training. * Manage the lifecycle of CES computer systems and software, including tracking equipment and planning for future maintenance and replacement costs. * Provide ongoing technical support and work with customers to maintain efficient operations and minimize interruptions to Information Technology (IT) services. * Resolve hardware, software, system, and order\-delivery issues, and provide management with analyses for automating work processes. * Review purchase requests and statements of work to justify system enhancements and ensure equipment and applications are compatible with existing infrastructure. * Serve as the commander\-appointed Automated Data Processing Equipment (ADPE) Equipment Custodian (EC), manage IT hardware assets in accordance with Communications Squadron Equipment Control Officer (ECO) directives, and conduct annual inventories for commander approval. * Maintain secure Commercial Off\-the\-Shelf (COTS) software license records and conduct annual audits of servers and desktop computers to identify unauthorized software. * Manage the CES information systems security program as the Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO), ensuring compliance with Wing, Air Force (AF), and Department of Defense (DoD) Computer Security (COMPUSEC) standards, directives, and policies. * Administer the Information Assurance Awareness Program (IAAP) and ensure all personnel complete required annual security training. * Scan desktop computers, report security incidents, and ensure antivirus protection and security patches are properly installed. * Implement Time Compliance Network Orders (TCNOs) within required timeframes and follow established vulnerability and incident\-reporting procedures. * Coordinate with the base Communications Squadron Information Assurance (IA) office to assess Emissions Security (EMSEC) requirements, apply countermeasures, process waivers, report completion, and request periodic reassessments. * Safeguard and inventory Communications Security (COMSEC) materials, train authorized users, and maintain ISSO, COMSEC, and EMSEC continuity books using prescribed checklists. * Serve as the Information Assurance Manager (IAM) for installation Industrial Control Systems (ICS), ensuring systems are certified and accredited in accordance with Department of Defense (DoD) and Air Force (AF) information\-assurance directives. * Approve, manage, and annually validate ICS access privileges; reassess access requirements every three years and whenever mission, system, or operating requirements significantly change. * Grant access based on personnel training, qualifications, and functional duties, and control the activation and deactivation of Civil Engineer (CE) ICS accounts. * Ensure personnel responsible for configuration decisions and information\-assurance controls for Platform IT (PIT) and Platform IT Interconnections (PITI) maintain required DoD certifications. * Use administrative privileges to install software updates and patches and maintain approved Enterprise Information Technology Data Repository (EITDR) entries. * Document and track configurations for all CE\-owned, operated, and maintained ICS throughout their lifecycle, including contractor\-supported systems, and submit required annual compliance and noncompliance reports to higher headquarters. jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: General Responsibilities: Provide engineering and consulting services for a broad array of projects and clients. This may include performing and/or leading field investigations, engineering analysis, calculations, and recommendations, design and development of plans and specifications, observation and inspection, and the writing, preparation, and review of related reports for the services provided. Review drawings and construction to assure compliance with plans and specifications. Prepare proposals and cost estimates, track and evaluate project progress, budgets, and recommend changes. Research and resolve design and construction problems. Assign, review, and evaluate laboratory or field data for inclusion in reports. Apply sound engineering principles and be able to communicate complex engineering issues and concepts to technical and non\-technical clients and project teams. Services may be provided for existing or proposed projects in a variety of sectors, including for example public works, transportation, commercial, communications, energy, and industrial. Essential Roles and Responsibilities: * Follow safety rules, guidelines and standards for all projects. Participate in pre\-task planning. Report any safety issues or concerns to management. * Demonstrate quality practices and acumen. * Provide consistent quality standards on proposal and project delivery. * Proficient engineering professional responsible for managing and executing small projects of minimal complexity. * Assist in developing the scope of work for routine projects. * Assist in the preparation of cost estimates, specifications, and other project related documents. * Analyze data, and perform engineering calculations and analysis for PE review. * Conduct, coordinate or supervise field investigations, laboratory testing, and evaluation of respective data. * Develop plans, schedules, conducts, and/or coordinates detailed phases of assigned project work. * Work closely with senior\-level project manager and Professional Engineer of Record to gain project management and engineering experience. * Makes design recommendations, adaptations and modifications for review and consideration by the Professional Engineer of Record. * Prepares work scope, proposals and reports and plans investigations for approval by senior level professionals. * May supervise field staff including graduate/field engineers, engineering technicians, exploration teams, laboratory staff and other support personnel. * Interacts with client and project team in developing scope of services and communicating project progress. * Works under the supervision of a Professional Engineer and a Terracon Authorized Project Reviewer. Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering. * Minimum 1\-3 years’ experience. * Master’s degree in Engineering preferred. * A valid driver’s license with acceptable violation history may be required. About Us Terracon is a 100 percent employee\-owned multidiscipline consulting firm comprised of more than 8,000 curious minds focused on solving engineering and technical challenges from more than 200 locations nationwide. Since 1965, Terracon has evolved into a successful multi\-discipline firm specializing in environmental, facilities, geotechnical, and materials services. Terracon’s growth is due to our talented employee\-owners exceeding expectations in client service and growing their careers with new and exciting opportunities in the marketplace. Terracon was recognized as the \#1 firm in Asbestos and Lead Abatement. Terracon’s vision of “Together, we are best at people” is demonstrated through our excellent compensation and benefits package. Based on eligibility, role and job status, we offer many programs including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, 401(k) plan, paid time off and holidays, education reimbursement, and various bonus programs. About the Team Innovation and hands\-on practice come together in our geotechnical consulting services. We provide geotechnical services nationwide for a wide range of projects, drawing on six decades of historical geotechnical data, a fleet of more than 200 drill rigs, 140 accredited laboratories, and thousands of employees to quickly organize or capture site data wherever projects are located. From AI\-supported solutions and predictive technologies to geophysics and traditional exploration, we deliver precision, value\-added subsurface information and engineering and scientific expertise to solving our clients’ challenges and achieve their goals for project sustainability, quality, and efficiency. EEO Statement Terracon is an EEO employer. We encourage qualified minority, female, veteran and disabled candidates to apply and be considered for open positions. We do not discriminate against any applicant for employment, or any employee because of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender, disability, age, or military status.

jobs.title: Manager, Electrical Engineering (Embedded Controls)
jobs.description: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions** Office**Job Description** **To learn more about our Marietta, Ohio site, including the work we do, our culture, and what makes the location unique, visit our Marietta careers page and watch the site video:** **Marietta \| Thermo Fisher Scientific** **Embedded Controls Engineering Manager** **Location:** Marietta, OH (Onsite) Non\-Local candidates may be eligible for relocation support **Travel:** Up to 10% Domestic Travel **Lead the Technology Behind Products That Protect Critical Research** At Thermo Fisher Scientific, our mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As our **Embedded Controls Engineering Manager**, you'll lead the development of intelligent control systems that power our ultra\-low temperature (ULT) freezers, cryogenic storage systems, and controlled\-rate freezing technologies. These products safeguard life\-saving vaccines, biologics, cell and gene therapies, and irreplaceable scientific samples used by researchers, hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, and biotechnology organizations around the world. This is a hands\-on engineering leadership role where you'll guide embedded hardware and software development, influence product architecture, and lead a global team delivering next\-generation control solutions for a growing portfolio of innovative laboratory products. **What You'll Do** As the Embedded Controls Engineering Manager, you'll provide both technical leadership and people leadership while driving the embedded controls strategy across multiple product platforms. **Engineering \& Technical Leadership** * Lead a global team of electrical engineers, embedded software engineers, and engineering technicians located in North America and India. * Define and drive the embedded controls architecture and technology roadmap for Thermo Fisher's cold storage and cryogenic product portfolio. * Provide technical leadership for embedded firmware, hardware, sensing technologies, communications, and control algorithms. * Develop scalable, modular control platforms that support future product innovation and platform reuse. * Guide architecture decisions that improve product performance, reliability, manufacturability, and serviceability. * Support technology development and innovation initiatives that contribute to future products and intellectual property. **New Product Development** * Lead embedded controls development throughout the complete New Product Development (NPD) lifecycle. * Partner closely with Product Management, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality to deliver high\-quality products on schedule. * Support existing products while driving next\-generation platform development. * Collaborate with global manufacturing sites to ensure successful product launches and ongoing production support. **Software Development \& Systems Engineering** * Champion modern embedded software development practices using Agile methodologies. * Promote best practices for software architecture, coding standards, design reviews, version control, testing, and release management. * Drive requirements management, traceability, and documentation using tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git. * Lead development of system\-level specifications, verification strategies, and validation plans. **Quality \& Regulatory Compliance** * Ensure embedded hardware and software designs meet applicable regulatory, safety, and certification requirements including UL, IEC, CE, CSA, and other applicable standards. * Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to maintain design controls, risk analyses, verification, validation, and requirements traceability. * Support continuous improvement initiatives that enhance product quality, reliability, and compliance. **Leadership \& Team Development** * Build, mentor, and develop a high\-performing global engineering organization. * Allocate engineering resources across multiple programs and priorities. * Partner with project managers to develop project schedules, staffing plans, and budgets. * Foster a collaborative culture focused on innovation, accountability, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. **Technologies You'll Work With** You'll help shape the future of intelligent laboratory equipment using technologies such as: * Embedded C/C\+\+ * Embedded microcontrollers * Real\-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) * PCB design and schematic development * Analog and digital circuit design * PI/PID control algorithms * Sensors, actuators, and data acquisition systems * Serial communications (UART, SPI, I2C) * Ethernet, Wi\-Fi, and Bluetooth connectivity * Git, Jira, and Confluence * Automated testing and validation systems **Minimum Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. * Five or more years leading embedded hardware and software engineering teams. * Three or more years designing and developing embedded control systems for electromechanical products. * Experience with embedded firmware development using C/C\+\+. * Strong understanding of embedded system architecture, microcontrollers, and real\-time control systems. * Experience leading cross\-functional engineering teams through product development. * Strong communication, leadership, and project management skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline. * Experience developing products for regulated industries such as medical devices, laboratory equipment, or industrial controls. * Experience with PCB design, circuit simulation, and design for manufacturability. * Knowledge of embedded Linux or RTOS environments. * Experience with Qt framework or modern embedded user interfaces. * Familiarity with cloud\-connected or IoT\-enabled embedded systems. * Experience developing thermal control systems, refrigeration controls, or other precision electromechanical systems. * Knowledge of Lean manufacturing or continuous improvement methodologies. **What Makes You Successful** You are a collaborative engineering leader who enjoys solving complex technical challenges while developing high\-performing teams. You combine strong technical expertise with strategic thinking and enjoy influencing product direction from concept through commercialization. You thrive in an environment where innovation, quality, customer focus, and continuous improvement are valued every day. **Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific?** At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you'll have the opportunity to influence products that support scientific discovery and improve lives around the world. **We Offer** * Leadership opportunity with a global Fortune 100 company * Ownership of embedded controls architecture across a growing product portfolio * Opportunity to lead global engineering teams and drive next\-generation product innovation * Competitive compensation and annual incentive bonus * Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits beginning on Day 1 * 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan * Generous paid time off and company holidays * Tuition reimbursement and professional development opportunities * Career advancement within one of the world's leading science and technology organizations * A collaborative culture focused on innovation, inclusion, quality, and continuous learning If you're passionate about embedded systems, engineering leadership, and developing technologies that support scientific breakthroughs, we invite you to join Thermo Fisher Scientific and help shape the future of laboratory equipment used around the world.

jobs.title: Manager, Refrigeration Engineering
jobs.description: **Work Schedule** Standard (Mon\-Fri)**Environmental Conditions** Office**Job Description** **To learn more about our Marietta, Ohio site, including the work we do, our culture, and what makes the location unique, visit our Marietta careers page and watch the site video:** **Marietta \| Thermo Fisher Scientific** As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond. Whether our customers are accelerating life sciences research, solving complex analytical challenges, improving patient diagnostics and therapies, or increasing productivity in their laboratories, we are here to support them. **This is an onsite role in Marietta, OH.** DESCRIPTION: Join our Refrigeration Engineering team and contribute to innovation that enables customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. As Manager, Refrigeration Engineering (ULT), you will lead the design, development, and sustainment of cascade refrigeration systems supporting Thermo Fisher’s cold storage and ultra\-low temperature (ULT) product portfolio. In this hands\-on leadership role, you will guide a team of refrigeration engineers and technicians to deliver high\-performance, energy\-efficient, and compliant cooling solutions. You will partner closely with Product Management, Controls Engineering, Quality, and Regulatory teams to define refrigeration system and control requirements, maintain traceability, and ensure products meet customer, performance, and regulatory expectations throughout the product lifecycle. WHAT YOU WILL DO: **Refrigeration System \& Technical Leadership** * Lead and manage a global refrigeration engineering organization responsible for cascade vapor\-compression systems used in ULT freezers and cold storage platforms. * Own refrigeration system architecture and strategy aligned with product roadmaps and platform reuse initiatives. * Provide technical oversight for sealed\-system design, including compressors, heat exchangers, refrigerants, controls interfaces, and safety devices. * Drive modular, scalable, and reusable refrigeration solutions across multiple product platforms. **Simulation, Modeling \& Innovation** * Lead the use of thermal modeling, system simulation, and analytical tools to predict performance, efficiency, and reliability. * Guide design trade studies using modeling and empirical data to optimize system performance and energy consumption. * Champion advanced development initiatives to mature next\-generation refrigeration technologies and support intellectual property creation. **Product Development \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration** * Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and controls engineering teams through all phases of the toll\-gate NPD process. * Partner with manufacturing and operations teams to ensure robust design transfer and global production readiness. * Support products manufactured across multiple global facilities. * Contribute to component, sub\-system, and system\-level technology roadmaps. **Requirements, Compliance \& Traceability** * Partner with Product Management, Controls Engineering, Quality, and Regulatory to develop and maintain refrigeration and control requirements. * Ensure traceability from customer and regulatory requirements through verification and validation evidence. * Ensure refrigeration designs meet applicable regulatory and certification requirements (e.g., UL, IEC, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star). * Drive standardization of system\-level specifications, test plans, and validation methods. **People, Program \& Financial Leadership** * Develop budgets, resource plans, and schedules in partnership with NPD project managers and leadership. * Balance internal resources, global engineering contractors, and third\-party support. * Coach, mentor, and develop engineers and technicians to build technical capability and leadership depth. * Foster a culture of safety, quality, accountability, and continuous improvement. * Travel: Up to 10% domestic travel. REQUIREMENTS: **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, systems engineering, chemical engineering, physics, or related discipline * Coursework in thermodynamics, heat transfer, and fluid mechanics strongly preferred * Master’s degree preferred **Experience** * 5\+ years of experience leading teams in the design and evaluation of refrigeration or thermal systems * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience developing vapor\-compression systems for cold storage or HVAC/R products, cascade systems preferred. * Experience using natural refrigerants and other low GWP refrigerants in system designs. * Experience supporting regulated products (e.g., UL 61010, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, FDA, CE, CSA, Energy Star) * Experience with thermal system modeling, simulation, and performance testing * Experience analyzing empirical test data to guide design decisions * Familiarity with data acquisition systems, automated testing, and technical documentation * Familiarity with Lean / PPI methodologies and continuous improvement systems **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Strong foundation in vapor\-compression and cascade refrigeration systems * Expertise in thermal modeling, simulation, and performance optimization * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and root\-cause analysis skills * Experience using engineering tools such as EES, thermal modeling software, and Microsoft Office * Ability to translate complex technical concepts into actionable business decisions * Strong leadership, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills * Excellent organizational skills in a fast\-paced, multi\-project environment * Commitment to safety, quality, and operational excellence

jobs.title: Sr. Firmware Engineer
jobs.description: **Summary:** VIAVI (NASDAQ: VIAV) is a global provider of network test, monitoring and assurance solutions for telecommunications, cloud, enterprises, first responders, military, aerospace, and railway. VIAVI is also a leader in light management technologies for 3D sensing, anti\-counterfeiting, consumer electronics, industrial, automotive, government and aerospace applications. We are the people behind the products that help keep the world connected at home, school, work, at play, and everywhere in between. VIAVI employees are passionate about supporting customer success and we welcome people who bring their best every day to the company – to question, to collaborate and to push for solutions that will delight our customers.**Duties \& Responsibilities:** We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Sr. Firmware Engineer to join our innovative team at Viavi Solutions Inc. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, development, and testing of embedded firmware for our cutting\-edge network test and measurement solutions. You will play a key role in bringing new products to market and enhancing existing ones, working within a dynamic and collaborative environment. Job Responsibilities * Analyzes, designs, programs, debugs and modifies software. * Troubleshoots code for firmware (IC embedded code) applications. * Work often involves analog and digital hardware and software operating systems. * Position requires knowledge and exposure to hardware design. Typically programs in machine language, assembly language and high\-level languages (e.g., C, C\+\+). * Design, develop, and debug robust and efficient firmware for embedded systems, primarily in C/C\+\+. * Translate product requirements into detailed firmware specifications and architectural designs. * Implement and optimize device drivers, real\-time operating systems (RTOS) components, and communication protocols. * Conduct thorough unit, integration, and system\-level testing of firmware, including writing automated test scripts. * Collaborate closely with hardware engineers during board bring\-up and debugging phases. * Participate in code reviews, ensuring high\-quality, maintainable, and well\-documented code. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex firmware issues reported from internal and external sources. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of firmware development processes and tools. * Stay current with emerging technologies and best practices in embedded systems and firmware development. * Mentor junior engineers and share technical expertise within the team. Job Qualifications * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * 7\+ years of experience in embedded firmware development. * Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded systems development. * Strong experience with real\-time operating systems (RTOS) such as FreeRTOS, VxWorks, or similar. * Demonstrated experience with various communication protocols (e.g., I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet, USB). * Solid understanding of microcontroller/microprocessor architectures (e.g., ARM, MIPS). * Experience with hardware\-software co\-design and debugging using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and in\-circuit emulators/debuggers. * Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git). * Experience with network test and measurement equipment or similar high\-performance embedded systems is highly desirable. * Excellent problem\-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment. **Pre\-Requisites / Skills / Experience Requirements:** If you have what it takes to push boundaries and seize opportunities, apply to join our team today. VIAVI Solutions is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer – minorities/females/veterans/persons with disabilities. **Job Posting Pay Range:** 96,600 to 179,400 Exceptional qualifications, experience and location may impact salary. VIAVI offers a competitive benefits package that includes paid time off, health, life and disability insurance, 401(k), and a bonus program.

jobs.title: Design Infrastructure Engineer (EDA & Test)
jobs.description: WaveWorks makes wireless communication solutions for the next wave of connected devices. WaveWorks' unique technology provides extremely low cost, small form factor, and orders of magnitude lower power consumption, while achieving long operating range and high reliability. WaveWorks is expanding its engineering team and searching for high performing, dedicated individuals to help blaze new trails. **ROLE DESCRIPTION** WaveWorks is looking for a strong software and systems engineer to own the engineering environment its silicon team depends on. That environment is built on the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, alongside other EDA and lab tools. The role covers the software, compute, EDA, data and automation infrastructure behind chip design, bring\-up, characterization and test. The goal is an engineering environment that runs like a mature production system: reliable, reproducible and able to scale, with tooling and infrastructure work taken off the IC designers. The right person will be given authority to direct information and IT infrastructure for a complex, deep\-stack technology startup building a multi\-faceted platform. This is not a chip design role and not corporate IT. The engineer is the technical owner of the systems that let analog, digital and verification designers do their jobs, and the software generalist the silicon team turns to when a new need appears. EDA tools are the first priority, but the scope is deliberately broad. **EDA ENVIRONMENT** * Install, configure and maintain the Synopsys, Cadence and Siemens EDA tool suites, their license servers, and other EDA tools, and make them work together reliably in one design environment. * Own the knowledge of how the design environment is assembled, and document it so that it does not depend on any one designer. * Open and track support tickets, reproduce and report failures, coordinate work with vendors, and drive issues to closure. **COMPUTE AND ENGINEERING INFRASTRUCTURE** * Run engineering workstations, compute servers, shared storage, and access control. * Build reproducible development environments, software deployment, and automation, including CI\-style workflows around design and test. **TEST AND CHARACTERIZATION SOFTWARE** * Build bench\-test automation and instrument\-control software for silicon bring\-up and characterization. * Build the pipeline for test data: acquisition, experiment metadata, parsing, storage, statistical analysis, plotting and reports. * Build regression and automated test suites, and tools to compare results across devices, lots, temperatures, configurations and silicon revisions. **ENGINEERING DATA** * Organize design files, test data, generated artifacts and technical documentation so they are stored predictably, versioned, searchable, tagged with metadata, and available to the right people. * Own version control across engineering: Git for software, scripts and configuration, and design data management for design libraries and PDKs, with branching, release and access practices the whole team follows. * Structure engineering data so later analysis and automation are possible. **INTERNAL SOFTWARE** * Write the internal tools, scripts, data pipelines, hardware\-control software and build tooling that the silicon team needs, including one\-off software to unblock a hardware engineer. * Use AI coding agents and modern tools as a standard part of the work, to build internal software quickly and remove recurring manual overhead. **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** * BS in Electrical Engineering or a closely related field plus 3 or more years of software or systems engineering experience, or an MS plus 1 or more years. * Strong software engineering in Python and at least one other language, with a record of building and maintaining tools other engineers rely on. * Expert use of Git and version\-control workflows, including repository administration. * Deep Linux systems administration: servers, storage, networking, user and access management, and scripting. * DevOps practice: configuration management, reproducible environments, containers, CI, and automation of repetitive work. * Daily, effective use of AI coding agents and assistants in engineering work. * High autonomy and breadth: able to take ownership of an undefined problem, such as a new test suite, and deliver it without close direction. * Enjoys building critical infrastructure and wants to own it. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience administering Synopsys, Cadence or Siemens EDA tools, including license servers and design\-environment setup. * Familiarity with IC design flows, PDKs, and design data management. * Lab automation and instrument control for semiconductor bring\-up or characterization. * Data engineering and statistical analysis of large test data sets. * Experience working with EDA or other technical vendors on support and escalation. * Firmware or embedded software experience. * Experience at a semiconductor or hardware startup. With its unique technology, WaveWorks is positioned to meet the needs of a plethora of applications of wireless connectivity that are not well served by conventional wireless solutions. Join us as we work to capture this opportunity and become a significant force in wireless. WaveWorks is committed to a friendly and welcoming working environment, and has a comprehensive benefits package for full time employees. WaveWorks does not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religious affiliation, or any other legally protected status. WaveWorks is located in downtown Seattle, Washington.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI
jobs.description: If you’re passionate about building a better future for individuals, communities, and our country—and you’re committed to working hard to play your part in building that future—consider WGU as the next step in your career. Driven by a mission to expand access to higher education through online, competency\-based degree programs, WGU is also committed to being a great place to work for a diverse workforce of student\-focused professionals. The university has pioneered a new way to learn in the 21st century, one that has received praise from academic, industry, government, and media leaders. Whatever your role, working for WGU gives you a part to play in helping students graduate, creating a better tomorrow for themselves and their families. The salary range for this position takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. At WGU, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their position, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is: Grade: Technical 411 Pay Range: $161,000\.00 \- $249,500\.00**Job Description** WGU’s Student Experience team builds the student portal that working adults use to navigate their education, monitor progress, connect with mentors, and determine what comes next. The team is now developing an AI assistant integrated into the portal and grounded in WGU’s systems to answer students’ questions about their individual degree journeys. As a Staff Software Engineer, AI, you will be the technical center of this work. You will design and build the assistant’s production foundation, including retrieval, inference, guardrails, evaluation, observability, and a security model that isolates each student’s information. This is a hands\-on product engineering role for someone who wants to set technical direction while continuing to design, code, test, and operate software. You will help simplify WGU’s complex technology landscape from the student’s perspective while contributing to an ambitious effort to apply AI meaningfully within higher education. You will join a culture that encourages engineers to operate as inventors, frame undefined problems, and build solutions beyond the boundaries of individual backlog items. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Design and build the chat foundation for the student portal assistant, including retrieval over WGU content and data, inference integration, conversation state, and the supporting service layer. * Own the assistant’s security and privacy model, building authorization\-aware retrieval and generation that protect student information and meet FERPA obligations. * Build guardrails and governance capabilities, including input and output filtering, refusal and escalation paths, prompt\-injection resistance, audit logging, and explainability controls. * Establish evaluation, regression testing, and observability practices that measure groundedness, accuracy, quality, latency, and cost for nondeterministic AI outputs. * Design, build, test, and operate full\-stack portal features across services, APIs, data access, and user interfaces within an established Java and Angular environment. * Integrate the assistant with systems of record, identity providers, and internal services, and participate in production support and service restoration. * Mentor engineers through technical design, code review, and pairing while documenting decisions and modeling strong AI\-assisted development practices. **What You’ll Bring** --------------------- * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience building and operating production web applications and web services. * Demonstrated technical ownership beyond individual feature delivery, including leading the design and build of a significant system or initiative and influencing technical decisions beyond your immediate work. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience building LLM\-backed applications in production, including retrieval\-augmented generation, inference integration, and evaluation of output quality. * Full\-stack production experience with a server\-side language such as Java, Python, TypeScript/Node, C\#, or Go, and a modern front\-end framework such as Angular, React, or Vue. * Experience integrating with databases and with third\-party or enterprise systems in an existing infrastructure. * The ability to design for security, privacy, scale, reliability, and cost while communicating technical decisions effectively to engineering, security, governance, and business partners. Equivalent relevant experience performing the essential functions of this job may substitute for education degree requirements. Generally, equivalent relevant experience is defined as one year of experience for one year of education and is at the discretion of the hiring manager. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Production experience with AWS Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker, or comparable managed model platforms, along with AWS, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, or cloud\-native delivery. * Experience with authorization\-aware retrieval, multi\-tenant data isolation, vector databases, hybrid search, LLM evaluation and observability, red\-teaming, or prompt\-injection testing. * Experience with Angular, identity and access management, regulated data environments such as FERPA or HIPAA, established codebase modernization, or higher education technology. **What to Expect** ------------------ At WGU, our mission drives everything we do, including how we hire. Our interview experience is designed to give qualified candidates the opportunity to show their best work through meaningful conversations and collaboration. We thoughtfully review every application and invite forward the candidates whose experience and potential best align with the role and our mission. **Work Location** ----------------- This is a full\-time, in\-office position requiring five days per week in our Salt Lake City, Utah office, designed to foster the collaboration and connection that fuel our best work. **Travel Requirement** ---------------------- This position requires occasional travel of up to 20%, including required attendance at designated company summits (typically one to two per year). Additional travel may include conferences, visits to company locations, and other business\-related events as needed. Additional travel may be assigned as needed to support business requirements. \#LI\-SB1 **Position \& Application Details** Full\-Time Regular Positions (classified as regular and working 40 standard weekly hours): This is a full\-time, regular position (classified for 40 standard weekly hours) that is eligible for bonuses; medical, dental, vision, telehealth and mental healthcare; health savings account and flexible spending account; basic and voluntary life insurance; disability coverage; accident, critical illness and hospital indemnity supplemental coverages; legal and identity theft coverage; retirement savings plan; wellbeing program; discounted WGU tuition; and flexible paid time off for rest and relaxation with no need for accrual, flexible paid sick time with no need for accrual, 11 paid holidays, and other paid leaves, including up to 12 weeks of parental leave. How to Apply: If interested, an application will need to be submitted online. Internal WGU employees will need to apply through the internal job board in Workday. **Additional Information** Disclaimer: The job posting highlights the most critical responsibilities and requirements of the job. It’s not all\-inclusive. Accommodations: Applicants with disabilities who require assistance or accommodation during the application or interview process should contact our Talent Acquisition team at recruiting@wgu.edu. Equal Employment Opportunity: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic as required by law.

jobs.title: Director Site Reliability Engineer, AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: At **d\-Matrix**, we are focused on unleashing the potential of generative AI to power the transformation of technology. We are at the forefront of software and hardware innovation, pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Our culture is one of **respect and collaboration.** We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI. **Role Overview** d\-Matrix designs and manufactures purpose\-built AI inference silicon, and the infrastructure underpinning our engineering organization must be as reliable and scalable as the chips we build. This role builds and leads d\-Matrix's Site Reliability Engineering function from the ground up, owning the infrastructure that development, validation, and customer\-facing deployments run on — spanning colocation facilities, on\-premises lab clusters, cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), and customer\-facing platform services. You will hire and grow the team, set technical direction, own SLOs for critical systems, and serve as the senior escalation point for incidents, all while remaining hands\-on. You will partner closely with Software Tools, QA DevOps, and Engineering teams whose workflows run on this infrastructure, as well as Networking Operations and IT Operations, to drive reliability, cost efficiency, and the removal of technical debt. **What You Will Do** * Build and lead the SRE function from scratch — define its charter, establish SRE as a discipline across hardware and software engineering, and hire, develop, and retain a team of 1–3 SRE engineers. * Direct a dedicated Data Center \& Lab Technician team, setting work priorities and operational standards across on\-premises and colocation facilities. * Own 24×7 reliability across colocation, on\-premises lab clusters, cloud, and customer\-facing platform services, designing for failure domains, progressive delivery, and strict change control. * Establish SRE process from zero: define SLIs/SLOs and error budgets, design on\-call rotations (including a follow\-the\-sun model as d\-Matrix expands globally), and build the incident and RCA management framework. * Own the full observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, Splunk or equivalent), instrumenting metrics, traces, and logs for SLO visibility and alert design. * Drive IaC\-first automation (Terraform, Ansible) and build self\-healing infrastructure — host lifecycle automation, fleet auto\-remediation, and AIOps\-driven alerting. * Own FinOps and capacity planning across cloud, colocation, and on\-premises tiers, including spend attribution, TCO modeling, and workload placement decisions. * Lead the migration from ad\-hoc JBOD storage to an enterprise\-grade shared storage platform spanning on\-prem, colocation, and cloud, including architecture, vendor selection, and DR design. **What You Will Bring** * Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field; 15\+ years in SRE, infrastructure engineering, or production engineering. * 5\+ years leading SRE or infrastructure engineering teams, including experience building or significantly rebuilding a function, not just managing a steady\-state team. * Demonstrated track record of establishing SRE as a discipline in an organization that lacked it: defining SLOs, creating on\-call frameworks, standing up observability, and driving cultural change with teams coming from a reactive ops background. * Deep Linux systems expertise: bare\-metal operations, enterprise shared storage platforms (NAS/SAN, NFS/SMB at scale, snapshot and replication architectures), and hybrid\-cloud storage integration. * Proven experience operating colocation and on\-premises hardware at scale: server lifecycle, power and cooling awareness, rack\-level networking. * Hands\-on Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and Ansible at production scale — module design, remote state, environment isolation, and change governance. * Kubernetes cluster operations: lifecycle management, workload reliability, storage, and RBAC at scale. * Full observability stack ownership (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog and/or Splunk or equivalent) for SLO definition, alert design, and end\-to\-end signal quality. * Strong Python and/or Go scripting for production services and automation that safely touches real infrastructure. * Executive communication skills, translating infrastructure health and operational risk into clear narratives for senior leadership, including non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to operate in a high\-ambiguity, low\-process environment, building structure rather than inheriting it. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience operating customer\-facing infrastructure or platform services, with reliability expectations beyond internal tooling. * Knowledge of high\-speed interconnect fabrics (InfiniBand, RoCE, or NVLink) — setup, troubleshooting, and performance tuning. * HPC job scheduler experience (Slurm, LSF, or equivalent) — setup, tuning, and integration with infrastructure automation. * Multi\-cloud hybrid operations across AWS, Azure, and GCP alongside on\-prem/colo, with unified observability and IaC. * FinOps expertise: cloud spend attribution, TCO modeling across cloud vs. on\-prem vs. colo, and translating cost data into workload placement recommendations. * ITIL knowledge or an equivalent structured incident/problem/change management framework. * Published technical writing, conference talks, or open\-source contributions in reliability, observability, or HPC infrastructure. **Equal Opportunity Employment Policy** **d\-Matrix** is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed and empowered to do their best work. We hire the best talent for our teams, regardless of race, religion, color, age, disability, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, ancestry, genetic information, marital status, national origin, political affiliation, or veteran status. Our focus is on hiring teammates with humble expertise, kindness, dedication and a willingness to embrace challenges and learn together every day. **d\-Matrix** does not accept resumes or candidate submissions from external agencies. We appreciate the interest and effort of recruitment firms, but we kindly request that individual interested in opportunities with d\-Matrix apply directly through our official channels. This approach allows us to streamline our hiring processes and maintain a consistent and fair evaluation of al applicants. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Compensation Range: $195K \- $285K

jobs.title: Senior Director of Communications (United States)
jobs.description: **We're** **Karat****, the world's largest interviewing company.** ------------------------------------------------------------------ Karat is transforming organizations around the world. We provide a powerful system for technical leaders at companies like PayPal, Atlassian, and Citi who want to take control of how they hire top engineers, elevate their teams and contractors, and stay ahead. At the core of Karat's system are live, expert\-led interviews, analytics designed to give leaders maximum visibility, and the most robust interview performance dataset in the world. **Come join our Communications team** ------------------------------------- Our Communications team is committed to sharpening how the market understands Karat; we build the channels, campaigns, and executive presence that position Karat as the definitive measure of talent. ### **What you will do** As Senior Director, Communications at Karat, you will own the company's entire communications function, spanning external, internal, executive, and crisis communications, and serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and leadership team. * Set and evolve Karat's integrated communications strategy, advising the CEO and leadership team on narrative, messaging, timing, and stakeholder impact. * Own media relations end\-to\-end, building proactive relationships with journalists and producers across business, technology, workplace, and trade press. * Develop integrated campaigns with Product Marketing and Demand Generation that turn thought leadership, research, and product milestones into stories that break through. * Build and run the CEO's platform across social, the company blog, earned media, and speaking opportunities, including the executive editorial calendar. * Lead internal and executive communications for major company moments, keeping employee\-facing and external narratives aligned. * Guide crisis and issues communications, coordinating response across Legal, People, Sales, and Marketing as needed. * Manage our PR agency and other communications partners to measurable outcomes, tracking KPIs across earned media, executive visibility, and employee understanding. ### **The experience you will bring** * 15\+ years of progressive communications experience spanning media relations, corporate, executive, and internal/change communications * Significant in\-house experience at a high\-growth technology or B2B company navigating rapid growth * A track record of building journalist relationships and securing high\-quality earned coverage * Demonstrated success developing narratives and campaigns that connect strategy, product, and industry conversation * Experience building executive platforms and coaching executives for media, speaking engagements, and high\-stakes moments * Exceptional writing and editorial judgment, from executive social content to all\-hands remarks * Experience guiding communications through periods of growth or high\-stakes change, with discretion and sound judgment * Experience managing PR agencies or communications partners to measurable outcomes * Fluency in how AI is reshaping hiring, talent assessment, and workforce planning, a plus ### **Curious what's driving this role right now? jobs.description: **Company Description** OleOle is building a global social, messaging and commerce platform designed specifically for the more than three billion football fans around the world. The platform brings together social media, short\-form video, encrypted messaging and calling, live scores, real\-time translation and football content within a single global ecosystem. Our goal is to connect fans across clubs, countries and languages while creating an infrastructure that extends well beyond social media. Every OleOle user receives a persistent Wallet ID that connects their identity across the ecosystem. Over time, OleOle will integrate payments, commerce, Mini Programs, ticketing and travel, gaming, digital assets and financial services. Mini Programs will allow clubs, brands, merchants and third\-party developers to build services directly within OleOle, using the platform’s identity, social and payment infrastructure. OleOleSport, our ticketing and travel business, provides an important early commercial opportunity through tickets, VIP hospitality and travel experiences around major sporting events. As the OleOle audience grows, additional businesses are designed to scale alongside it, including Mini Programs, payments, gaming and NewZeros, our planned financial infrastructure combining exchange capabilities with a broader payments and transaction network. We are currently a team of approximately 20 people building across backend infrastructure, social, video, messaging, AI and translation, payments, football data, product and design. OleOle is being built around a long\-term thesis: football is the world’s largest shared passion, yet its global audience remains fragmented across social networks, messaging applications, sports platforms and commerce providers. We believe there is an opportunity to bring those experiences together in one global platform and build significant businesses around the resulting network. OleOle — Where Fans Kick Off. **Job Description** We are looking for a senior, hands\-on iOS engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of OleOle’s native iOS application. You will work directly with our backend, product and design teams to build the mobile implementation of OleOle’s social, messaging, video, live\-score and payments functionality. You will: * Architect and build the native iOS application using Swift and SwiftUI. * Integrate backend APIs and realtime services as they are developed. * Build high\-performance social feeds and microblogging functionality. * Implement short\-form vertical video, including capture, upload, playback and media handling. * Implement encrypted one\-to\-one messaging and realtime chat. * Integrate voice and video calling. * Build contacts, invitations and user\-discovery functionality. * Implement live scores, realtime match events and push notifications. * Integrate authentication, account management and secure session handling. * Integrate wallet, payments and rewards functionality. * Implement localization and translation functionality. * Optimize startup, scrolling, media playback, networking, caching and battery usage. * Build reliable behavior for poor or intermittent network conditions. * Own testing, debugging and production reliability of the iOS application. * Take features from architecture through App Store production release. This is a hands\-on engineering role. We need someone capable of making architectural decisions and then writing the production code to implement them. Job Description We are looking for a senior, hands\-on Android engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of OleOle’s native Android application. You will work directly with our backend, product and design teams to build the mobile implementation of OleOle’s social, messaging, video, live\-score and payments functionality. You will: * Architect and build the native Android application using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. * Integrate backend APIs and realtime services as they are developed. * Build high\-performance social feeds and microblogging functionality. * Implement short\-form vertical video, including capture, upload, playback and media handling. * Implement encrypted one\-to\-one messaging and realtime chat. * Integrate voice and video calling. * Build contacts, invitations and user\-discovery functionality. * Implement live scores, realtime match events and push notifications. * Integrate authentication, account management and secure session handling. * Integrate wallet, payments and rewards functionality. * Implement localization and translation functionality. * Optimize startup, scrolling, media playback, networking, caching and battery usage. * Build reliable behavior across Android devices and poor or intermittent network conditions. * Own testing, debugging and production reliability of the Android application. * Take features from architecture through Google Play production release. This is a hands\-on engineering role. We nee deo capture, playback, compression, upload and media handling. * Strong understanding of Swift concurrency, networking, caching, memory management and mobile performance optimization. * Production experience with APNs, push notifications and background processing. * Experience implementing authentication, Keychain/secure storage, session management and privacy\-sensitive functionality. * Experience integrating complex backend APIs and working directly with backend engineers as APIs evolve. * Strong understanding of iOS application lifecycle, background execution and handling poor or intermittent network conditions. * Experience taking applications through App Store review, release and production operation. * Demonstrated ability to independently own a major application or feature from architecture through production. * Strong debugging, profiling, testing and production troubleshooting skills. * Must be a hands\-on engineer who writes production code, not primarily an engineering manager. Senior Android Engineer — Qualifications * 7\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including substantial native Android development. * Expert\-level Kotlin and strong production experience with Jetpack Compose. * Proven experience architecting, building and shipping complex consumer Android applications. * Experience building at least one substantial product involving social feeds, messaging, short\-form video, live content or realtime communications. * Strong experience with Kotlin Coroutines and Flow. * Strong experience with WebSockets and realtime/event\-driven mobile applications. * Production experience with WebRTC or comparable voice/video calling technology. * Strong experience with CameraX, Media3/ExoPlayer, including video capture, playback, compression, upload and media handling. * Strong understanding of Android networking, caching, memory management and mobile performance optimization. * Production experience with Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM), push notifications and background processing. * Experience implementing authentication, Android Keystore/secure storage, session management and privacy\-sensitive functionality. * Experience integrating complex backend APIs and working directly with backend engineers as APIs evolve. * Strong understanding of the Android application lifecycle, background execution, device/OS fragmentation and poor or intermittent network conditions. * Experience taking applications through Google Play review, release and production operation. * Demonstrated ability to independently own a major application or feature from architecture through production. * Strong debugging, profiling, testing and production troubleshooting skills. * Must be a hands\-on engineer who writes production code, not primarily an engineering manager. Compensation This position currently operates under a written deferred compensation agreement while OleOle completes its funding round. This is not unpaid or volunteer work. Compensation is earned during the deferred period and becomes payable when the company closes funding. Following funding, the position transitions to a standard compensation package consisting of a competitive salary plus equity and OleOle token participation. **Additional Information** Solutions not problems . * Creative problem solver who can courageously propose and support new ideas to our organization. Not interested in best practices, lets build something better! * Ability to adapt. An ideal candidate will welcome the opportunity to solve a broad range of problems using a wide array of technologies. * Comfortable with ambiguity, shifting priorities and general growing pains of an early\-stage technology company * An exceptional entrepreneurial judgment that fosters independence over micro\-management * Understanding of football and international sports a huge plus Ole Ole is located in beautiful Austin Texas, however, this role requires some travel we are privately held and rapidly growing!
